title: WeaveVLA: 3D Relational Grounding for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models leverage pretrained vision-language representations for instruction-conditioned robot control, yet their understanding of task-relevant 3D relations and how these relations evolve during manipulation remains largely implicit. To address this challenge, we introduce WeaveVLA, a framework that enhances VLA action generation by explicitly modeling task-relevant relative 3D relations and maintaining relational context across observations. WeaveVLA employs a task-conditioned sparse graph neural network to encode relative 3D relations among objects, the gripper, and nearby references. Pair-specific recurrent edge states integrate geometric evidence across observations to maintain evolving spatial context. A learned-query readout summarizes the updated graph representations into compact relational tokens, which condition the action expert alongside the original vision-language context. An auxiliary geometry reconstruction objective further encourages spatial structure preservation. We instantiate WeaveVLA on StarVLA-GR00T and $π_{0.5}$, achieving over 98% average success on LIBERO with both backbones. On LIBERO-Plus, WeaveVLA improves success from 74.9% to 82.0% and from 85.7% to 87.8%, respectively, with additional improvements on CALVIN D$\rightarrow$D. On three real-world tasks, the StarVLA-GR00T-based variant improves average success from 55.6% to 70.0% under standard conditions and from 33.3% to 53.3% under OOD perturbations, surpassing the $π_{0.5}$ baseline in both settings.
tldr: WeaveVLA enhances VLA models by explicitly modeling task-relevant relative 3D relations via a sparse graph neural network with recurrent edge states, achieving significant success improvements on LIBERO, CALVIN, and real-world manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: WeaveVLA 通过稀疏图神经网络和循环边状态显式建模任务相关的相对 3D 关系，在 LIBERO、CALVIN 和真实世界操作任务上显著提升了成功率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型利用预训练的视觉-语言表征实现指令条件下的机器人控制，但其对任务相关三维关系及其在操作过程中如何演变的理解在很大程度上仍是隐式的。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了WeaveVLA，一种通过显式建模任务相关的相对三维关系并在观测间维持关系上下文来增强VLA动作生成的框架。WeaveVLA采用任务条件化的稀疏图神经网络来编码物体、夹爪及邻近参考点之间的相对三维关系。成对特定的循环边状态跨观测整合几何证据，以维持不断演化的空间上下文。学习式查询读出将更新后的图表示归纳为紧凑的关系令牌，这些令牌连同原始视觉-语言上下文一起对动作专家进行条件化。辅助的几何重建目标进一步促进空间结构的保持。我们在StarVLA-GR00T和π₀.₅上实例化了WeaveVLA，在LIBERO基准上使用两种骨干网络均实现了超过98%的平均成功率。在LIBERO-Plus上，WeaveVLA将成功率分别从74.9%提升至82.0%、从85.7%提升至87.8%，并在CALVIN D→D上取得进一步改进。在三个真实世界任务中，基于StarVLA-GR00T的变体在标准条件下将平均成功率从55.6%提升至70.0%，在OOD扰动条件下从33.3%提升至53.3%，在两种设置下均超越了π₀.₅基线。

title: Wrist-Camera Video Diffusion as Generalizable Robot Policies
summary: A generalist manipulation policy should perform new tasks, operate in unfamiliar scenes, and transfer skills across robot embodiments. We present Wrist Video Policy (WVP), a closed-loop manipulation framework that learns how manipulation unfolds through video prediction and recovers executable motion through geometric estimation. Our key idea is to represent robot motion through wrist-camera trajectories, which determine the corresponding end-effector poses through a fixed hand-eye transformation. We pair a video generator that predicts future wrist views with a pose estimator adapted from a pretrained 3D model to recover the corresponding camera trajectories. Model stitching maps the generator's predicted latents directly into the estimator's intermediate feature space, bypassing RGB decoding. This decomposition allows task knowledge to expand through broad human and robot video data while reusing geometric motion estimation across tasks and embodiments. The resulting pose estimator transfers across Franka Panda, PiPER-X, and Galaxea R1 Pro without further fine-tuning. Across tabletop and laundry-room settings, WVP generalizes to tasks ranging from precise grasping and inserting to handling deformable objects, achieving a success rate of over 50% in zero-shot out-of-distribution evaluations. Our project page is at https://wrist-video-policy.github.io.
tldr: WVP is a closed-loop manipulation framework that predicts future wrist-camera videos and recovers end-effector poses via a pose estimator, enabling zero-shot generalization across tasks and robot embodiments through model stitching and video prediction.
tldr_zh: WVP 是一个闭环操作框架，通过预测未来腕部相机视频并使用位姿估计器恢复末端执行器位姿，实现跨任务和机器人本体的零样本泛化。
summary_zh: 通用操作策略应当能够执行新任务、在陌生场景中运作，并将技能迁移至不同的机器人本体。我们提出了腕部视频策略（Wrist Video Policy, WVP），这是一种闭环操作框架，通过视频预测学习操作过程，并通过几何估计恢复可执行的运动。我们的核心思想是用腕部相机轨迹来表示机器人运动，并通过固定的手眼变换确定相应的末端执行器姿态。我们结合了一个预测未来腕部视图的视频生成器，以及一个从预训练三维模型适配而来的姿态估计器，以恢复对应的相机轨迹。通过模型拼接，将生成器的预测潜变量直接映射到估计器的中间特征空间，绕过了RGB解码环节。这一分解方式使得任务知识能够通过丰富的人类和机器人视频数据扩展，同时在不同任务和机器人本体间复用几何运动估计。由此得到的姿态估计器能够直接迁移到Franka Panda、PiPER-X和Galaxea R1 Pro上，无需进一步微调。在桌面操作和洗衣房场景中，WVP能够泛化至精确抓取、插入以及处理可变形物体等各类任务，在零样本分布外评估中实现了超过50%的成功率。我们的项目页面位于https://wrist-video-policy.github.io。

title: RoboUniverse-10K: Toward the Scaling Era of Agentic Robotics via Real-to-Sim Environments
summary: Agentic Robotics, in which foundation models act as coding agents to control robots through executable programs, has emerged as a compelling paradigm for embodied intelligence. Yet unlike software engineering, where massive executable environments power post-training, robotics remains constrained by small, manual benchmarks and in-distribution evaluation. To bridge this gap, we introduce RoboUniverse-10K, 10,807 interactive, resettable, and verifiable physics environments built from real-world videos via an automated Real2Sim and quality assurance pipeline. Each runs in an isolated, Harbor-compatible harness that hides privileged states and grading logic to mirror real-world sensing. From the same pipeline, we hold out 500 unseen tasks to establish RoboUniverse-Verified, an expert-verified zero-shot benchmark. Evaluating 11 closed- and open-source models reveals a huge gap: frontier models reach 85.8\% success, while open-source baselines lag at 2.6\% to 10.0\%, bottlenecked by low-level grasping, deformable-object manipulation, and post-contact physical control. Finally, we collect about 17K multi-turn trajectories totaling 0.79B tokens with GPT-6 Astra and perform full-parameter supervised fine-tuning on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, yielding RoboUniverse-35B-A3B. Our model achieves substantial zero-shot gains on RoboUniverse-Verified, lifting the success rate from 0.8\% to 21.2\%, while achieving zero-shot task completions across LIBERO-MAX, RoboCasa, RoboTwin 2.0, and a real Franka arm. We open-source the RL-ready environments and model to lay the foundation for large-scale reinforcement learning in Agentic Robotics.
tldr: RoboUniverse-10K introduces 10,807 interactive, resettable, and verifiable physics environments built from real-world videos via an automated Real2Sim pipeline, plus a held-out zero-shot benchmark and a fine-tuned VLA model, enabling large-scale post-training for agentic robotics and demonstrating significant zero-shot success gains on real and simulated tasks.
tldr_zh: RoboUniverse-10K 通过自动化 Real2Sim 流程从真实视频构建了 10,807 个交互式、可重置的物理环境，并附带一个留出的零样本基准和一个微调后的 VLA 模型，为智能体机器人提供大规模后训练，在真实和模拟任务上展示了显著的零样本成功率提升。
summary_zh: 代理式机器人技术——在这一范式中，基础模型充当编码代理，通过可执行程序控制机器人——已成为具身智能的一种引人注目的范式。然而，与软件工程中依靠海量可执行环境驱动训练后优化的做法不同，机器人领域仍受限于规模小、人工标注的基准测试和分布内评估。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了RoboUniverse-10K，一个包含10,807个交互式、可重置且可验证的物理环境的数据集，这些环境通过自动化的真实到仿真（Real2Sim）及质量保障流水线，从真实世界视频构建而成。每个环境均运行在独立的、兼容Harbor的测试框架中，该框架隐藏特权状态和评分逻辑，以模拟真实世界感知。基于同一流水线，我们预留出500个未见过的任务，构建了RoboUniverse-Verified，一个经专家验证的零样本基准测试。对11个闭源和开源模型的评估揭示出巨大差距：前沿模型达到85.8%的成功率，而开源基线模型仅达2.6%至10.0%，其瓶颈在于低层抓取、可变形物体操作以及接触后的物理控制。最后，我们使用GPT-6 Astra收集了约17K条多轮轨迹，总计0.79B个标记，并对Qwen3.6-35B-A3B进行全参数监督微调，得到RoboUniverse-35B-A3B。我们的模型在RoboUniverse-Verified上取得了显著的零样本性能提升，将成功率从0.8%提升至21.2%，同时在LIBERO-MAX、RoboCasa、RoboTwin 2.0以及真实的Franka机械臂上实现了零样本任务完成。我们开源了可供强化学习直接使用的环境及模型，为代理式机器人技术中的大规模强化学习奠定基础。

title: CoSel: Cooperation as Selection for End-to-End Driving
summary: Cooperative driving can extend a vehicle's awareness beyond its own sensors, but existing cooperative end-to-end methods inject shared information into the planner and rely on cooperative driving demonstrations to learn how to use it. The moments in which shared information should change a driving decision are rare in such data, providing limited supervision for learning this behavior. We argue that cooperation need not be learned by the planner. Instead, reacting to shared information requires predicting how surrounding agents will move and selecting a response from the candidate trajectories of an ego planner. We introduce CoSel, a cooperation-as-selection framework that leaves the planner and its ego-only input unchanged. A separately trained cooperative predictor uses observations from the ego vehicle, roadside units, and connected automated vehicles to predict surrounding agents and their future motion. CoSel evaluates the planner's candidate trajectories against these predictions, preserves the planner's choice when it remains safe, and selects the closest safe alternative when shared information reveals additional risk. Each safety intervention is traceable to the shared evidence that triggers it. In closed-loop evaluation, CoSel achieves a driving score of 70.7 on V2Xverse, outperforming the best compared cooperative method by 7.5 points, and the highest average driving score of 85.8 on MDrive. Under missing ego detections, the collision count of CoSel increases only from 17 to 19 in 72 scenarios, compared with 19 to 32 for an existing cooperative end-to-end model.
tldr: CoSel introduces a cooperation-as-selection framework for end-to-end driving, where a separately trained cooperative predictor evaluates candidate trajectories of an unchanged ego-only planner and selects safe alternatives when shared information reveals risk, improving closed-loop driving scores and robustness to missing detections.
tldr_zh: CoSel提出了一种用于端到端驾驶的协作即选择框架，通过单独训练的协作预测器评估未经修改的ego-only规划器的候选轨迹，并在共享信息揭示风险时选择安全替代方案，从而提高了闭环驾驶分数和对缺失检测的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 协同驾驶可以将车辆的感知范围拓展至其自身传感器之外，但现有的协同端到端方法将共享信息注入规划器，并依赖协同驾驶示范来学习如何使用这些信息。在真实数据中，共享信息应当改变驾驶决策的时刻极为罕见，这为此类行为的学习提供了极为有限的监督信号。我们认为，协同能力并不需要由规划器来学习。相反，对共享信息做出反应需要对周围智能体的运动进行预测，并从自车规划器的候选轨迹中选择相应的响应。我们提出了CoSel——一种“协同即选择”框架，该框架保持规划器及其仅基于自车信息的输入不变。一个单独训练的协同预测器利用来自自车、路侧单元及网联自动驾驶车辆的观测数据，预测周围智能体及其未来运动。CoSel根据这些预测对规划器的候选轨迹进行评估：当原规划结果安全时予以保留，而当共享信息揭示出额外风险时，则选择最近的安全替代轨迹。每一次安全干预均可追溯至触发该干预的共享证据。在闭环评估中，CoSel在V2Xverse数据集上取得了70.7的驾驶评分，比最优对比协同方法高出7.5分；在MDrive数据集上取得了最高平均驾驶评分85.8。在自车检测缺失的情况下，CoSel在72个场景中的碰撞次数仅从17次增至19次，而现有协同端到端模型则从19次增至32次。

title: World Models as Native Latent Action Models
summary: Large and diverse video sources, such as egocentric human video and heterogeneous robot recordings, carry rich dynamics but come either without actions or without a shared action space. Latent action models (LAMs) can recover these dynamics, but they train their inverse- and forward-dynamics models (IDM, FDM) from scratch, trading off pixel reconstruction against latent capacity and accuracy. Pretrained video world models natively generate high-fidelity dynamics, yet represent them densely, entangled across all layers. Viewing the world model as a LAM, we show that these dynamics can be extracted with minimal changes to the model. Native LAM operates one pretrained video diffusion transformer as both IDM and FDM, with learnable dynamics registers as the only causal bridge between the two, and trains on counterfactual temporal pairs that differ in motion alone, so that the registers distill a video's dynamics into a compact native latent action. We further propose a pretraining paradigm for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, Pretraining Actions from World models (PAWlicy), in which Native LAM serves as a dynamics teacher on large-scale video; unlike world action models, it never generates video. Native latent actions outperform existing LAMs on the LARY benchmark in both action classification and control regression, and replay the same motion on new robots, in new scenes, and from human hands to robots, although no transfer objective is used in training. With a 3.8B model, PAWlicy reaches a 93.6% average success rate on RoboTwin 2.0 trained with domain-randomized demonstrations, the highest among VLAs. On RoboDojo, it is competitive on every dimension we evaluate, and its Precision, evaluated by us, is on par with the leading leaderboard entries. On real robots, it improves over the pi_0.5 baseline on both tasks. Both stages use only public data and a publicly released world model.
tldr: This paper introduces Native LAM, a method that reuses a pretrained video diffusion transformer as both inverse- and forward-dynamics models to extract compact latent actions from videos, and applies it to pretrain VLA policies (PAWlicy), achieving strong results on robot manipulation benchmarks and real robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Native LAM，将预训练视频扩散模型同时用作逆动力学和正动力学模型，从视频中提取紧凑的潜在动作，并用于VLA策略的预训练（PAWlicy），在机器人操作基准和真实机器人上取得了优异性能。
summary_zh: 大规模多样化的视频源，例如自我中心的人类视频和异构机器人记录，蕴含着丰富的动态信息，但要么缺乏动作标签，要么缺少共享的动作空间。潜在动作模型（LAMs）能够恢复这些动态信息，但它们的逆动力学模型（IDM）和前向动力学模型（FDM）是从零开始训练的，需要在像素重建与潜在容量及准确性之间进行权衡。预训练的视频世界模型天然能够生成高保真的动态信息，但以密集形式表示，并与所有层纠缠在一起。将世界模型视为LAM，我们表明这些动态信息可以通过对模型的极小改动来提取。Native LAM将单个预训练的视频扩散Transformer同时用作IDM和FDM，可学习的动态寄存器作为两者之间唯一的因果桥梁，并在仅运动状态不同的反事实时间对上进行训练，从而使寄存器将视频的动态信息提炼为紧凑的原生潜在动作。我们进一步提出了一种用于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的预训练范式，即从世界模型预训练动作（PAWlicy），其中Native LAM在大规模视频上充当动态教师；与世界动作模型不同，它从不生成视频。在LARY基准上，原生潜在动作在动作分类和控制回归方面均优于现有LAM，并且能够在没有使用任何迁移目标进行训练的情况下，在新机器人、新场景以及从人类手部到机器人的跨域中重放相同的运动。使用3.8B模型，PAWlicy在RoboTwin 2.0上使用领域随机化演示训练时达到了93.6%的平均成功率，在VLA中最高。在RoboDojo上，它在我们评估的每个维度上都具有竞争力，并且我们评估的Precision与排行榜领先条目相当。在真实机器人上，它在两个任务上都超过了pi_0.5基线。两个阶段仅使用公开数据和公开发布的世界模型。

title: OVOGO: Offline Value-Guided On-Policy Generative Optimization for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Flow-based vision-language-action models can benefit from robot experience collected during deployment, but repeatedly acquiring new physical interactions for policy improvement is costly. Offline reinforcement learning provides a natural way to reuse collected experience, while flow-based policies offer an additional opportunity because fresh generation trajectories can be cheaply resampled from the current policy at replay observations. This motivates separating offline value learning from on-policy optimization of the generative process. We propose OVOGO, an offline reinforcement learning framework that realizes this separation for flow-based VLAs. A central challenge in this formulation is to learn a critic that remains grounded in logged robot experience while providing useful value signals for newly generated actions. OVOGO introduces a Return-Anchored Ranking Critic that combines in-sample distributional value learning with guarded local ranking, improving discrimination among generated actions without assigning them artificial return targets. The frozen critic then provides group-relative value signals for selected-transition optimization of fresh action candidates sampled from the current flow policy. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0, DexJoCo, and LIBERO, as well as a real-robot dexterous manipulation task, show that OVOGO improves the initial VLA across all four settings and achieves higher success rates than the evaluated offline adaptation and value-guided baselines. These results suggest that offline robot experience can be repeatedly reused for value learning while inexpensive generative sampling supports policy optimization, providing an effective approach to experience-based post-training of flow-based VLAs.
tldr: OVOGO is an offline RL framework for flow-based VLA models that separates offline value learning from on-policy generative optimization, using a Return-Anchored Ranking Critic to provide grounded value signals for fresh action candidates, improving robot policies across simulated and real-robot tasks.
tldr_zh: OVOGO 是一种针对基于流的视觉-语言-动作模型的离线强化学习框架，它通过将离线的价值学习与在线的生成式优化分离，并利用锚定回报的排序评论家为新的动作候选提供有根据的价值信号，从而在模拟和真实机器人任务中提升策略性能。
summary_zh: 基于流的视觉-语言-动作模型可以受益于部署过程中收集的机器人经验，但反复获取新的物理交互以改进策略成本高昂。离线强化学习为复用已收集经验提供了一种自然途径，而基于流的策略则提供了额外机会，因为可以从当前策略在回放观测处廉价地重新采样新的生成轨迹。这促使我们将离线价值学习与生成过程的在线策略优化分离开来。我们提出OVOGO，一种实现基于流VLA这一分离目标的离线强化学习框架。该框架面临的核心挑战在于，如何学习一个评论者，使其既扎根于记录的机器人经验，又能为新生成的动作提供有效的价值信号。OVOGO引入了返回锚定排名评论者（Return-Anchored Ranking Critic），将样本内分布价值学习与有保护的局部排名相结合，在不赋予生成动作人为返回目标的情况下提升其判别能力。冻结的评论者随后为从当前流策略采样得到的新动作候选提供基于组相对的价值信号，以支持选择性转移优化。在RoboTwin 2.0、DexJoCo和LIBERO上的实验以及真实机器人灵巧操作任务表明，OVOGO在全部四种设置中均提升了初始VLA的性能，并取得了高于所评估的离线适应方法和价值引导基线的成功率。这些结果表明，离线机器人经验可以反复用于价值学习，而廉价的生成采样支持策略优化，从而为基于流的VLA提供了一种有效的基于经验的后训练方法。

title: ROSE-Drive: Runtime Orchestration and System Evolution for Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end driving models have made substantial progress, yet reliable closed-loop driving in complex traffic remains challenging. Beyond improving individual models, system-level orchestration offers a complementary approach by coordinating driving capabilities and computation. We introduce ROSE-Drive (Runtime Orchestration and System Evolution), a model-agnostic framework that jointly orchestrates driving execution and computation. It coordinates frozen driving models with driving skills, perception tools, and feedback controllers. A distilled vision-language model (VLM) proposes driving tasks and scene relations. Shared physical state and persistent tasks support capability composition, task continuity, and adaptive scheduling. The orchestrator combines model and skill outputs across control channels, maintains task responsibility through handover, and uses execution feedback to select controllers, reuse valid motion references, and schedule model inference. Offline revisions use execution records to refine skills and their coordination through a stable task interface. Successive system stages inherit these revisions while model, perception, and VLM weights remain fixed. Evaluations with four driving models on Bench2Drive v0.0.3, Bench2Drive v0.0.4, and Fail2Drive show accumulated capability and transfer before target-benchmark revision. On held-out Longest6, driving score (DS) rises from 25 to 52 for AutoMoT and from 22 to 47 for SimLingo across system stages, while both systems skip new model inference on over 71% of control steps.
tldr: ROSE-Drive is a model-agnostic runtime orchestration framework for autonomous driving that coordinates frozen driving models, skills, perception tools, and feedback controllers via a distilled VLM and persistent task states, improving closed-loop driving scores across multiple benchmarks.
tldr_zh: ROSE-Drive 是一个模型无关的自动驾驶运行时编排框架，通过蒸馏视觉语言模型和持久任务状态协调冻结的驾驶模型、技能、感知工具和反馈控制器，在多个基准上提升闭环驾驶分数。
summary_zh: 端到端驾驶模型已取得显著进展，但在复杂交通场景中实现可靠的闭环驾驶仍具挑战。除改进单个模型外，系统级编排通过协调驾驶能力与计算资源，提供了一种互补性方案。我们提出ROSE-Drive（运行时编排与系统演进），一种模型无关的框架，联合编排驾驶执行与计算。该框架将冻结的驾驶模型与驾驶技能、感知工具及反馈控制器协同配合。蒸馏视觉语言模型（VLM）提出驾驶任务并识别场景关系。共享物理状态与持久任务支持能力组合、任务连续性与自适应调度。编排器在控制通道间整合模型与技能输出，通过交接维持任务职责，并利用执行反馈选择控制器、复用有效运动参考及调度模型推理。离线修订利用执行记录，通过稳定的任务接口优化技能及其协调机制。系统各阶段继承这些修订成果，同时模型、感知及VLM权重保持固定。在Bench2Drive v0.0.3、Bench2Drive v0.0.4及Fail2Drive上对四种驾驶模型的评估显示，在目标基准修订前即出现能力的累积与迁移。在保留的Longest6上，AutoMoT的驾驶得分（DS）跨系统阶段从25升至52，SimLingo从22升至47，而两系统在超过71%的控制步骤中跳过了新的模型推理。

title: AgentMoT: An Agentic Mixture-of-Transformers for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Driving models need to choose which capabilities to use and when to reconsider their decisions. We introduce AgentMoT, a Mixture-of-Transformers with built-in agent reasoning and system scheduling. Combinations of agent, world, and action experts form three jointly trained pathways for direct-action, vision-language-action, and world-action computation. The Router selects a native pathway, while the agent expert supplies reasoning and selects skills. Execution feedback raises wake-up requests, and the agent self-scheduler learns whether to reconsider the task decision or keep it. Mandatory requests invoke the agent directly. The relative-capability principle guides these choices by relating the benefit of additional computation or intervention to its cost. After open-loop initialization, dual-loop evolution trains the Router, agent, and self-scheduler from closed-loop experience while failure-driven updates refine skills and execution feedback. AgentMoT achieves state-of-the-art results on Bench2Drive v0.0.3 and v0.0.4, with 94.48/92.33 driving score and 85.45/82.73% success rate, respectively. With skills disabled, learned routing improves over the strongest fixed pathway by 1.79 driving-score points and 4.09 percentage points of success rate on v0.0.3. Ablation studies further show gains from closed-loop agent learning, two-view queries, and event-triggered wake-up.
tldr: AgentMoT introduces a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture with agent reasoning and system scheduling for end-to-end autonomous driving, achieving state-of-the-art results on Bench2Drive benchmarks through dual-loop evolution and event-triggered wake-up.
tldr_zh: AgentMoT 提出了一种具有智能体推理和系统调度的 Transformer 混合架构，用于端到端自动驾驶，通过双循环进化和事件触发唤醒在 Bench2Drive 基准上取得了最先进的结果。
summary_zh: 驾驶模型需要选择使用哪些能力，以及何时重新考虑其决策。我们提出了AgentMoT，一种内置智能体推理与系统调度的混合Transformer架构。智能体专家、世界专家与动作专家的组合构成了三条联合训练的通路，分别用于直接动作计算、视觉-语言-动作计算以及世界-动作计算。路由器选择原生通路，而智能体专家提供推理并选择技能。执行反馈触发唤醒请求，智能体自调度器学习是重新考虑任务决策还是维持原判。强制请求直接调用智能体。相对能力原则通过将额外计算或干预的收益与其成本相关联来指导这些选择。在开环初始化之后，双环进化从闭环经验中训练路由器、智能体与自调度器，同时失败驱动的更新精炼技能并优化执行反馈。AgentMoT在Bench2Drive v0.0.3和v0.0.4上取得了最先进的结果，驾驶得分分别为94.48和92.33，成功率分别为85.45%和82.73%。在禁用技能的情况下，学习到的路由在v0.0.3上比最强固定通路提升了1.79个驾驶得分点和4.09个百分点的成功率。消融研究进一步显示了闭环智能体学习、双视角查询以及事件触发唤醒带来的增益。

title: Beyond Which: Where, How, and When in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models typically rely on vision-language model (VLM) features as the primary perceptual source for action prediction, showing strong generalization across diverse robotic manipulation tasks. Although VLM features can identify which entities are relevant to action prediction, precise manipulation also requires understanding where task-relevant entities are located within the spatial layout, how their geometric structure constrains physical interaction, and when spatial or geometric information should make a greater contribution to action prediction. To this end, we introduce {\mathcal{W}^{3}\mathcal{H}}-VLA to organize VLA perception and action prediction around which, where, how, and when. Specifically, {\mathcal{W}^{3}\mathcal{H}}-VLA retains VLM-based semantic entity perception which and further introduces spatial distance perception where and geometric structure perception how with adaptive spatial-geometric guidance when to enrich the perceptual information available for action prediction. Experiments across real-world settings and simulation benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and superior performance of {\mathcal{W}^{3}\mathcal{H}}-VLA.
tldr: The paper introduces W3H-VLA, a VLA model that augments VLM-based semantic perception with spatial distance and geometric structure perception, guided adaptively to improve robotic manipulation action prediction.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出W3H-VLA，在VLM语义感知的基础上增加空间距离和几何结构感知，并自适应地引导其作用，以提升机器人操作的动作预测。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通常依赖视觉-语言模型（VLM）的特征作为动作预测的主要感知来源，在多样化的机器人操作任务中展现出强大的泛化能力。尽管VLM特征能够识别哪些实体与动作预测相关，但精确操作还需要理解任务相关实体在空间布局中的位置、其几何结构如何约束物理交互，以及空间或几何信息何时应当对动作预测作出更大贡献。为此，我们提出了{\mathcal{W}^{3}\mathcal{H}}-VLA，围绕“什么、在哪里、如何以及何时”来组织VLA的感知与动作预测。具体而言，{\mathcal{W}^{3}\mathcal{H}}-VLA保留了基于VLM的语义实体感知（什么），并进一步引入空间距离感知（在哪里）和几何结构感知（如何），同时通过自适应空间-几何引导（何时）来丰富动作预测可用的感知信息。在真实世界场景和仿真基准上的实验结果表明，{\mathcal{W}^{3}\mathcal{H}}-VLA具有有效性和优越性能。

title: Quantizing in the Loop: Drift-Aware Ultra-Low-Bit Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Deploying large vision-language-action (VLA) models on resource-constrained robots demands extreme compression, yet existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods frequently collapse at ultra-low bit-widths ($\le$ 2 bits). We trace this failure to two mismatches in standard pipelines. First, calibrating on static offline demonstrations induces distribution shift: minor quantization perturbations drive the policy into unseen states where uncalibrated errors compound. Second, minimizing the layer-wise weight reconstruction error is a flawed proxy, as action generation depends only on the representations consumed by the action head. We present LoopQ, an on-policy ultra-low-bit quantization framework. LoopQ closes the loop by calibrating on states from the quantized policy's own rollouts. It then adds readout-aligned fine-tuning, which freezes the trellis codes and optimizes only lightweight lookup tables and scaling factors to align the backbone readout with the full-precision teacher. With all linear layers at 2 bits, LoopQ achieves a 60.4% success rate on LIBERO-Plus with GR00T N1.7, close to the 61.8% of full precision. Even at 1 bit per weight, $π_{0.5}$ still completes 80.0% of LIBERO tasks. With 8-bit activations, the 2-bit $π_{0.5}$ runs on integer kernels on an embedded NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor, with 4.1$\times$ smaller weights and 44% less memory. On a real AgileX Piper arm, it stays within one success of full precision on each of three tasks. Code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/ForeverBlue816/LoopQ
tldr: LoopQ introduces an on-policy, drift-aware post-training quantization framework for ultra-low-bit VLA models, calibrating on the quantized policy's own rollouts and adding readout-aligned fine-tuning to achieve near-full-precision success rates on simulation and real robot tasks while drastically reducing memory and compute.
tldr_zh: LoopQ提出了一种在策略的、漂移感知的VLA模型超低位量化框架，通过在量化策略自身rollout上校准并添加读出对齐微调，在仿真和真实机器人任务中实现了接近全精度的成功率，同时大幅降低内存和计算需求。
summary_zh: 在资源受限的机器人上部署大型视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型需要进行极致的压缩，然而现有的后训练量化（PTQ）方法在超低位宽（$\le$ 2比特）下经常失效。我们将这一失败归因于标准流水线中的两个不匹配。首先，在静态离线示范上进行校准会导致分布偏移：微小的量化扰动会驱动策略进入未观测状态，在这些状态中未校准的误差会不断累积。其次，最小化逐层权重重构误差是一个有缺陷的替代目标，因为动作生成仅依赖于动作头所消费的表征。我们提出了LoopQ，一个在线策略超低位宽量化框架。LoopQ通过量化策略自身轨迹中的状态进行校准，从而形成闭环。随后，它添加了对齐读取的微调，该步骤冻结格状码（trellis codes），仅优化轻量级查找表和缩放因子，以使骨干网络的读取输出与全精度教师模型对齐。将所有线性层量化至2比特时，LoopQ在LIBERO-Plus上使用GR00T N1.7达到了60.4%的成功率，接近全精度模型的61.8%。即使在每权重1比特的情况下，$π_{0.5}$仍能完成LIBERO任务的80.0%。在8比特激活下，2比特的$π_{0.5}$能够在嵌入式NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor上以整数内核运行，权重缩小4.1$\times$，内存减少44%。在真实的AgileX Piper机械臂上，它在三个任务中的每一个任务中与全精度模型的成功率相差不超过一次成功。代码和检查点可在 https://github.com/ForeverBlue816/LoopQ 获取。

title: RMR-VLA: Recurrent Memory Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Long-horizon, history-dependent robotic manipulation often requires acting on visual cues that have disappeared, such as an object indicated earlier or a target hidden under a moving cup. The key challenge is to maintain what past evidence means for the next action as the scene changes. We introduce Recurrent Memory Reasoning (RMR), an explicit reasoning step that connects memory to action inside a vision-language-action model (VLA), with no external reasoning model. At each update, the VLA first infers an event from visual evidence, then revises the task state and grounds a subgoal in the current scene to guide action generation. Carrying the state and subgoal across updates lets remembered identities and task progress determine the current target, doubling RoboMME success over an otherwise identical model without recurrence. Joint training lets one VLA both reason and act; because its memory decisions are text tokens with exact likelihoods, GRPO refines them from rollout rewards without making action generation stochastic. Among the compared methods, RMR-VLA achieves the best results on RoboMME (66.46% overall, 79.83% on the Reference category) and LIBERO-Mem (90.08%).
tldr: RMR-VLA introduces a recurrent memory reasoning module inside a VLA model, using text-based memory tokens and GRPO fine-tuning to improve long-horizon, history-dependent robotic manipulation. It achieves state-of-the-art results on the RoboMME and LIBERO-Mem benchmarks.
tldr_zh: RMR-VLA 在视觉-语言-动作模型中引入了循环记忆推理模块，利用基于文本的记忆标记和 GRPO 微调来改进长期、依赖历史的机器人操作，并在 RoboMME 和 LIBERO-Mem 基准上取得了最优结果。
summary_zh: 长期且依赖历史信息的机器人操作任务，通常需要根据已经消失的视觉线索采取行动，例如先前指示过的物体，或是藏于移动杯下的目标。其核心挑战在于，随着场景的变化，如何维持过往证据对下一步行动的意义。我们提出了循环记忆推理（Recurrent Memory Reasoning, RMR），一种在视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）内部将记忆与行动相连的显式推理步骤，无需借助外部推理模型。在每次更新时，VLA首先根据视觉证据推断出一个事件，随后修正任务状态，并在当前场景中设定子目标以引导动作生成。通过跨更新携带状态与子目标，记忆中的身份信息和任务进度得以决定当前目标，使RoboMME的成功率相比无循环机制的同构模型提升了一倍。联合训练使同一个VLA既能推理又能执行；由于其记忆决策是以精确似然度表示的文本令牌，GRPO可利用回滚奖励对其进行优化，而无需使动作生成过程随机化。在所对比的方法中，RMR-VLA在RoboMME（总体66.46%，Reference类别79.83%）和LIBERO-Mem（90.08%）上均取得了最优结果。

title: RoboThink: Let the Agent Think, Let the Policy Act
summary: Robot policies act in real time but fail without knowing why, whereas a reasoning agent that watches the robot can often tell what went wrong. Existing systems either hand the agent control, which takes minutes per episode, or let it send instructions. Yet a policy follows a new instruction only from a fresh start, since a half-finished task leaves it in states outside its training data. Nor can an instruction fix how the robot moves. If a drift keeps pulling the hand to the left, "push right, slightly" is not a task the policy has learned. We propose RoboThink, in which the agent thinks and the policy learns to act on the agent's guidance. An instruction channel tells the policy what to do. When the user says "the milk, not the butter" after the robot has started, the agent rewrites the instruction and the robot undoes its own motion, with no training. A feedback channel tells it how to move. It is taught from the agent alone with agent-labelled DAgger, role tokens and counterfactual feedback, and is read only by the policy's action module. On LIBERO, RoboThink with Claude Opus 5.5 raises success from 0.09 to 0.87 under an unknown constant drift and from 0.42 to 0.84 under a random one. It also completes misheard and changed requests in 0.91 to 1.00 of the episodes. Acting alone, GPT-6 Astra needs 2.1 min per success and over a million tokens per episode, whereas RoboThink needs 55 s and 8k tokens. The same recipe works across policies, for both vision-language-action models and world action models, and across robots, from one arm to two arms and a mobile manipulator. On all 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks with two arms, success rises from 0.12 to 0.74 under the constant drift and from 0.31 to 0.56 under the random one. Finally, the agent is a plug-in. A policy taught by one agent works with other agents, including open-weight ones, and grows stronger with a stronger agent, without retraining.
tldr: RoboThink introduces a plug-in reasoning agent that provides instruction and feedback channels to a robot policy, enabling correction of unknown drifts and changed user requests without retraining, and it is demonstrated on LIBERO and RoboTwin benchmarks with multiple policy types and robot embodiments.
tldr_zh: RoboThink 提出了一种即插即用的推理代理，通过指令和反馈通道为机器人策略提供指导，无需重新训练即可纠正未知漂移和变更的用户请求，并在 LIBERO 和 RoboTwin 基准上针对多种策略类型和机器人形态进行了验证。
summary_zh: 机器人策略能够实时执行动作，但在失败时却无法解释原因，而一个观察机器人的推理智能体则往往能判断出问题所在。现有系统要么将控制权交给智能体，这需要每回合花费数分钟时间，要么让智能体发送指令。然而，策略只有在全新开始时才能遵循新的指令，因为任务进行到一半会使它处于训练数据之外的状态。指令也无法纠正机器人的动作方式。如果存在漂移不断将手拉向左侧，那么“向右推，稍微用力”并不是策略学习过的任务。我们提出了RoboThink，该框架中智能体负责思考，策略则学习在智能体的指导下执行动作。指令通道告知策略该做什么。当机器人在开始后收到用户指令“要牛奶，不是黄油”时，智能体会重写指令，机器人无需训练即可撤销自身的动作。反馈通道则告知它该如何移动。该通道仅由智能体单独训练，使用智能体标注的DAgger、角色标记和反事实反馈，并且只能由策略的动作模块读取。在LIBERO基准上，使用Claude Opus 5.5的RoboThink在未知恒定漂移下将成功率从0.09提升至0.87，在随机漂移下从0.42提升至0.84。同时，在0.91至1.00的回合中，它能够完成听错和变更的请求。若仅由智能体独立执行，GPT-6 Astra每次成功需要2.1分钟，每回合消耗超过一百万token，而RoboThink仅需55秒和8k token。该方案在不同策略、不同机器人（从单臂到双臂及移动操作平台）上均能奏效，适用于视觉-语言-动作模型和世界动作模型。在RoboTwin 2.0全部50个双臂任务中，恒定漂移下的成功率从0.12提升至0.74，随机漂移下从0.31提升至0.56。最后，智能体是一个即插即用的组件。由一个智能体训练的策略可以与其他智能体（包括开放权重智能体）协同工作，并且在更强的智能体帮助下会变得更强，无需重新训练。

title: Hierarchical Reasoning Action Head for Tiny Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Real-time onboard robot control calls for a lightweight vision-language-action (VLA) model, yet shrinking the backbone leaves less capacity for deliberation at inference time. Chain-of-thought decoding, dual-system architectures, and larger backbones can restore deliberation but reintroduce the latency and memory costs that motivated going small. Recurrent action heads offer a lighter alternative by iterating in latent space before committing to an action, but existing designs refine a single undifferentiated state that must simultaneously encode slowly evolving task context and rapidly changing motor commands. We propose the Hierarchical Reasoning Action Head (HR-AH), which maintains two latent states updated at different frequencies: a low-level state that updates fast, grounded in action tokens and proprioception, and a high-level state that updates slowly, grounded in visual understanding and the instruction-informed low-level state. The two states exchange information through nested reasoning cycles. Because all iteration occurs in the compact head after a single backbone pass, HR-AH adds hierarchical reasoning without increasing the backbone size. With a 22.5M-parameter head, 3-4.3x smaller than those of RD-VLA and VLA-Adapter on the same backbone, HR-AH reaches 97.0% success rate on LIBERO and a 4.40 average chain length on CALVIN ABC->D, at the lowest latency among compared methods. We show that this hierarchy improves performance over a parameter-matched single-state head, and that routing distinct modalities to each level yields further gains in both accuracy and inference cost.
tldr: This paper proposes a Hierarchical Reasoning Action Head (HR-AH) for tiny VLA models, which maintains two latent states updated at different frequencies to enable hierarchical reasoning without increasing backbone size, achieving state-of-the-art performance on LIBERO and CALVIN benchmarks with low latency.
tldr_zh: 本文为微型VLA模型提出了一种层级推理动作头（HR-AH），通过维护以不同频率更新的两个潜在状态来实现层级推理，无需增大主干网络规模，在LIBERO和CALVIN基准上以低延迟取得了最优性能。
summary_zh: 实时机载机器人控制需要轻量级的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，然而缩小骨干网络规模会减少推理时的思考能力。链式思维解码、双系统架构以及更大的骨干网络虽能恢复推理能力，但会重新引入促使模型小型化的延迟和内存成本。循环动作头提供了一种更轻量的替代方案，通过在行动之前于潜在空间中进行迭代来实现，但现有设计仅优化单一无差别状态，该状态必须同时编码缓慢演化的任务上下文和快速变化的电机指令。我们提出了层次化推理动作头（HR-AH），它维护两个以不同频率更新的潜在状态：一个低频更新的高层状态，基于视觉理解和指令引导的低层状态；以及一个高频更新的低层状态，基于动作标记和本体感觉。两个状态通过嵌套推理循环交换信息。由于所有迭代均在单次骨干网络前向传播后在紧凑的动作头中完成，HR-AH在不增加骨干网络规模的前提下增加了层次化推理能力。在22.5M参数的动作头配置下，比同一骨干网络上RD-VLA和VLA-Adapter的动作头小3至4.3倍，HR-AH在LIBERO上达到97.0%的成功率，在CALVIN ABC->D上达到4.40的平均链长，同时在对比方法中延迟最低。我们证明，该层次结构在性能上优于参数匹配的单状态动作头，并且将不同模态路由到各层级在准确性和推理成本两方面均带来进一步提升。

title: Into My Arms: Structured reinforcement learning for autonomous transport of objects and humans
summary: Whole-body humanoid manipulation remains bottlenecked by high-dimensional state-action spaces, contact-rich environments, and long task horizons. This trilemma is a challenge that state-of-the-art reinforcement learning (RL) methods are yet to resolve reliably. We address it with three contributions that add just enough structure to guide exploration: Sparse Interaction Edges (SIE) for whole-body manipulation, Interaction Gated Transport (IGT) for sustained transport over long horizons, and a Hinted Object Path (HOP) that resolves collision and search complexity bottlenecks. Across all three, the policy remains free to discover its own manipulation strategy. The method generalises from rigid object to human transport. As a flagship demonstration, we show, to our knowledge, the first bed-to-wheelchair transfer of a medical mannequin by a humanoid robot completed with no human intervention during execution. In the domain of human transfer, we show that a single policy can adapt across substantial variations in body mass, size, and random force perturbations, all while training on a single GPU in under an hour. Our approach offers a pathway to fully RL-driven humanoid manipulation, enabling assistive robots that can help humans. Website: https://elle-miller.github.io/into_my_arms
tldr: This paper introduces structured reinforcement learning techniques (SIE, IGT, HOP) to enable whole-body humanoid manipulation for transporting objects and humans, demonstrating the first autonomous bed-to-wheelchair transfer of a medical mannequin and robust human transport adaptation, all while training efficiently on a single GPU.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了结构化强化学习技术（SIE、IGT、HOP），使全身人形机器人能够搬运物体和人类，展示了首次自主完成医疗人体模型从床到轮椅的转移，并在单GPU上高效训练，实现了对不同体型和扰动的鲁棒适应。
summary_zh: 全身人形机器人操控仍受制于高维状态-动作空间、富含接触的环境以及长任务时域这三重挑战。这一“三难困境”是当前最先进的强化学习方法尚未能可靠解决的问题。我们通过三项贡献来应对这一挑战，这些贡献恰好添加了足够的结构以引导探索：用于全身操控的稀疏交互边（SIE）、用于长时域持续搬运的交互门控转运（IGT），以及能够解决碰撞与搜索复杂度瓶颈的提示物体路径（HOP）。在所有这三项设计中，策略仍可自由探索并发现自身的操控策略。该方法可从刚性物体泛化至人体搬运。作为标志性演示，我们展示了——据我们所知——首个由人形机器人在执行过程中无需任何人工干预完成的医疗人体模型从病床到轮椅的转移任务。在人体搬运领域，我们证明单一策略能够适应体重、体型及随机力扰动的显著变化，且整个训练过程仅需一块GPU在一小时内完成。我们的方法为完全由强化学习驱动的人形机器人操控提供了一条可行路径，助力实现能够帮助人类的辅助机器人。网站：https://elle-miller.github.io/into_my_arms

title: Quantization for Action, Execution for Deployment: Joint Precision and Execution Selection for World Action Models
summary: World action models guide robots by predicting the effects of actions or generating commands from observations. A model may compare hundreds of candidate futures before acting, repeatedly reading weights that must fit in device memory. Post-training quantization reduces the number of bits used to store pretrained weights, but a smaller model is not necessarily a deployable one: temporary tensors can exceed graphics processing unit (GPU) memory limits, while even small prediction errors can change the selected action. This creates two coupled challenges: identifying bit assignments that preserve task performance and determining which of them meet real execution constraints, without exhausting costly task trials. We present PTQ4WAM, a framework for choosing layer-wise bit assignments and execution routes under memory, latency and task-evaluation budgets. Calibration measurements guide candidate proposals, optionally with a language model agent. We profile full-model routes on the GPU before spending task trials on feasible assignments. Fusing group rescaling and reading visual history in place can make an otherwise infeasible assignment deployable. Across 15 workloads from four model families, the median task score is 99.2% of the corresponding 32-bit floating-point (FP32) score. On fixed GPU replays, the median speedup over FP32 is 2.36 times and the median reduction in peak allocated memory is 71.5%. The code will be released soon.
tldr: This paper introduces PTQ4WAM, a framework that selects layer-wise bit assignments and execution routes for post-training quantization of world action models, balancing memory, latency, and task performance. It achieves high task scores with significant speedup and memory reduction across multiple model families.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 PTQ4WAM，一个为世界动作模型选择逐层位宽分配和执行路径的框架，在内存、延迟和任务性能之间取得平衡。在多个模型家族上实现了高任务分数，并显著提升速度和减少内存。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型通过预测动作效果或从观测中生成指令来引导机器人。模型在行动前可能需要对数百个候选未来状态进行比较，并反复读取必须适配于设备内存的权重。训练后量化减少了存储预训练权重所需的比特数，但更小的模型并不一定意味着可以直接部署：临时张量可能超出图形处理器（GPU）内存限制，而即使是微小的预测误差也可能改变所选动作。这带来了两个相互关联的挑战：在有限的昂贵任务试验预算下，既要确定能保持任务性能的比特分配方案，又要判断其中哪些满足真实的执行约束。我们提出了PTQ4WAM，一个在内存、延迟和任务评估预算约束下选择逐层比特分配与执行路径的框架。校准测量结果指导候选方案的生成，可选地借助语言模型智能体。在将任务试验分配给可行方案之前，我们在GPU上对全模型路径进行性能剖析。通过融合组重缩放和就地读取视觉历史，原本不可行的分配方案也可以变得可部署。在来自四个模型家族的15个工作负载上，中位任务得分为对应32位浮点数（FP32）得分的99.2%。在固定GPU回放中，相对FP32的中位加速比为2.36倍，峰值分配内存的中位减少量为71.5%。代码即将发布。

title: RUIBench: What Makes a Good Robot-Use Interface?
summary: Foundation models can reason about complex physical tasks, yet translating this intelligence into reliable robot execution remains challenging. We argue that a critical, often overlooked factor is the robot-use interface (RUI), which determines how agents express and execute physical actions. To systematically study its impact, we introduce RUIBench, comprising 30 manipulation tasks across five suites spanning world knowledge, in-context learning, discovery, dynamic interaction, and contact-rich manipulation. We further develop RUIKit, a unified framework that crosses six action abstractions with two interaction forms, yielding 13 interfaces under shared perception and control. In simulation, changing only the RUI shifts a frontier agent's success rate from 45% to 81%, and that of a fine-tuned 4B model from 13% to 47%. Our analysis reveals that effective interfaces reduce unnecessary decisions while preserving essential feedback, with their benefits shaped by agent behavior and physical uncertainty. We further uncover a verification gap, where agents frequently declare success despite observable failures, revealing the need for task-level verification beyond individual actions. Together, these findings establish RUI design as a critical factor in embodied agent reliability.
tldr: This paper introduces RUIBench, a benchmark and framework (RUIKit) for systematically studying robot-use interfaces (RUIs) in manipulation, showing that interface choice can significantly impact agent success rates and revealing a need for task-level verification.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了RUIBench基准和RUIKit框架，系统研究机器人操作中的接口设计，发现接口选择对智能体成功率有显著影响，并揭示了任务级验证的必要性。
summary_zh: 基础模型能够对复杂的物理任务进行推理，然而将这些智能转化为可靠的机器人执行仍具挑战性。我们认为，一个关键且常被忽视的因素是机器人使用接口（RUI），它决定了智能体如何表达和执行物理动作。为了系统研究其影响，我们引入了RUIBench，包含五个套件中的30个操作任务，涵盖世界知识、上下文学习、发现、动态交互以及接触丰富的操作。我们进一步开发了RUIKit，这是一个统一框架，跨越六种动作抽象与两种交互形式，在共享感知和控制下产生13种接口。在仿真中，仅改变RUI即可将前沿智能体的成功率从45%提升至81%，并将微调后的4B模型成功率从13%提升至47%。我们的分析表明，有效的接口减少了不必要的决策，同时保留了关键反馈，其益处受智能体行为和物理不确定性的影响。我们还揭示了一个验证缺口，即智能体在观察到明显失败的情况下仍频繁宣称成功，这凸显了对超越个体动作的任务级验证的需求。综合来看，这些发现确立了RUI设计作为具身智能体可靠性的关键因素。

title: NoveltyGate: Novelty, Not Error, Decides Which VLA Prefix Tokens to Compute Exactly
summary: Flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) models such as $π_{0.5}$ re-encode the camera images and the instruction with a 2B-parameter backbone at every control step, and the feed-forward layers of this prefix account for most of its compute. A natural way to save this compute is to send most tokens through a low-rank MLP and compute exactly only the tokens whose approximation error is large. We find that this intuition is wrong. Even a verifier that knows every token's exact error picks the wrong tokens, producing 1.3--1.7$\times$ larger action deviation than a simple test of whether a token's input is novel, that is, whether it falls outside the subspace seen during calibration. Large errors concentrate in tokens the policy relies on little, such as the third-person camera, while the novelty test favors the wrist camera, a view the action depends on heavily. We call this the error--reliance gap. Building on it, we propose NoveltyGate, a training-free method that routes each prefix token, once per layer and before any multiplication, to either a low-rank or the original MLP. Deciding once per layer instead of once per matrix product avoids moving wide intermediate tensors and keeps every shape static, so the whole prefix runs as a single CUDA graph. On LIBERO, NoveltyGate accelerates the $π_{0.5}$ prefix by up to 1.61$\times$, stays 2.7--2.9$\times$ closer to the original policy than channel pruning and low-rank compression at equal compute, and preserves closed-loop task success.
tldr: NoveltyGate is a training-free method that accelerates the prefix of flow-matching VLA models (e.g., π0.5) by routing tokens to low-rank or exact MLP computation based on novelty rather than approximation error, achieving up to 1.61× speedup while preserving task success.
tldr_zh: NoveltyGate 是一种无需训练的方法，通过基于新颖性（而非近似误差）将前缀 token 路由到低秩或精确 MLP 计算，从而加速流匹配 VLA 模型（如 π0.5）的前缀，实现最高 1.61 倍加速并保持任务成功率。
summary_zh: 流匹配视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型（如 \( \pi_{0.5} \)）在每个控制步骤中，都会使用一个20亿参数的骨干网络对相机图像和指令进行重新编码，而该前缀部分的前馈层占据了绝大部分计算量。一种自然的节省计算的方式是，将大部分令牌通过低秩MLP处理，仅对近似误差较大的令牌进行精确计算。然而我们发现这一直觉是错误的。即使一个验证器能够精确知道每个令牌的误差，它也只会选择错误的令牌，导致动作偏差比简单地检查令牌输入是否新颖（即是否位于标定过程中所见子空间之外）大1.3至1.7倍。较大的误差集中在策略依赖较少的令牌上，例如第三人称相机，而新颖性测试则偏向于手腕相机——这一视角对动作的依赖程度很高。我们将此称为“误差—依赖差距”。基于这一发现，我们提出了NoveltyGate，一种无需训练的方法，它在每一层、每次乘法之前，将每个前缀令牌路由至低秩或原始MLP。每层决策一次而非每次矩阵乘积决策一次，从而避免移动宽中间张量，并保持所有形状静态，因此整个前缀可作为一个单一的CUDA图运行。在LIBERO上，NoveltyGate将 \( \pi_{0.5} \) 的前缀加速最高达1.61倍，在相同计算量下，与通道剪枝和低秩压缩相比，其策略一致性提高2.7至2.9倍，并保持了闭环任务成功率。

title: Real2Worlds2Real: Scaling Self-Improving Agentic Real2Sim2Real for Robot Manipulation
summary: Scaling robot manipulation learning remains challenging due to the high cost of collecting real-world interaction data. Real-to-Sim-to-Real (Real2Sim2Real) offers a promising route by enabling policy learning in simulation grounded in real-world observations, yet scaling this paradigm across diverse tasks and physical interactions remains difficult. We introduce Real2Worlds2Real, a self-improving agentic framework that integrates scalable simulation-world construction with policy development. Given limited visual observations and task descriptions, its tool-orchestration harness constructs faithful digital twins and expands them into diverse, physically executable digital cousins. The agent adaptively selects tools and revisits construction decisions, using visual and execution feedback to refine geometry and physical behavior. Building on these worlds, the agent orchestrates policy development by coordinating data generation, policy learning, and refinement based on task requirements and simulation rollout feedback. Across both stages, the agent distills validated procedures into reusable skills that guide subsequent tasks. Experiments demonstrate improved world fidelity and successful real-world policy transfer, with performance gains from increasing world diversity and interaction-data volume. Skill reuse further improves world-building efficiency and long-horizon task success.
tldr: This paper presents a self-improving agentic framework that automates real-to-sim-to-real pipeline construction and policy development for robot manipulation, achieving better world fidelity and real-world transfer through world diversity, data scaling, and skill reuse.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个自我改进的智能体框架，自动化机器人操作的real-to-sim-to-real流程构建与策略开发，通过世界多样性、数据规模化和技能复用提升世界保真度和真实转移成功率。
summary_zh: 扩展机器人操作学习仍然面临挑战，主要原因在于收集真实世界交互数据的成本高昂。真实到仿真再到真实（Real2Sim2Real）范式通过在基于真实世界观测的仿真环境中进行策略学习，提供了一条有前景的路径，但将该范式扩展至多样化任务和物理交互仍具难度。我们提出了Real2Worlds2Real——一个自我改进的智能体框架，将可扩展的仿真世界构建与策略开发相结合。在有限的视觉观测和任务描述条件下，其工具编排机制能够构建高保真数字孪生体，并将其扩展为多样化的、可物理执行的数字近亲体。该智能体自适应地选择工具并重新审视构建决策，利用视觉和执行反馈来优化几何结构与物理行为。在这些世界的基础上，智能体通过协调数据生成、策略学习和根据任务要求及仿真 rollout 反馈进行的细化，来编排策略开发过程。在两个阶段中，智能体将验证有效的流程提炼为可复用的技能，用于指导后续任务。实验结果表明，世界保真度有所提升，并且策略向真实世界的迁移取得了成功，性能增益来源于世界多样性和交互数据量的增加。技能复用进一步提升了世界构建效率和长时程任务成功率。

title: ReWeave: Emergent Physical Task Topologies for Embodied Harness Optimization and Cross-Task Meta-Distillation
summary: Long-horizon embodied tasks involve physical dependencies that may only become clear through interaction. As task understanding deepens, past trials can reveal new information for adaptation and transfer. However, coarse progress feedback cannot identify which physical preconditions held, leaving search unguided, while task-specific optimization easily overfits to individual scenes, making cross-task transfer brittle. We introduce ReWeave, a framework that jointly optimizes an embodied agent harness and an emergent physical task topology from interaction without updating policy weights. Keeping execution policies and perception frozen, ReWeave co-optimizes coupled context, workflows, and control loops. As new evidence revises the topology, ReWeave reprojects past trials onto the updated task understanding, exposing retained progress, regressions, and bottlenecks that guide parent selection and search width. Across tasks, matching verified local mechanisms to unmet preconditions consolidates 72 specialist units into 44 reusable groups ($0.34\times$ full concatenation) within a compact shared harness capable of continual learning. ReWeave improves held-out success from 89.00% to 98.75% on LIBERO-PRO and from 25.50% to 58.25% on RoboDojo, while uncovering retained progress in 89% of 159 failed RoboDojo development trials and translating stronger offline reasoning into higher online performance. On eight unseen LIBERO-PRO tasks, the shared harness reaches 51.3% success versus 41.3% for direct distillation, rising to 75.0% after continual learning.
tldr: ReWeave introduces a framework that jointly optimizes an agent harness and an emergent physical task topology from interaction without updating policy weights, improving generalization across embodied tasks.
tldr_zh: ReWeave 提出一个框架，在不更新策略权重的情况下，通过交互联合优化智能体绑定和涌现的物理任务拓扑，提升了跨具身任务的泛化能力。
summary_zh: 长期具身任务涉及物理依赖关系，这些依赖关系往往只有通过交互才能显现。随着对任务理解的深入，过往的尝试可能揭示出新的信息，从而支持适应与迁移。然而，粗粒度进度反馈无法识别哪些物理前置条件已成立，导致搜索缺乏引导；同时，任务特定的优化容易对单个场景过度拟合，使跨任务迁移变得脆弱。我们提出ReWeave框架，该框架在不更新策略权重的前提下，通过交互联合优化一个具身智能体控制器和一组涌现性的物理任务拓扑结构。在执行策略与感知保持冻结的情况下，ReWeave协同优化耦合的上下文、工作流和控制回路。随着新证据修正拓扑结构，ReWeave将过往尝试重新投影至更新后的任务理解之上，暴露出保留的进展、回退和瓶颈，从而指导父代选择和搜索宽度。在跨任务中，将已验证的局部机制与未满足的前置条件进行匹配，将72个专家单元整合为44个可复用组（仅为完整拼接规模的0.34倍），并封装于一个紧凑且支持持续学习的共享控制器中。ReWeave在LIBERO-PRO上的保留测试成功率从89.00%提升至98.75%，在RoboDojo上从25.50%提升至58.25%；同时，在159次失败的RoboDojo开发尝试中，有89%的尝试揭示出保留的进展，并将更强的离线推理转化为更高的在线表现。在8个未见过的LIBERO-PRO任务中，共享控制器达到51.3%的成功率，优于直接蒸馏方法的41.3%，并在持续学习后提升至75.0%。

title: Generalizing Agentic Robotics via Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
summary: Building general-purpose robots is a central goal in robotics. Agentic robotics pursues this goal with planners that control robots through tool calls. However, existing methods either rely on proprietary models accessed through APIs, which incur high costs and latency, or post-train a planner with reinforcement learning (RL) in a single domain, requiring a separate specialist for each domain with incompatible tools. In large language model (LLM) post-training, multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) has been used to consolidate domain specialists into a single generalist. Yet whether MOPD can build a generalist planner for agentic robotics, how well it performs, and how it compares with other consolidation methods remain unexplored. In this paper, we systematically study these questions: we introduce Robo-MOPD, which trains a single student on closed-loop rollouts in simulation under token-level supervision from matching frozen specialists, and compare it with weight merging, off-policy specialist supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and multi-domain online RL. Experiments on LIBERO-PRO and RoboCasa365 show that a single 9B Robo-MOPD planner reaches 72.9% and 44.8% success (58.9% average), surpassing all consolidated baselines in average success and both 9B specialists on their respective benchmarks. Robo-MOPD excels on long-horizon tasks, outperforming multi-domain online RL by 13.0 percentage points on LIBERO-10.
tldr: Robo-MOPD applies multi-teacher on-policy distillation to train a single 9B generalist robot planner from domain-specific specialists, outperforming consolidated baselines on LIBERO-PRO and RoboCasa365 benchmarks.
tldr_zh: Robo-MOPD 采用多教师在线策略蒸馏，从领域专家训练出单一 9B 通用机器人规划器，在 LIBERO-PRO 和 RoboCasa365 基准上优于其他整合基线。
summary_zh: 构建通用型机器人是机器人学的核心目标之一。智能体机器人技术通过规划器调用工具来控制机器人，从而追求这一目标。然而，现有方法要么依赖通过API访问的专有模型，带来高昂的成本和延迟，要么在单一领域内使用强化学习（RL）对规划器进行后训练，导致每个领域需要单独的专业模型，且工具不兼容。在大语言模型（LLM）的后训练中，多教师同策略蒸馏（MOPD）已被用于将多个领域专家合并为单一通用模型。然而，MOPD能否用于构建智能体机器人领域的通用规划器、其性能表现如何，以及与其他合并方法的对比效果，尚未得到充分探索。本文系统性地研究了这些问题：我们提出了Robo-MOPD，该方法在模拟环境中通过闭环轨迹回放，在匹配的冻结专家的token级监督下训练单一学生模型，并将其与权重合并、离策略专家监督微调（SFT）以及多领域在线RL进行了比较。在LIBERO-PRO和RoboCasa365上的实验表明，一个9B参数的Robo-MOPD规划器分别达到了72.9%和44.8%的成功率（平均58.9%），在平均成功率上超越了所有合并基线，并且在各自的基准测试上也优于两个9B专家模型。Robo-MOPD在长周期任务上表现出色，在LIBERO-10上比多领域在线RL高出13.0个百分点。

title: WorldLeague: Benchmarking Physical Agency
summary: AI systems can now operate Blender, follow instructions in complex video games, and manipulate objects with robot arms. What range of physical goals can today's AI systems achieve autonomously? Answering this question requires testing systems on tasks that demand different combinations of perception, memory, planning, and action. We introduce \textbf{WorldLeague}, a benchmark that compares AI systems on a common set of \textbf{60 simulated robot tasks} by measuring progress toward each task's physical goal from the robot's trajectory. Robots explore scenes to gather evidence in \textbf{WorldSeek}, rearrange objects in \textbf{WorldShape}, and adapt to changes in \textbf{WorldShift}. Tying these goals to a single control interface limits which AI systems can be compared. In WorldLeague, vision-language models (VLMs) choose targets and motions, while vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs) use their native controls. For each of six capability dimensions, we measure how much progress a system makes toward its goals (Interactive Score) and how often it achieves them (physical success rate). Together, these measures form the system's \emph{Physical Agency Profile}. Among 13 representative AI systems, Claude Fable 5.2 achieves 13 of the 60 goals and earns the highest mean Interactive Score (28.58/100). Fable leads in four dimensions, while GPT-6.1-Sol and GPT-6-Astra tie for first on rule-following tasks. Even when VLMs answer every final question correctly, they receive an Interactive Score of zero in 71.8\% of those episodes. WorldLeague gives Embodied AI, Physical AI, and Agentic AI a shared basis for comparing what AI systems achieve autonomously, from partial progress toward a physical goal to full goal completion. Project Webpage: https://xyangzhou.github.io/WorldLeague
tldr: WorldLeague is a benchmark for evaluating AI systems on 60 simulated robot tasks across three scenarios, comparing VLMs, VLAs, and world-action models via an Interactive Score and physical success rate to form a Physical Agency Profile.
tldr_zh: WorldLeague是一个基准，通过60个模拟机器人任务，从轨迹进展评估AI系统的物理代理能力，涵盖VLM、VLA和世界动作模型，并提供互动分数和物理成功率。
summary_zh: 人工智能系统如今已能够操作Blender、在复杂电子游戏中遵循指令，并操控机械臂操作物体。当今的人工智能系统能够自主实现哪些物理目标？回答这一问题需要在要求感知、记忆、规划与行动不同组合的任务上对系统进行测试。我们提出\textbf{WorldLeague}，一个通过在\textbf{60项模拟机器人任务}上测量系统从机器人轨迹向各自物理目标推进的程度，来比较AI系统的基准。机器人在\textbf{WorldSeek}中探索场景以收集证据，在\textbf{WorldShape}中重新排列物体，并在\textbf{WorldShift}中适应环境变化。将这些目标绑定到单一控制接口会限制可比较的AI系统范围。在WorldLeague中，视觉语言模型（VLM）选择目标和动作，而视觉语言行动模型（VLA）和世界行动模型（WAM）则使用其原生控制方式。针对六个能力维度，我们分别测量系统向其目标推进的程度（交互得分）以及达成目标的频率（物理成功率）。这些指标共同构成系统的\textit{物理能动性画像}。在13个具有代表性的AI系统中，Claude Fable 5.2实现了60个目标中的13个，并获得最高平均交互得分（28.58/100）。Fable在四个维度上领先，而GPT-6.1-Sol和GPT-6-Astra在规则遵循任务上并列第一。即使VLM在每个最终问题上都回答正确，在71.8\%的此类回合中其交互得分仍为零。WorldLeague为具身AI、物理AI和智能体AI提供了共同的比较基础，用以衡量AI系统从向物理目标的部分推进到完全实现目标的自主成就。项目网页：https://xyangzhou.github.io/WorldLeague

title: Foresight Forcing: Learning Spatial Foresight for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Robotic manipulation policies can improve action prediction by anticipating how objects move and how their spatial relationships change. World Action Models (WAMs) learn to predict future visual observations, but their training objectives typically leave the underlying 3D geometric transitions implicit. To alleviate this problem, we introduce Foresight Forcing ($\mathcal{F}^{2}$), a WAM that learns a spatial transition representation from changes in a pretrained 3D feature space. During training, a frozen 3D foundation model extracts patch-wise feature differences from aligned current and future observations that provide dense supervision for geometry-aware feature transitions. We distill these targets into spatial transition queries, which are progressively refined from the current observation, language instruction, and proprioceptive state, and use them alongside current visual features to generate actions. At deployment, the policy predicts the queries without future observations or the 3D teacher. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin2.0 demonstrate strong manipulation performance and improved robustness, including 95.01% average success on RoboTwin2.0 Full. On six real-world manipulation tasks, $\mathcal{F}^{2}$ achieves a mean task score of 85.8%.
tldr: This paper proposes Foresight Forcing, a World Action Model for robotic manipulation that learns spatial transition representations from a frozen 3D foundation model and distills them into queries for action generation, achieving strong performance on benchmarks and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了预见性强制（Foresight Forcing），一种用于机器人操作的World Action Model，它从冻结的3D基础模型中学习空间过渡表示，并将其蒸馏为用于动作生成的查询，在基准测试和真实世界任务中取得了强劲表现。
summary_zh: 机器人操控策略可以通过预测物体的运动方式及其空间关系的变化来提升动作预测能力。世界动作模型（WAMs）学习预测未来的视觉观测，但其训练目标通常隐含底层三维几何变换，未对其进行显式建模。为解决这一问题，我们引入了前瞻强制（$\mathcal{F}^{2}$），一种从预训练三维特征空间的变化中学习空间过渡表示的WAM。在训练过程中，一个冻结的三维基础模型从对齐的当前与未来观测中提取分块级特征差异，为几何感知的特征过渡提供密集监督。我们将这些目标蒸馏到空间过渡查询中，该查询从当前观测、语言指令及本体感觉状态中逐步细化生成，并与当前视觉特征一起用于生成动作。在部署时，策略仅预测查询，无需未来观测或三维教师模型。在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin2.0上的实验展示了强大的操控性能和增强的鲁棒性，包括在RoboTwin2.0完整数据集上达到95.01%的平均成功率。在六个真实世界操控任务中，$\mathcal{F}^{2}$取得了85.8%的平均任务得分。

title: SayDo: Benchmarking the Safety of Frontier Models from Chat to Closed-Loop Robot Control
summary: Frontier vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as high-level robot controllers, yet their safety is evaluated almost entirely in text. We introduce SayDo, a benchmark that assesses the propensity of frontier models to cause harm in embodied contexts. SayDo comprises eleven laboratory and household tasks that pair a benign instruction with a hazard latent in the scene. Tasks are implemented in six settings along an embodiment gradient, from chat questions about an imagined robot to closed-loop control of a simulated robot arm. Benign controls, safe-alternative variants and scripted operator pushback complement each task. Across six open- and closed-weight VLMs and 11,480 episodes, hazardous-action rates rise from 14% in chat to 47% in the simulator, and from 2% to 80% for the most affected model. The increase is largely driven by open-weight models. We find that models flag hazards before acting in 73% of unsafe episodes and give way to pushback about twice as often when controlling robots as in chat. The safest models also show signs of overcaution on benign controls. Safety evaluations run in text therefore do not predict the safety behavior of the same models when used as robot controllers.
tldr: This paper introduces SayDo, a benchmark evaluating frontier vision-language models' safety in embodied contexts from chat to closed-loop robot control, finding that hazardous-action rates significantly increase in simulation and that text-based safety evaluation does not predict robot control safety.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了SayDo基准，用于评估前沿视觉语言模型在从聊天到闭环机器人控制的具体环境中的安全性，发现仿真中的危险行为率显著增加，基于文本的安全评估无法预测机器人控制时的安全性。
summary_zh: 前沿视觉-语言模型（VLMs）正日益被用作高层机器人控制器，然而对其安全性的评估几乎完全在文本层面进行。我们引入了SayDo，一个评估前沿模型在具身情境中引发伤害倾向的基准测试。SayDo包含十一个实验室和家庭任务，每个任务将良性指令与场景中潜藏的危险配对。任务在六个沿具身化梯度设置的场景中实施，从关于想象机器人的聊天问题到模拟机器人臂的闭环控制。良性对照、安全替代变体和脚本化操作员干预为每个任务提供补充。在六个开放权重和封闭权重的VLM及11，480个回合中，危险行为率从聊天情境中的14%上升至模拟器中的47%，受影响最严重的模型从2%上升至80%。这一增长主要由开放权重模型驱动。我们发现，模型在73%的不安全回合中会在行动前标记危险，并且在控制机器人时对干预的让步频率约为聊天情境中的两倍。最安全的模型在良性对照中也表现出过度谨慎的迹象。因此，在文本中运行的安全评估并不能预测同一模型作为机器人控制器时的安全行为。

title: DexLatentWorld: 3D Cross-Embodiment Latent Action World Models for Zero-Shot Robotic Manipulation
summary: World models facilitate planning and control in robotic manipulation by enabling agents to anticipate the consequences of their actions. However, they typically rely on action-labelled interaction data that is costly to acquire and difficult to scale. These models are also often tied to the specific embodiment they were trained on, limiting transferability to previously unseen robot morphologies. We introduce a 3D latent-action world model that learns continuous action representations directly from point-cloud observations of retargeted human manipulation demonstrations. A contrastive objective is used to encourage consistent representations of motion across embodiments. The resulting unified latent action space serves directly as the search space for model-predictive control, where sampled latent actions condition particle-based future predictions. Executable robot commands are then recovered from the predicted geometric motion without requiring an embodiment-specific action decoder. Through extensive evaluations, we demonstrate that the learned latent actions exhibit controllable and compositional motion, transfer to unseen robot embodiments, and support zero-shot manipulation with unseen gripper geometries. Following task-agnostic adaptation, our model achieves 90%, 92%, and 60% success on reaching, grasping, and placing, respectively, compared with DexWM's reported 72%, 58%, and 28%. Finally, we demonstrate zero-shot real-world manipulation with an unseen dexterous hand, achieving an 86% success rate across 50 trials on five diverse tasks involving pushing, grasping, and lifting everyday objects. These results highlight the potential of geometry-grounded latent actions as a unified, transferable interface for world-model-based robotic manipulation. Project materials, including demonstration videos and source code, are available at https://vinaymohan0409.github.io/DexLatentWorld/.
tldr: This paper introduces a 3D latent-action world model that learns continuous action representations from point-cloud observations of human demonstrations, enabling zero-shot transfer to unseen robot embodiments and real-world dexterous manipulation via model-predictive control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于3D点云观测的潜动作世界模型，从人类示教中学习连续动作表示，实现零样本迁移到未见过机械臂形态并用于真实世界灵巧操作。
summary_zh: 世界模型通过使智能体能够预测其行为后果，为机器人操作中的规划与控制提供便利。然而，这类模型通常依赖带有动作标签的交互数据，而此类数据获取成本高昂且难以规模化。此外，这些模型往往与其训练时所依托的特定机器人本体绑定，限制了其向未见过的机器人形态迁移的能力。我们提出了一种三维潜在动作世界模型，该模型直接从重定向后的人类操作演示的点云观测中学习连续动作表示。通过对比学习目标，我们鼓励跨本体运动表示的一致性。由此产生的统一潜在动作空间可直接作为模型预测控制的搜索空间，其中采样的潜在动作用于条件化基于粒子的未来预测。可执行的机器人指令随后从预测的几何运动中被恢复，无需依赖特定本体的动作解码器。通过大量评估，我们证明了所学习的潜在动作具有可控性和组合性运动能力，能够迁移至未见过的机器人本体，并支持对未见过的夹爪几何结构进行零样本操作。在与任务无关的适配之后，我们的模型在到达、抓取和放置任务上分别达到了90%、92%和60%的成功率，而DexWM的相应报告结果为72%、58%和28%。最后，我们展示了使用未见过的灵巧手进行零样本真实世界操作的能力，在涉及推、抓和举日常物体的五类不同任务的50次试验中实现了86%的成功率。这些结果凸显了几何锚定的潜在动作作为基于世界模型的机器人操作中统一、可迁移接口的潜力。项目材料，包括演示视频和源代码，可在https://vinaymohan0409.github.io/DexLatentWorld/获取。

title: GlanceNav: Efficient Vision-and-Language Navigation with Streaming Memory and Counterfactual Rewind
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have become strong policies for vision-and-language navigation (VLN). However, most of them encode a sample of past frames again at every decision and are trained on isolated decisions, so computation is redundant and the usable history is short. They also learn from their own mistakes through outcome rewards that give one scalar to a whole episode. We ask whether a navigator can encode each frame only once, at a constant cost per step, and still remember what matters and learn efficiently from its mistakes. We present GlanceNav, a streaming navigator built on a hybrid MLLM. Its Gated DeltaNet layers carry a recurrent state through the whole episode, while its attention layers keep a short window of recent observations and a small bank of keyframes, selected by how much each frame changes the recurrent state. This constant-size memory keeps the cost per step fixed and allows training on whole episodes with the same memory as at inference. Because the entire memory can also be copied in constant time, we further propose Counterfactual Rewind (CoRe), a reinforcement learning stage that rewinds a drifting rollout to its closest approach to the goal, lets an expert correct a few actions, and credits decisions by the resulting change in outcome. Trained only on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE training splits, with 1,000 instructions for reinforcement learning, a 4B GlanceNav reaches success rates of 71.9% and 73.6% on R2R-CE and RxR-CE val-unseen. On R2R-CE, it outperforms the strongest previous single-RGB method trained without external data by 9.1 points, while running at 104 ms per step.
tldr: GlanceNav introduces a streaming memory and reinforcement learning method for vision-and-language navigation, encoding each frame once and using counterfactual rewind to improve efficiency and performance in R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks.
tldr_zh: GlanceNav 提出了一种用于视觉语言导航的流式记忆和强化学习方法，为每帧仅编码一次，并利用反事实回放机制提高效率和性能，在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE 基准上取得了显著成果。
summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）已成为视觉与语言导航（VLN）中的强有力策略模型。然而，其中大多数模型在每个决策节点都会重新编码过去帧的样本，并且是在孤立决策上进行训练的，因此计算存在冗余，可用的历史信息也较短。此外，它们通过结果奖励从自身错误中学习，而这种奖励仅在整个回合中给出一个标量值。我们探究一个问题：导航器是否能够仅对每一帧编码一次，以每步恒定成本运行，同时仍能记住关键信息，并高效地从错误中学习？为此，我们提出了GlanceNav，一种基于混合多模态大语言模型的流式导航器。其门控DeltaNet层在整个回合中携带循环状态，而注意力层则保留近期观测的短窗口以及一个小型关键帧库，关键帧的选择依据是每帧对循环状态的改变程度。这种恒定大小的记忆机制使得每步成本保持固定，并允许在完整回合上进行训练，且训练记忆与推理时一致。由于整个记忆还可以在常数时间内复制，我们进一步提出了反事实回退（Counterfactual Rewind, CoRe），这是一种强化学习阶段，将漂移的轨迹回退到其最接近目标的位置，让专家纠正少量动作，并根据由此产生的结果变化来评判决策的优劣。仅使用R2R-CE和RxR-CE的训练划分，并通过1,000条指令进行强化学习，一个4B参数规模的GlanceNav在R2R-CE和RxR-CE的val-unseen上分别达到了71.9%和73.6%的成功率。在R2R-CE上，它比此前不使用外部数据的最强单RGB方法高出9.1个百分点，同时每步运行时间仅为104毫秒。

title: HIVE-Bench: Evaluating Patch-Level Visual Representations for Egocentric Robot Manipulation
summary: Pretrained vision is a common start for robot learning, but most comparisons still score one pooled vector from a third-person image. Bimanual policies instead read dense patch tokens from cameras on the robot. We introduce HIVE-Bench: one shared flow-matching policy reads 20 encoders from seven families on 24 egocentric bimanual tasks, across adaptation, task sharing, and sweeps of data, model size, and layer. Keeping the patches matters. Averaging each view to one token removes most of the success, adaptation helps every pair we test, and one shared policy keeps most of the success of separate policies at a fraction of the updates. The same tokens are then scored with statistics, state and object readouts, published vision scores, and an inverse-dynamics readout. That readout of the commanded motion is one of the strongest measurements available before a policy is trained. Recognition, depth, and correspondence do not transfer reliably. Fine-tuning can improve the action readout even when other measurements move the other way, and no statistic is stable enough to replace a rollout before any deployment.
tldr: HIVE-Bench evaluates 20 visual encoders for egocentric bimanual robot manipulation by feeding patch-level tokens to a single flow-matching policy, showing that preserving patch structure and adaptation are critical for success and introducing an inverse-dynamics readout as a strong pre-training metric.
tldr_zh: HIVE-Bench 通过将补丁级视觉令牌输入统一的流匹配策略，评估了 20 个视觉编码器在 24 项自我中心双臂操作任务上的表现，证明保留补丁结构和适应训练至关重要，并提出逆动力学读取作为训练前评估的有效指标。
summary_zh: 预训练视觉是机器人学习的常见起点，但大多数比较仍仅从第三人称图像中提取单一池化向量进行评估。相比之下，双臂策略需要读取机器人摄像头上密集的补丁标记。我们提出了HIVE-Bench：一个共享的流匹配策略，在24个以自我为中心的双臂任务上，读取来自七个家族的20个编码器，涵盖适应、任务共享以及数据量、模型规模和层数的扫描变化。保留补丁细节至关重要。将每个视图平均为单一标记会丧失大部分成功率；适应机制对我们测试的每一对组合都有帮助；而单一共享策略能以极少的更新次数保留独立策略的大部分成功率。随后，同一组标记通过统计量、状态与物体读取、已发表的视觉评分以及逆动力学读取进行评分。其中，对指令运动的逆动力学读取是在策略训练前可获得的最强度量之一。识别、深度和对应关系不能可靠地迁移。微调可以改善动作读取，即使其他度量指标向相反方向变化，且在部署前，没有任何统计量足够稳定，能够替代实际 rollout 评估。

title: Coordinating Perception and Planning for Test-Time Adaptation in End-to-End Driving under Distribution Shifts
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving has achieved significant milestones, yet its reliance on the i.i.d. assumption renders it vulnerable to real-world distribution shifts. While Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) offers a promising paradigm for on-the-fly enhancement, its application to driving is hindered by two barriers: (i) multi-task adaptation dependency, where updates to upstream perception also affect downstream planning, while perception confidence alone does not directly assess these downstream effects; and (ii) continuous adaptation instability, where recursive online updates over long horizons cause compounding parameter drift. To address these challenges, we propose P2-TTA, a plug-and-play TTA framework for the continual adaptation of end-to-end driving models. P2-TTA coordinates adaptation through a joint objective combining perception entropy minimization with a retrospective temporal planning consistency objective derived from observed ego motion. To stabilize online updates, we use an EMA teacher as a moving parameter reference and reject candidate updates that increase historical planning loss. Extensive experiments across multiple models demonstrate that, by updating an average of 0.11 per mille of parameters with an average adaptation time of 19.9 ms on different backbones, P2-TTA achieves average recovery rates of 36.4%, 30.0%, and 9.3% for L2, collision rate, and PDMS, respectively, under severe distribution shifts. Under a shared perception-planning objective, P2-TTA achieves the highest L2 and collision recovery among the compared TTA baselines on UniAD.
tldr: This paper introduces P2-TTA, a plug-and-play test-time adaptation framework for end-to-end autonomous driving that coordinates perception and planning updates under distribution shifts, using a joint perception entropy and retrospective temporal planning consistency objective with EMA stabilization, achieving notable recovery rates across driving metrics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出P2-TTA，一种即插即用的测试时自适应框架，用于端到端自动驾驶在分布偏移下的感知与规划协同更新，通过联合感知熵和回顾性时间规划一致性目标及EMA稳定化，在多个驾驶指标上取得了显著恢复率。
summary_zh: 端到端自动驾驶已取得显著进展，但其对独立同分布假设的依赖使其在真实世界的分布偏移面前较为脆弱。尽管测试时适应（TTA）为实时增强提供了一种有前景的范式，但其在自动驾驶中的应用仍面临两大障碍：（i）多任务适应依赖性——对上游感知模块的更新也会影响下游规划模块，而仅靠感知置信度无法直接评估这些下游影响；（ii）连续适应不稳定性——长时间范围内的递归在线更新会导致参数漂移的累积。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了P2-TTA，一种即插即用的TTA框架，用于端到端驾驶模型的持续适应。P2-TTA通过联合目标协调适应过程，该目标结合了感知熵最小化与基于观测自车运动导出的回溯式时间规划一致性目标。为稳定在线更新，我们采用EMA教师网络作为移动参数参考，并拒绝那些会增大历史规划损失的候选更新。跨多个模型的大量实验表明，通过在不同骨干网络上平均更新0.11‱的参数，平均适应时间为19.9 ms，P2-TTA在严重分布偏移下对L2、碰撞率和PDMS分别实现了36.4%、30.0%和9.3%的平均恢复率。在共享感知-规划目标下，P2-TTA在UniAD上相较于所对比的TTA基线取得了最高的L2和碰撞恢复率。

title: LLM-Guided Compositional Continual Learning for Robot Manipulation with Gated Low-Rank Experts
summary: General-purpose manipulation robots must acquire new skills over time without forgetting prior ones or retraining from scratch. We present a continual learning framework that represents each skill as a dedicated expert sub- network in a Progressive Neural Network (PNN). New tasks reuse prior knowledge through low-rank adaptation (LoRA) modules on lateral connections controlled by learnable per-parent gates, enabling explicit attenuation of individual transfer paths while reducing the parameter cost of dense PNN laterals. For long-horizon deployment, a frozen local large language model decomposes natural-language instructions into sub-tasks, routes them to suitable experts, and requests a new expert only when the library is insufficient. Using a shared task-space action interface, we evaluate the framework on twelve MetaWorld tasks and in a Sawyer-to-Panda-to-UR5e cross-embodiment transfer experiment, showing improved task success relative to learning from scratch when demonstrations are limited. Real-robot manipulation experiments further demonstrate that the proposed framework supports compositional execution and expert orchestration.
tldr: This paper proposes a continual learning framework for robot manipulation that combines progressive neural networks with gated low-rank adaptation and a frozen LLM for task decomposition and expert routing, demonstrating improved skill composition and cross-embodiment transfer.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于机器人操作的持续学习框架，结合渐进式神经网络与门控低秩适应模块，并利用冻结的大语言模型进行任务分解和专家路由，在技能组合和跨实体迁移上取得了改进。
summary_zh: 通用型操作机器人必须在不遗忘先前技能或从头重新训练的情况下，随时间持续获取新技能。我们提出了一种持续学习框架，将每项技能表示为渐进式神经网络（PNN）中的一个专用专家子网络。新任务通过低秩适配（LoRA）模块复用先前知识，这些模块位于由可学习的逐父门控控制的横向连接上，从而能够显式衰减单个迁移路径，同时降低密集PNN横向连接的参数成本。对于长时程部署，一个冻结的本地大语言模型将自然语言指令分解为子任务，将其路由至合适的专家，并仅在专家库不足时请求创建新专家。利用共享任务空间动作接口，我们在十二个MetaWorld任务以及一项Sawyer-to-Panda-to-UR5e跨本体迁移实验中评估了该框架，结果表明在演示样本有限的情况下，相比从头学习，任务成功率有所提升。真实机器人操作实验进一步证明了所提框架支持组合式执行与专家编排。

title: Active Observation for Robust Visual Servoing in Robotic Manipulation
summary: Robust visual servoing during robotic grasping remains challenging, as approach-phase occlusion frequently disrupts closed-loop control. To address this, we present an active observation framework in which one arm of an existing dual-arm platform carries an RGB-D camera as an active observer while the other executes grasping. The observer repositions to maintain or recover a shared target-gripper view within the feasible shared-view workspace. Occlusion during the final approach is particularly acute: fixed eye-to-hand lacks an active recovery mechanism once the target is hidden, while eye-in-hand can suffer from self-occlusion and sensitivity to hand-eye calibration. The observer first uses an active two-phase viewpoint strategy to align high-precision RGB-D axes with task-relevant error components. If visibility later degrades, an occlusion-triggered exploration module pauses the worker arm and scores candidate viewpoints by observation quality to recover a shared target-gripper view. Because both objects are detected in a single RGB-D image, the resulting Relative Servo Error avoids differencing two independently transformed target and gripper estimates. We evaluate the system on a dual 6-DoF Piper platform using an open-vocabulary detector with text prompts, without task-specific fine-tuning or demonstrations. Across 50 randomized trials per object, the system achieves 94% grasp success versus 76% for a reactive viewpoint baseline and 64% for a fixed camera. On triggered severe-occlusion trials, recovery takes $1.8 \pm 0.6$ s on average.
tldr: This paper presents an active observation framework for robust visual servoing in robotic grasping, where one arm of a dual-arm platform actively moves an RGB-D camera to maintain a shared target-gripper view and recover from occlusions, improving grasp success rates over baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种用于机器人抓取中鲁棒视觉伺服主动观测框架，通过双臂平台上一支手臂主动移动RGB-D相机以维持共享目标-夹爪视野并从遮挡中恢复，提高了抓取成功率。
summary_zh: 摘要：机器人抓取过程中的鲁棒视觉伺服仍具挑战性，因为接近阶段的遮挡常会中断闭环控制。为解决该问题，我们提出一种主动观测框架，其中现有双臂平台的一条机械臂搭载RGB-D相机作为主动观测器，另一条机械臂执行抓取操作。观测器在可行的共享视角工作空间内重新定位，以维持或恢复目标-夹爪的共享视图。最终接近阶段的遮挡尤为严重：固定式眼在手外（eye-to-hand）系统一旦目标被遮挡便缺乏主动恢复机制，而眼在手上（eye-in-hand）系统则可能遭受自遮挡及手眼标定敏感性问题。观测器首先采用主动两阶段视角策略，将高精度RGB-D轴与任务相关的误差分量对齐。若后续可见性下降，则遮挡触发的探索模块暂停工作臂，并通过观测质量对候选视角评分，以恢复目标-夹爪的共享视图。由于两个物体均在同一张RGB-D图像中检测，所得的相对伺服误差避免了分别对目标与夹爪估计进行独立变换后再作差。我们在双6自由度Piper平台上使用开放词汇检测器及文本提示对所提系统进行评估，无需任务特定微调或演示。在每种物体各50次随机试验中，系统实现了94%的抓取成功率，而反应式视角基线为76%，固定相机为64%。在触发严重遮挡的试验中，平均恢复时间为$1.8 \pm 0.6$秒。

title: SWEEP-Bench: Do Embodied Policies Act on the Speed They See?
summary: Robot policies must adapt to the speed of moving objects, yet existing benchmarks rarely measure this ability across diverse tasks and speeds. We introduce SWEEP-Bench, a simulation benchmark with 80 conveyor-belt manipulation tasks spanning 16 skill categories, each evaluated at 13 belt speeds (0.10-0.40 m/s). Objects are transported through physical contact with a visibly moving belt. Each task has a static counterpart, and each evaluation episode uses the same randomized scene at all 13 speeds. We fine-tune eight vision-language-action and world-action models on demonstrations spanning the full speed range, comparing observations from the current frame alone with those including two past frames. For six models, the success rate peaks at intermediate speeds, and their failures indicate that they tend to produce actions suited to the average demonstration speed rather than to the actual one. Past frames raise the success rate by 10-40 percentage points for three models, and linear probes show that the belt speed is also most linearly decodable from these three. Adding ground-truth speed input to four of the models improves all of them, and a speed estimated from the images keeps most of this gain. These results show that SWEEP-Bench exposes speed-dependent failures and suggest that past frames help only policies from which the speed is most decodable, such as those pretrained on multiple frames. Project page: https://damin3927.github.io/SWEEP-Bench
tldr: This paper introduces SWEEP-Bench, a simulation benchmark with 80 conveyor-belt manipulation tasks across 16 skills and 13 speeds, and uses it to evaluate eight VLA and world-action models, finding that policies often fail to adapt to object speed unless trained with past frames or ground-truth speed.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了SWEEP-Bench，一个包含80个传送带操作任务（16种技能×13种速度）的仿真基准，并评估了八种VLA和世界动作模型，发现策略常常不能适应物体速度，除非使用过去帧或真实速度输入。
summary_zh: 机器人策略必须适应移动物体的速度，然而现有基准测试很少在不同任务和速度下衡量这一能力。我们引入了SWEEP-Bench，一个包含80个传送带操作任务的仿真基准，涵盖16个技能类别，每个任务在13种传送带速度（0.10-0.40 m/s）下进行评估。物体通过与可见移动传送带的物理接触被传送。每个任务都有一个对应的静态版本，并且每次评估回合在所有13种速度下使用相同的随机化场景。我们在覆盖整个速度范围的演示上微调了八个视觉-语言-动作模型和世界动作模型，比较了仅使用当前帧观测与包含两个历史帧的观测。对于六个模型，成功率在中间速度时达到峰值，其失败模式表明它们倾向于产生适合平均演示速度的动作，而非实际速度。历史帧将三个模型的成功率提高了10-40个百分点，线性探针显示传送带速度也最能从这三个模型中被线性解码。将地面真实速度输入加入四个模型后，所有模型均有所改进，而从图像估计的速度保留了大部分提升效果。这些结果表明SWEEP-Bench揭示了速度依赖的失败模式，并提示历史帧仅对速度最可解码的策略（如那些在多个帧上预训练的模型）有帮助。项目页面：https://damin3927.github.io/SWEEP-Bench

title: GeoMerge-OPD: Balanced Skill Integration in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models excel at individual robotic skills, yet integrating heterogeneous skills into a single policy remains a key challenge for general-purpose robotic control, especially in whole-body tasks with differing manipulation and locomotion requirements. Common multi-skill integration strategies, such as joint fine-tuning and parameter merging, can induce unintended actions during closed-loop execution, severely degrading individual skills. Task-conditioned analysis of expert updates reveals response energy concentrated in a few dominant directions and opposing expert responses along high-energy directions within a shared, task-relevant response subspace. This structure co-occurs with unintended action shifts after merging. We propose GeoMerge-OPD, combining response-space regularization, parameter merging, and on-policy distillation. During independent expert fine-tuning, G-isometry constrains update-response gains within task-activation subspaces; the expert parameters are then statically merged into a student with preliminary multitask capabilities. Fine-tuned task experts serve as teachers, providing velocity-field supervision at the environment observations and intermediate action-flow states visited by the student to calibrate residual behavioral deviations. Experiments with two VLA backbones show strong, balanced humanoid skill integration on SIMPLE and consistent performance on LIBERO and LIBERO-PRO, outperforming joint fine-tuning and multitask reinforcement-learning baselines while maintaining robustness under perturbations.
tldr: GeoMerge-OPD introduces a method for integrating heterogeneous robotic skills into a single VLA policy by combining response-space regularization, static parameter merging, and on-policy distillation, achieving balanced humanoid and manipulation performance.
tldr_zh: GeoMerge-OPD 通过结合响应空间正则化、静态参数合并和在线策略蒸馏，将异构机器人技能集成到单一 VLA 策略中，在类人形和操作任务上实现均衡性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在单项机器人技能上表现出色，然而将异构技能整合到单一策略中仍是通用机器人控制面临的关键挑战，尤其是在操控与运动需求各异的人形全身任务中。常见的多技能整合策略，如联合微调和参数合并，可能在闭环执行过程中诱发非预期动作，严重削弱单项技能表现。对专家更新进行任务条件化分析发现，响应能量集中于少数主导方向，且共享的任务相关响应子空间内沿高能量方向存在对立的专家响应。这种结构与合并后的非预期动作偏移同时出现。我们提出GeoMerge-OPD，该方法结合了响应空间正则化、参数合并和在线策略蒸馏。在独立的专家微调阶段，G-等距约束限制了任务激活子空间内的更新响应增益；随后，专家参数被静态合并为学生模型，使其具备初步的多任务能力。微调后的任务专家作为教师，在环境观测及学生模型所访问的中间动作流状态处提供速度场监督，以校准残余的行为偏差。基于两种VLA骨干网络的实验表明，所提方法在SIMPLE上实现了强且均衡的人形技能整合，并在LIBERO和LIBERO-PRO上保持了一致的性能，优于联合微调和多任务强化学习基线，同时在扰动条件下仍保持鲁棒性。

title: VeriTouch: Verified Visuo-Tactile World Models that Improve Robot Policy Learning
summary: Scaling visuo-tactile policy learning is constrained by the high cost of real-world data collection and the difficulty of building realistic simulations. Generative models offer a scalable source of training data, yet useful demonstrations require plausible tactile feedback, temporal alignment with visual contact, and accurate actions. To this end, we present VeriTouch, a framework for generating and verifying synthetic visuo-tactile trajectories for policy learning. Conditioned on initial images and task instructions, our world model, VeriGen, jointly generates high-fidelity dual-view videos and realistic tactile sequences over complete manipulation trajectories. By integrating a dedicated tactile expert with a pretrained video model, it captures realistic visual details and tactile deformation dynamics through joint visuo-tactile modeling. Our multimodal verifier VeriEval then checks visual quality while focusing on tactile reliability, assessing tactile realism, contact-force plausibility, and temporal alignment between visible contact and tactile signals, thereby directly filtering out unreliable sequences.
