Finally, our inverse dynamics model, VeriIDM, combines global scene information from both camera views with fine-grained gripper details and motion across neighboring frames to extract actions from verified videos. Experiments on five real-world tasks show that synthetic data improves all four evaluated policies, with further scaling synthetic trajectories substantially boosting policy performance without additional real-world data collection.
tldr: VeriTouch generates and verifies synthetic visuo-tactile trajectories for robot policy learning, improving real-world policy performance by scaling synthetic data.
tldr_zh: VeriTouch 生成并验证合成视觉-触觉轨迹用于机器人策略学习，通过扩展合成数据提升真实世界策略性能。
summary_zh: 缩放视觉-触觉策略学习受限于真实世界数据采集的高成本以及构建逼真仿真的难度。生成模型为训练数据提供了可扩展的来源，然而有用的示范需要合理的触觉反馈、与视觉接触的时间对齐以及精确的动作。为此，我们提出了VeriTouch，一个用于生成和验证合成视觉-触觉轨迹以支持策略学习的框架。基于初始图像和任务指令，我们的世界模型VeriGen在完整的操作轨迹上联合生成高保真双视角视频和逼真的触觉序列。通过将专用触觉专家与预训练视频模型相结合，它通过联合视觉-触觉建模捕捉逼真的视觉细节和触觉形变动态。随后，我们的多模态验证器VeriEval在关注触觉可靠性的同时检查视觉质量，评估触觉真实性、接触力合理性以及可见接触与触觉信号之间的时间对齐，从而直接过滤掉不可靠的序列。最后，我们的逆动力学模型VeriIDM结合两个相机视角的全局场景信息、细粒度夹爪细节以及相邻帧之间的运动，从验证后的视频中提取动作。在五个真实世界任务上的实验表明，合成数据提升了所有四种评估策略的性能，且进一步扩展合成轨迹能大幅提升策略表现，而无需额外采集真实世界数据。

title: RoboInF: A Benchmark for Instruction Fidelity in Robotic Manipulation
summary: Precise language control requires embodied models to follow instructions governing both task outcomes and execution. Although recent methods train policies to follow increasingly detailed commands, existing benchmarks often assess instruction following alongside perception, planning, and generalization to unfamiliar scenes. Higher task success therefore offers limited evidence of closer adherence to instructions. We introduce RoboInF, a benchmark measuring how reliably manipulation policies adapt their behavior to changes in an instruction. For each of eight tasks, six to twelve expert-validated instruction branches vary the requested goal, procedure, or manipulation detail while holding the initial scene and robot state fixed. Task-specific checkers verify the terminal goal and use recorded trajectories, contacts, and event sequences to assess compliance throughout execution. The accompanying RoboInF-4K dataset pairs 4,242 expert demonstrations with simulator-derived annotations of motion and contact. We evaluate leading manipulation policies ($π_{0.5}$ and OpenWAM) and inference-only agents (GPT-6 Astra and Qwen3.8-Flash). All four models exhibit a gap between task completion and faithful execution, indicating substantial room for fine-grained instruction following.
tldr: RoboInF is a benchmark for evaluating instruction fidelity in robotic manipulation, with 4,242 expert demonstrations across eight tasks and multiple instruction branches, revealing that leading policies often complete tasks without strictly following instructions.
tldr_zh: RoboInF 是一个用于评估机器人操作中指令遵循度的基准，包含八个任务的 4,242 个专家演示和多个指令分支，揭示了领先策略在完成任务时不一定严格遵循指令。
summary_zh: 精确的语言控制要求具身模型遵循既规定任务结果又规定执行方式的指令。尽管近期方法训练策略以遵循越来越详细的指令，但现有基准通常在评估指令遵循的同时，还涉及感知、规划以及对陌生场景的泛化能力。因此，更高的任务成功率并不能充分证明模型对指令的忠实遵循程度。我们提出了RoboInF，一个用于衡量操作策略如何可靠地根据指令变化调整其行为的基准。在八个任务中，每个任务包含六至十二条经专家验证的指令分支，这些分支在保持初始场景和机器人状态不变的情况下，改变目标、操作流程或操作细节。任务特定的检查器验证最终目标，并利用记录的运动轨迹、接触信息及事件序列，评估整个执行过程中的指令符合度。配套的RoboInF-4K数据集包含4，242条专家演示，并附有仿真器生成的运动与接触注释。我们评估了领先的操作策略（$π_{0.5}$和OpenWAM）以及仅推理型智能体（GPT-6 Astra和Qwen3.8-Flash）。所有四种模型在任务完成与忠实执行之间均存在差距，表明细粒度指令遵循仍具有显著的提升空间。

title: Body and Soul: Decoupling Robotic Brain and Policy with RoboHarness-Zero
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies can execute individual skills but fail to complete tasks that require combining several of them. In our audit of Xiaomi-Robotics-1, an estimated 43\% of failures involve choosing the wrong target or losing track of task progress. Wrapping a frozen VLA in a vision-language model (VLM) harness is a natural remedy. Existing harnesses can gain substantially from task- and policy-specific preparation, raising the question of how much of that gain transfers to a new task or policy. An ideal harness should (i) need minimal preparation for a new task, (ii) need no redesign for a new policy, and (iii) preserve standalone capabilities the policy already has. To the best of our knowledge, our \ours{} is the first harness built this way. Its premise is that choosing targets and tracking progress are easy for a VLM such as GPT-6 without task preparation, while the frozen VLA already handles continuous, contact-rich motion. The frozen VLA therefore executes continuous control while the VLM plans zero-shot and monitors execution; when progress stalls or targets drift, the VLM first rephrases the instruction and, only as a fallback, executes short generated code over generic motion primitives before returning fine control to the VLA. The supervision rules stay fixed across policies, requiring only a thin interface adapter and an automatically profiled skill configuration per policy. On 200 RoboCasa365 scenes, \ours{} with GPT-6 Astra raises the success rate of frozen Xiaomi-Robotics-1 from \textbf{\color{blue}57.5\%} to \textbf{\color{blue}70.5\%} and preserves \textbf{\color{blue}90.4\%} of its standalone successes (104/115) while rescuing 37 of 85 failures. On a shared 50-scene subset, the same rules add 8 to 10 percentage points to each of four other frozen policies, while existing preparation-based harness systems often fail to transfer to a new policy.
tldr: The paper introduces RoboHarness-Zero, a VLM-based harness that wraps a frozen VLA policy to improve task completion by zero-shot task planning and progress monitoring, demonstrating gains across multiple policies on RoboCasa365 scenes.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了RoboHarness-Zero，一种基于VLM的封装框架，通过零样本任务规划和进度监控来提升冻结的VLA策略的任务完成率，并在RoboCasa365场景中展示了多种策略的性能提升。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略能够执行单个技能，但无法完成需要组合多个技能的任务。在我们对小米机器人1号的审计中，估计有43%的失败涉及选择错误目标或丢失任务进度。将冻结的VLA封装在视觉-语言模型（VLM）框架中是一种自然的补救措施。现有框架能从针对任务和策略的专门准备中显著获益，这引出一个问题：这些收益中有多少能迁移到新任务或新策略上。理想的框架应具备：(i) 对新任务只需极少的准备；(ii) 对新策略无需重新设计；(iii) 保留策略已有的独立能力。据我们所知，我们的\ours{}是首个以这种方式构建的框架。其前提是，对于GPT-6这样的VLM而言，选择目标和跟踪进度在无需任务准备的情况下即可轻松完成，而冻结的VLA已经能够处理连续的、高接触性的运动。因此，冻结的VLA负责执行连续控制，而VLM则进行零样本规划并监控执行过程；当进度停滞或目标偏移时，VLM首先重新表述指令，仅在必要时，通过通用运动原语执行简短生成的代码作为后备方案，然后再将精细控制权交还给VLA。监督规则在不同策略之间保持固定，仅需针对每个策略配置一个轻量级接口适配器和自动生成的技能配置。在200个RoboCasa365场景中，采用GPT-6 Astra的\ours{}将冻结的小米机器人1号的成功率从\textbf{\color{blue}57.5\%}提升至\textbf{\color{blue}70.5\%}，并保留了其\textbf{\color{blue}90.4\%}的独立成功案例（104/115），同时挽救了85个失败中的37个。在共享的50个场景子集上，相同规则为其他四种冻结策略各增加了8到10个百分点的成功率，而现有基于准备的框架系统往往无法迁移到新策略上。

title: DelayOPSD: On-Policy Self-Distillation from a Synchronous Teacher for Real-time Asynchronous Policies
summary: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) policies incur substantial inference latency due to their large vision-language backbones and iterative denoising. Asynchronous execution reduces this latency by generating the next action chunk while executing the current one, but the new chunk is conditioned on a stale observation, degrading performance as the delay increases. We investigate this mismatch by comparing actions predicted from observations at planning and execution times. We find that these predictions differ little on expert demonstrations but diverge substantially on the policy's own delayed rollouts, particularly in failed episodes. Motivated by this observation, we propose DelayOPSD, which trains an asynchronous policy to imitate its synchronous counterpart on the policy's own rollouts. Specifically, a synchronous teacher, obtained from the same policy using the observation at execution time, supervises a delayed student that observes only the earlier frame and the actions still being executed. The student learns to match the teacher throughout its own denoising process. Under a 10-step delay, training SmolVLA on demonstrations achieves only 70.2% success, comparable to naive asynchronous execution (70.4%), whereas training on its own rollouts improves success to 78.7%. Across LIBERO and Kinetix, DelayOPSD achieves the highest average success among the compared methods, without introducing additional modules at deployment. On a real robot, it further improves success from 46% to 62%.
tldr: DelayOPSD addresses the latency-induced stale observation problem in asynchronous VLA policies by training the delayed student to imitate a synchronous teacher on the policy's own rollouts, improving success rates on LIBERO, Kinetix, and a real robot without extra deployment modules.
tldr_zh: DelayOPSD通过让延迟的学生策略在自身轨迹上模仿同步教师策略，解决了异步VLA策略中因陈旧观测导致的性能下降问题，在LIBERO、Kinetix及真实机器人上均提升了成功率。
summary_zh: 基于流式的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略由于依赖大规模视觉-语言主干网络和迭代去噪过程，导致推理延迟显著。异步执行通过在当前动作块执行期间生成下一个动作块来降低延迟，但新生成的动作块基于过时的观测，随着延迟增加，性能会下降。我们通过比较规划和执行时刻基于观测预测的动作来研究这一不匹配问题。我们发现，在专家演示中，这些预测差异很小，但在策略自身延迟的轨迹中，尤其是在失败的回合中，差异显著增大。基于这一观察，我们提出DelayOPSD方法，训练异步策略在自身轨迹上模仿其同步对应策略。具体地，同步教师模型由同一策略利用执行时刻的观测得到，用于监督延迟学生模型，后者仅能观察到较早的帧以及仍在执行的动作。学生模型在自身的去噪过程中学习匹配教师模型。在10步延迟条件下，使用演示数据训练SmolVLA的成功率仅为70.2%，与朴素异步执行（70.4%）相当，而在自身轨迹上训练则可将成功率提升至78.7%。在LIBERO和Kinetix基准上，DelayOPSD在对比方法中取得了最高的平均成功率，且部署时无需引入额外模块。在真实机器人上，该方法进一步将成功率从46%提升至62%。

title: JEPA-ICL: Progress-Aligned Latent Plans for In-Context Robotic Manipulation
summary: Demonstrations show how a task can be completed, but differences in embodiment, appearance, and execution speed make it difficult to identify the guidance relevant to the robot's current progress. We introduce JEPA-ICL, a vision-language-action framework that couples predictive planning with demonstration learning. The policy learns to plan by predicting ordered future states in JEPA feature space up to subtask completion, capturing what remains to be accomplished. These plans guide action generation and locate relevant stages in demonstrations, whose JEPA-supervised content features provide progress-aligned context. Learning from this context, in turn, updates the shared policy that produces the plans and actions. This coupling connects anticipating the robot's own execution with reusing demonstrated experience. On the Imitator Game, JEPA-ICL achieves 80.0% seen-task success under C15 pretraining, outperforming Zero-WAM by 12.0 percentage points. Without contextual demonstrations, JEPA-ICL outperforms the VLA-JEPA variant without human-video pretraining, improving success rates from 96.1% to 97.6% on LIBERO and from 62.9% to 73.2% on LIBERO-Plus. With demonstration-based training and contextual guidance at inference, LIBERO-Plus success further increases from 73.2% to 75.2%.
tldr: JEPA-ICL introduces a vision-language-action framework that uses predictive planning in JEPA feature space to align contextual demonstrations with the robot's current progress, improving manipulation success on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks.
tldr_zh: JEPA-ICL 提出了一种视觉-语言-动作框架，通过在 JEPA 特征空间中进行预测规划，将示范上下文与机器人当前进度对齐，从而提高了 LIBERO 和 LIBERO-Plus 上的操作成功率。
summary_zh: demonstrations展示了任务如何完成，但具身形态、外观以及执行速度上的差异使得难以识别与机器人当前进度相关的指导。我们介绍了JEPA-ICL，一个将预测规划与演示学习相结合的视觉-语言-动作框架。该策略通过在JEPA特征空间中预测至子任务完成的有序未来状态来学习规划，捕捉尚需完成的内容。这些规划指导动作生成，并定位演示中的相关阶段，其由JEPA监督的内容特征提供了与进度对齐的上下文。从这一上下文中学习，进而更新生成规划和动作的共享策略。这种耦合将预测机器人自身执行与重用演示经验联系起来。在Imitator Game上，JEPA-ICL在C15预训练下实现了80.0%的已见任务成功率，比Zero-WAM高出12.0个百分点。在没有上下文演示的情况下，JEPA-ICL优于未进行人类视频预训练的VLA-JEPA变体，将LIBERO上的成功率从96.1%提升至97.6%，将LIBERO-Plus上的成功率从62.9%提升至73.2%。通过基于演示的训练和推理时的上下文引导，LIBERO-Plus的成功率进一步从73.2%提升至75.2%。

title: DexDuet: Learning Contact-Preserving Bimanual Dexterity from Human Demonstrations
summary: Human demonstrations provide a rich source of bimanual dexterous skills, yet transferring them to robot hands remains challenging. Existing methods primarily optimize object trajectory tracking, often overlooking how human hands interact with the object. Even with accurate tracking, robots may contact incorrect object parts or slide their fingers, resulting in unstable manipulation. We present DexDuet, a framework that learns contact-preserving bimanual dexterity from a single human demonstration. DexDuet employs two interaction rewards to preserve human hand-object configurations and contacts. To enable coordinated manipulation, we factorize the bimanual policy into two weight-sharing per-hand policies that condition on each other's states. We further propose assisted reference-state initialization (A-RSI), an adaptive curriculum that adjusts object assistance and training starts across demonstration segments to overcome difficult manipulation phases. Across four benchmarks spanning three simulators and five robot embodiments, DexDuet improves object-tracking ADD-AUC by 11 to 41 points over the corresponding baselines while consistently achieving better contact preservation. Notably, among 122 paired runs with comparable object-tracking accuracy, DexDuet preserves the human's contacts better in 117 cases. Code and videos are available at https://rcl-robotics.github.io/Dexduet.io/
tldr: DexDuet learns contact-preserving bimanual dexterous manipulation from a single human demonstration by factorizing the policy into two weight-sharing per-hand policies, using interaction rewards and an assisted curriculum to improve contact fidelity and object tracking across multiple simulators and embodiments.
tldr_zh: DexDuet 通过将双手策略分解为两个权重共享的单手策略，并利用交互奖励和辅助课程，从单个人类演示中学习保持接触的双手灵巧操作，在多个模拟器和机器人平台上提高了接触保真度和物体跟踪精度。
summary_zh: 人类演示为双臂灵巧技能提供了丰富的来源，但将其迁移至机器人手部仍具挑战性。现有方法主要优化物体轨迹跟踪，往往忽视了人类手部与物体之间的交互方式。即便实现了精确跟踪，机器人仍可能接触错误的物体部位或发生手指滑动，导致操作不稳定。我们提出DexDuet，一个从单次人类演示中学习保持接触的双臂灵巧性框架。DexDuet采用两种交互奖励来保持人类手-物构型与接触。为实现协调操作，我们将双臂策略分解为两个共享权重的单臂策略，二者相互以对方状态为条件。我们进一步提出辅助参考状态初始化（A-RSI），一种自适应课程机制，根据演示片段调整物体辅助程度与训练起点，以克服困难的操作阶段。在横跨三个仿真器与五种机器人实体共四个基准测试中，DexDuet相较于对应基线在物体跟踪ADD-AUC上提升11至41个百分点，同时始终实现更优的接触保持。值得注意的是，在122次物体跟踪精度相当的成对运行中，DexDuet在117次中更好地保留了人类的接触模式。代码与视频见 https://rcl-robotics.github.io/Dexduet.io/

title: EgoStudy: How Does Scaling Egocentric Data Affect VLA and WAM Pretraining?
summary: Egocentric human manipulation data offer a scalable resource for training dexterous robot policies. However, how effectively robots can learn and benefit from these data remains unclear due to the embodiment gap between humans and robots. We present EgoStudy, a systematic, controlled study of egocentric data for robot learning. Holding the robot dataset fixed, we vary the scale and diversity of egocentric data, data processing strategies, and co-training configurations. We investigate three questions: (1) Which data processing and pretraining choices most effectively exploit egocentric data? (2) Which components of robot action prediction benefit most from scaling these data? (3) How do scaling effects differ between vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs)? Our experiments yield three main findings. First, data diversity, alignment between trajectories, and detailed language annotations are key factors in effective transfer. Second, scaling egocentric data yields larger gains in predicting end-effector translation than in predicting fine-grained finger movements. Third, WAMs perform better when egocentric data are limited, whereas VLAs exhibit greater gains as the amount of egocentric data increases. Together, these findings provide practical guidance on processing and using egocentric data to train VLAs and WAMs, while clarifying the benefits and limitations of scaling these data.
tldr: EgoStudy systematically investigates how scaling egocentric human manipulation data affects VLA and WAM pretraining, finding that data diversity, alignment, and detailed language annotations are key, with VLAs benefiting more from scaling than WAMs, and gains primarily in predicting end-effector translation.
tldr_zh: EgoStudy系统研究了扩展以自我为中心的人类操作数据如何影响VLA和WAM预训练，发现数据多样性、轨迹对齐和详细语言注释是关键因素，且VLA比WAM从数据扩展中获益更多，提升主要体现在预测末端执行器平移上。
summary_zh: 以自我为中心的人类操作数据为训练灵巧机器人策略提供了可扩展的资源。然而，由于人类与机器人之间存在具身差异，机器人能多有效地从这些数据中学习并获益尚不明确。我们提出了EgoStudy，一项关于以自我为中心的数据用于机器人学习的系统性、受控研究。在保持机器人数据集固定的情况下，我们变化以自我为中心的数据的规模与多样性、数据处理策略以及协同训练配置。我们探究三个问题：（1）哪些数据处理和预训练选择能最有效地利用以自我为中心的数据？（2）机器人动作预测的哪些组成部分从这些数据的扩展中获益最大？（3）扩展效应在视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）与世界-动作模型（WAMs）之间有何不同？我们的实验得出三个主要发现。首先，数据多样性、轨迹之间的对齐以及详细的语言标注是有效迁移的关键因素。其次，扩展以自我为中心的数据在预测末端执行器平移方面带来的收益大于预测精细手指动作。第三，当以自我为中心的数据有限时，WAMs表现更好，而随着以自我为中心的数据量增加，VLAs展现出更大的增益。综合这些发现，为处理和利用以自我为中心的数据来训练VLAs和WAMs提供了实用指导，同时阐明了扩展这些数据的益处与局限。

title: CHAMP: Coordinated Humanoid Loco-Manipulation with Whole-Body Motion Priors
summary: Coordinating locomotion and dexterous manipulation is fundamental to humanoid robots operating in human environments. A key challenge is learning motion priors from diverse data and using them effectively for coordinated robot control. We present CHAMP, a unified framework for humanoid loco-manipulation that combines whole-body motion pretraining with adaptive feature extraction. CHAMP pretrains a vision-language model to predict future body and hand motion from approximately 2,298 hours of heterogeneous human and robot data. A shared motion representation enables unified whole-body motion learning across embodiments from datasets with body annotations, hand annotations, or both. To ground these motion priors in robot control, we introduce a Coordination-oriented Action Expert (CAE) and train it on replay data generated using the target controller. Through sparse routing, CAE adaptively selects, transforms, and fuses features from multiple layers of the pretrained model to jointly generate body and hand actions. In experiments, CHAMP achieves overall success rates of 84.8% on seven simulated tasks and 91.4% on seven real-world tasks with a Unitree G1, outperforming the evaluated baselines in both settings. In particular, CHAMP achieves 70.0% success on the long-horizon popcorn-serving task, compared with 40.0% for the best-performing baseline.
tldr: CHAMP pretrains a vision-language model on heterogeneous human and robot motion data to learn whole-body motion priors, then uses a routing-based action expert to generate coordinated body and hand actions for humanoid loco-manipulation, achieving high success on simulated and real tasks.
tldr_zh: CHAMP 在异构人机运动数据上预训练视觉语言模型以学习全身运动先验，并通过路由机制的动作专家生成协调的身体和手部动作，在仿真和真实任务中取得高成功率。
summary_zh: 协调运动与灵巧操作是仿人机器人在人类环境中工作的基础。一个关键挑战在于从多样化的数据中学习运动先验，并将其有效应用于机器人的协调控制。我们提出了CHAMP，一个用于仿人机器人移动操作任务的统一框架，结合了全身运动预训练与自适应特征提取。CHAMP预训练了一个视觉-语言模型，利用约2298小时的异构人类与机器人数据预测未来的身体和手部运动。一种共享的运动表示使得跨不同形态的全身运动学习成为可能，所用数据来自包含身体标注、手部标注或两者兼具的数据集。为了将这些运动先验落地到机器人控制中，我们引入了一个面向协调的动作专家（CAE），并在由目标控制器生成的回放数据上进行训练。通过稀疏路由机制，CAE自适应地选择、变换并融合预训练模型多个层次的特征，以联合生成身体和手部动作。在实验中，CHAMP在七个仿真任务中取得了84.8%的总体成功率，在Unitree G1上的七个真实世界任务中取得了91.4%的成功率，在两种场景下均优于所评估的基线方法。特别地，在长时程的爆米花递送任务中，CHAMP达到了70.0%的成功率，而表现最好的基线仅为40.0%。

title: SOAR: temporal Structure-guided One-step Action generation for Robotic manipulation
summary: Efficient robotic manipulation requires temporally coordinated actions with low inference latency. Multi-step diffusion and flow policies progressively refine action trajectories but require costly iterative inference, whereas one-step policies eliminate iterative trajectory refinement to reduce inference cost. We introduce **SOAR**, a structure-guided one-step generative policy that improves action quality while preserving one-step efficiency. SOAR predicts an observation-conditioned discrete cosine transform (DCT) representation of future actions, capturing temporal variations across multiple frequency bands to provide explicit guidance from key temporal structural information. Unlike velocity-parameterized one-step flow policies that recover clean actions indirectly from a predicted velocity field, SOAR directly generates clean action trajectories in action space. This aligns the model output with the executable control target and provides a direct interface for structural calibration. The predicted structure further corrects the generated trajectory according to their spectral discrepancy, without requiring an additional evaluation of the generative backbone. During training, the corresponding MeanFlow velocity is derived from the calibrated clean action and used for consistency learning, while an endpoint objective aligns training with the pure-noise condition used for one-step inference. Across 53 Adroit and Meta-World tasks, SOAR achieves 83.9% overall success with only 8.7 ms inference latency. When applied to the VLA model, π0.5, SOAR further achieves 97.2% on LIBERO and 71.7% on RoboTwin 2.0. Real-world experiments and extensive ablations further validate its effectiveness and efficiency.
tldr: SOAR introduces a structure-guided one-step generative policy for robotic manipulation that predicts DCT-based action representations to improve action quality while maintaining low inference latency, achieving high success rates across multiple benchmarks and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: SOAR 提出了一种结构引导的单步生成策略，通过预测基于离散余弦变换的动作表示来提升动作质量并保持低推理延迟，在多个基准和真实任务中取得了高成功率。
summary_zh: 高效机器人操作需要低推理延迟的时间协调动作。多步扩散与流策略通过逐步优化动作轨迹，但需要昂贵的迭代推理，而单步策略则消除了迭代轨迹优化过程，从而降低推理成本。我们提出了 **SOAR**，一种结构引导的单步生成策略，在保持单步效率的同时提升动作质量。SOAR 预测以观测为条件的未来动作离散余弦变换（DCT）表示，捕获多个频带上的时间变化，从而从关键时间结构信息中提供显式引导。与基于速度参数化的单步流策略（需从预测的速度场中间接恢复干净动作）不同，SOAR 直接在动作空间中生成干净的动作轨迹。这使模型输出与可执行控制目标对齐，并为结构校正提供了直接接口。所预测的结构进一步根据其频谱差异对生成轨迹进行校正，而无需对生成骨干网络进行额外评估。在训练过程中，从校正后的干净动作中推导相应的 MeanFlow 速度用于一致性学习，同时端点目标使训练与单步推理所用的纯噪声条件保持一致。在 53 个 Adroit 和 Meta-World 任务中，SOAR 以仅 8.7 ms 的推理延迟实现了 83.9% 的总体成功率。当应用于 VLA 模型 π0.5 时，SOAR 在 LIBERO 上进一步达到 97.2%，在 RoboTwin 2.0 上达到 71.7%。真实世界实验及大量消融研究进一步验证了其有效性与高效性。

title: ConsisX: Cross-View Consistency Thinking in 3D for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models integrate visual perception and language understanding from vision-language models (VLMs) with action prediction for robotic manipulation. Although multi-view observations provide complementary scene information, VLMs model cross-view interactions based on 2D feature similarity, which can lead to physical inconsistency in the form of cross-view incorrect association between distinct entities and cross-view information fragmentation about the same entity. To address these challenges, we propose ConsisX, a novel VLA framework that integrates cross-view association and entity coherence to enable cross-view consistency thinking in 3D for physically consistent robotic manipulation. Specifically, Cross-View Association Modeling (CAM) is proposed to introduce cross-view spatial proximity constraints in a shared 3D space to reduce cross-view incorrect association. Entity Coherence Organization (ECO) is designed to organize cross-view local information into coherent 3D entity evidence, thereby addressing cross-view information fragmentation. Consistent Action Conditioning (CAC) is introduced to condition action prediction on task-relevant 3D entity evidence for cross-view consistent action execution. Experiments on 3 real-world manipulation tasks and 4 simulation benchmarks establish ConsisX as an effective and competitive framework for robotic manipulation.
tldr: ConsisX introduces cross-view consistency thinking in 3D for VLA models, with cross-view association modeling, entity coherence organization, and consistent action conditioning, improving robotic manipulation on real and simulated benchmarks.
tldr_zh: ConsisX 通过在三维空间中进行跨视角一致性思考，结合跨视角关联建模、实体一致性组织和一致动作条件化，提高了机器人操作的性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将视觉-语言模型（VLM）中的视觉感知与语言理解能力，与机器人操作中的动作预测相结合。尽管多视角观测能够提供互补的场景信息，但VLM基于二维特征相似性建模跨视角交互，这可能导致物理不一致性，具体表现为不同实体间的跨视角错误关联，以及同一实体跨视角信息的碎片化。为解决上述问题，我们提出ConsisX，一种新颖的VLA框架，整合跨视角关联与实体一致性，在三维空间中实现跨视角一致性思考，从而支持物理一致的机器人操作。具体而言，我们提出跨视角关联建模（CAM），在共享三维空间中引入跨视角空间邻近约束，以减少跨视角错误关联；设计实体一致性组织（ECO），将跨视角局部信息整合为连贯的三维实体证据，以解决跨视角信息碎片化问题；引入一致性动作条件化（CAC），基于任务相关的三维实体证据对动作预测进行条件化，以实现跨视角一致的动作执行。在3项真实世界操作任务和4项仿真基准上的实验表明，ConsisX是一种有效且具有竞争力的机器人操作框架。

title: Skill-Adaptive Noise Scheduling for Diffusion Policies
summary: Recent advances in diffusion policies have demonstrated strong effectiveness when integrated into hierarchical skill-based learning frameworks, leveraging offline data to capture multimodal and temporally abstracted behaviors. However, prior approaches have rarely considered the diffusion process as a learnable component, adopting fixed noise schedules applied uniformly across skills, regardless of their distinct behavioral contexts. Such a design fundamentally limits the achievable performance, particularly for contact-rich and dexterous manipulation tasks where different skills exhibit distinct couplings between action dimensions. In this paper, we present a skill-adaptive noise diffusion framework (SaND) which introduces a learnable, skill-conditioned noise schedule that modulates the diffusion process per action dimension, adapting the noising dynamics to each skill. To prevent the learned noise schedule from collapsing into trivial solutions, we employ an auxiliary inverse objective that reconstructs the skill embedding from the Legendre coefficients of the derivative of the noise schedule, encouraging the schedules to remain skill-discriminative. This formulation naturally enables adaptive control over the denoising steps for each skill, where noise schedules are clustered in the Legendre coefficient space, and the appropriate number of denoising steps is determined at the point where reconstruction error abruptly increases. At inference, we identify each skill embedding's cluster from its noise schedule and apply the corresponding number of denoising steps, dedicating more compute to skills requiring fine-grained control and less to simpler ones. In simulation and on real robot hardware, SaND outperforms existing skill learning and planning baselines on contact-rich and dexterous manipulation tasks, achieving higher success rates while requiring fewer denoising steps.
tldr: This paper introduces SaND, a skill-adaptive noise scheduling framework for diffusion policies that learns skill-conditioned, per-action-dimension noise schedules, improving contact-rich and dexterous manipulation performance while reducing denoising steps via adaptive compute allocation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出SaND，一种面向扩散策略的技能自适应噪声调度框架，通过学习技能条件化的逐动作维度噪声调度，提升接触丰富和灵巧操作任务性能，并通过自适应计算分配减少去噪步数。
summary_zh: 扩散策略的最新进展已展现出显著有效性，特别是在将其整合到基于分层技能的学习框架中时，能够利用离线数据捕捉多模态及时间抽象的行为特征。然而，现有方法鲜少将扩散过程视为可学习组件，而是对所有技能统一采用固定的噪声调度，未考虑各技能独特的行为背景。这种设计从根本上限制了可实现的性能，尤其是在接触密集及灵巧操作任务中，不同技能在动作维度间表现出不同的耦合特性。在本文中，我们提出了一种技能自适应噪声扩散框架（SaND），该框架引入了一个可学习的、以技能为条件的噪声调度，能够按动作维度调节扩散过程，使噪声动态适应每种技能。为防止学习到的噪声调度退化为平凡解，我们采用了一个辅助逆向目标，从噪声调度导数的勒让德系数中重建技能嵌入，从而促使各调度保持技能区分性。该公式自然实现了对每种技能去噪步骤的自适应控制，其中噪声调度在勒让德系数空间中形成聚类，并在重建误差突然增大之处确定合适的去噪步数。在推理阶段，我们根据噪声调度识别各技能嵌入所属的聚类，并应用相应的去噪步数，为需要精细控制的技能分配更多计算资源，而为较简单技能分配较少资源。在仿真及真实机器人硬件上，SaND在接触密集和灵巧操作任务中均优于现有的技能学习与规划基线，实现了更高的成功率，同时所需去噪步数更少。

title: Innata-0: A Native Embodied World System with Model-Agent Co-Design
summary: The physical world is open-ended, dynamic, and partially observable. While foundation models have advanced embodied intelligence, standalone models struggle with long-horizon execution, and simply integrating models with agents may lead to inconsistencies between planning and physical control. To support reliable and adaptive behaviors in the physical world, we introduce Innata-0, a native embodied world system. Innata-0 jointly designs an embodied world-action model and an agent to combine their complementary strengths. The model, Innata-0-WAM, adopts a tri-tower Mixture-of-Transformers architecture that integrates understanding, prediction, and action generation. The agent, Innata-0-Agent, coordinates long-horizon execution through memory, verification, and recovery. A co-design protocol is further proposed to align model training with agent execution and leverage validated experiences to support subsequent adaptation and model improvement. Extensive evaluations demonstrate strong embodied capabilities across understanding, world prediction, and robotic manipulation. Innata-0 represents our first step toward physical intelligence, and we see it as the beginning of a much longer journey.
tldr: Innata-0 introduces a native embodied world system that co-designs an embodied world-action model (Innata-0-WAM) with a tri-tower Mixture-of-Transformers architecture and an agent (Innata-0-Agent) for long-horizon execution, demonstrating capabilities in understanding, world prediction, and robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: Innata-0 提出了一种原生具身世界系统，通过联合设计具有三塔混合Transformer架构的具身世界动作模型和用于长程执行的智能体，在理解、世界预测和机器人操作方面展现出强大能力。
summary_zh: 物理世界是开放、动态且部分可观测的。尽管基础模型推动了具身智能的发展，但独立模型难以应对长时程任务执行，而简单地将模型与智能体结合可能导致规划与物理控制之间的不一致。为了在物理世界中实现可靠且自适应的行为，我们引入了Innata-0，一个原生具身世界系统。Innata-0联合设计了一个具身世界-动作模型与一个智能体，以结合二者的互补优势。其中，模型部分Innata-0-WAM采用三塔式混合专家架构，集成了理解、预测与动作生成三大功能。智能体部分Innata-0-Agent则通过记忆、验证与恢复机制来协调长时程任务执行。此外，我们提出了一种协同设计协议，用于对齐模型训练与智能体执行过程，并利用经过验证的经验来支持后续的自适应与模型改进。大量实验评估表明，该系统在理解、世界预测和机器人操作等方面展现出强大的具身能力。Innata-0是我们迈向物理智能的第一步，我们视其为一段更长远旅程的起点。

title: RoboAda: Adapting Frozen Robot Policies at Test Time to Physics They Cannot See
summary: Pretrained robot policies decide what to do from camera images, yet some of the physics that decides whether their plans succeed is not visible. An object may look light but be 100 times heavier, and a weakened joint or a lagging controller leaves no trace in the image. When the physics at deployment differs from training, the plan is often still right but is executed as if nothing had changed. Training on such variations in advance cannot handle unseen changes, while adapting once deployed either changes the plan, leaving the miscalibrated commands in place, or updates a robot model by gradient steps that do not know how reliable they are and can make the robot worse even when nothing has changed. We propose RoboAda, which keeps the policy and its plan unchanged and corrects the commands that carry it out by inferring at test time how the robot turns commands into motion. The key observation is that the robot's own motion reveals the change: after each action chunk, an inverse-dynamics model of the original robot converts the observed motion into the commands it would have needed, yielding free labels at every step. Competing hypotheses of how the robot responds, including that nothing has changed, are weighted by how well they predict these labels, and the next chunk is sent with the commands that best realize the plan under them. RoboAda needs no reward, no gradient step and no data from the changed robot. We evaluate RoboAda with five frozen policies on LIBERO, two world action models and three vision-language-action models. Under eleven physical shifts, it more than doubles their average success, from 27.8% to 62.9%. It beats the best of seven test-time adaptation methods by 17.3 points on Cosmos Policy, and largely preserves the policies' success when nothing has changed. On bimanual RoboTwin 2.0 in joint space, it raises success under joint-target offsets from 24.9% to 78.8%.
tldr: RoboAda adapts frozen robot policies at test time by inferring changed dynamics from the robot's own motion, correcting action commands without gradients or retraining, and significantly improving success under physical shifts.
tldr_zh: RoboAda 在测试时通过机器人自身的运动推断变化的动力学，在不进行梯度更新或重新训练的情况下修正动作指令，显著提高物理变化下的成功率。
summary_zh: 预训练的机器人策略从相机图像中决定该做什么，然而，决定其计划能否成功的部分物理因素并不可见。一个物体可能看起来很轻，但实际上重达100倍；一个老化的关节或滞后的控制器在图像中不会留下任何痕迹。当部署时的物理条件与训练时不同，计划通常仍然是正确的，但执行时却仿佛一切都未改变。预先针对此类变化进行训练无法应对未见过的变化，而部署后的适配要么改变计划，留下未校准的指令，要么通过梯度步更新机器人模型，但这些梯度步并不知晓自身的可靠性，即便环境未发生任何变化，也可能使机器人性能变差。我们提出RoboAda，它保持策略及其计划不变，通过在测试时推断机器人如何将指令转化为运动来修正执行计划的指令。关键观察在于：机器人自身的运动揭示了变化——在每个动作片段之后，原始机器人的逆动力学模型将观察到的运动转换为所需的指令，从而在每一步都提供免费标签。关于机器人如何响应的竞争性假设（包括“环境未变”这一假设）根据其对标签的预测效果进行加权，随后发送的下一片段使用在该加权下最能实现计划的指令。RoboAda无需奖励、无需梯度步、也无需来自变化后机器人的数据。我们在LIBERO上使用五个冻结策略、两个世界动作模型和三个视觉-语言-动作模型对RoboAda进行了评估。在十一种物理变化下，其平均成功率从27.8%提升至62.9%，翻了一倍多。在Cosmos Policy上，它比七种测试时适配方法中的最佳方法高出17.3个百分点，并且在环境未变时基本保持了策略的成功率。在关节空间的双臂RoboTwin 2.0上，它在关节目标偏移条件下将成功率从24.9%提升至78.8%。

title: Calibrating World Action Models: From Adaptive System 2 Takeover to Self-Evolution
summary: World action models (WAMs) deliver fast visuomotor control, yet degrade sharply in challenging scenes and act blindly when about to fail; conversely, foundation-model-based agents generalize and recover reliably, but incur prohibitive latency and cost when queried at every step. To achieve both WAM (System 1)-level speed and agent (System 2)-level reliability--- we propose \textbf{\oursfull (\ours)}, a framework that calibrates WAMs' confidence--- adaptively triggering System~2 only when necessary, and distilling System~2's knowledge to form an evolving System~1. First, \ours equips a frozen WAM with \textbf{calibrated self-assessment}: a single lightweight judgment token reading internal video--action features is trained via our proposed \textbf{cross-fitted temporal-difference (TD) learning} using only binary rollout success/failure signals. It can predict a \textbf{calibrated success probability} at negligible overhead without affecting action predictions. Second, this calibrated success probability schedules control chunk by chunk---invoking System~2 to resolve bottlenecks when confidence drops, and handing control back to the WAM once confidence recovers, preserving WAM-like speed while approaching System~2 reliability. Third, as System~2 intervenes only when the WAM lacks confidence, its takeover trajectories directly capture the WAM's capability gaps. JiL distills these takeovers into the WAM to repair those gaps so System~1 can operate standalone without System~2 at test time, while our mastered-skill anchoring and dynamic confidence gating prevent degrading existing capabilities.
tldr: This paper introduces JiL, a framework that calibrates World Action Models (WAMs) by adaptively triggering a slower, more reliable System 2 agent only when the WAM's confidence is low, and then distilling these interventions back into the WAM to improve its standalone performance, achieving both speed and reliability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了JiL框架，通过校准世界动作模型（WAM）的置信度，仅在置信度低时自适应地触发更慢但更可靠的System 2代理，并将其干预知识蒸馏回WAM以提升其独立性能，从而同时实现速度和可靠性。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）能够实现快速的视觉运动控制，但在挑战性场景中性能急剧下降，且在即将失败时盲目行动；相反，基于基础模型的智能体能够可靠地泛化与恢复，但若在每一步都查询，则会带来难以承受的延迟与成本。为同时获得WAM（系统1）级别的速度与智能体（系统2）级别的可靠性，我们提出\textbf{\oursfull（\ours）}框架，该框架对WAM的置信度进行校准——仅在必要时自适应触发系统2，并将系统2的知识蒸馏至不断演化的系统1中。首先，\ours为冻结的WAM配备\textbf{校准的自评估}能力：通过我们提出的\textbf{交叉拟合时序差分（TD）学习}，仅利用二值化轨迹成功/失败信号，训练一个轻量级判断标记，该标记读取内部视频-动作特征。该标记能以可忽略的开销预测\textbf{校准的成功概率}，且不影响动作预测。其次，该校准的成功概率按控制块进行调度——当置信度下降时调用系统2解决瓶颈，一旦置信度恢复便将控制权交还给WAM，从而在保持WAM级别速度的同时逼近系统2的可靠性。第三，由于系统2仅在WAM缺乏置信度时介入，其接管轨迹直接捕获了WAM的能力缺口。JiL将这些接管经验蒸馏至WAM中，以弥补这些缺口，使得系统1在测试阶段无需系统2即可独立运行，同时我们的技能锚定与动态置信度门控机制防止了现有能力的退化。

title: LeadVLA: Learning Follower-Aware Route Execution for Robot Leading
summary: Robot leading requires executing a route while continuously adapting to a designated follower. Existing robot-leading systems often mediate follower understanding and physical route execution through explicit states, planners, or modular interfaces; directly learning this coupling through end-to-end trajectory prediction can instead entangle route execution with follower response. We introduce LeadVLA, a structured multimodal policy that preserves the route as an explicit Path reference while learning a Pace for route progress and a Residual for local follower- and scene-conditioned adaptation. To make this problem trainable and measurable, we develop LeadInfra, a configurable Unreal Engine-based closed-loop data-generation infrastructure from which we instantiate an approximately 4M-sample training corpus, and LeadBench, a standardized benchmark with 108 fully held-out closed-loop episodes. LeadVLA achieves the highest task success (39.6%) among evaluated robot policies on LeadBench while maintaining strong route fidelity and follower responsiveness, and transfers to unseen real-world environments without real-world policy fine-tuning. Project Page: https://louiszengCN.github.io/LeadVLA_PAGE/
tldr: LeadVLA introduces a structured multimodal policy for robot leading that separates route execution into an explicit Path reference, a Pace module for route progress, and a Residual for follower- and scene-conditioned adaptation, achieving state-of-the-art success on a new closed-loop benchmark and transferring to unseen real environments without fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: LeadVLA 提出了一种用于机器人引导的结构化多模态策略，将路线执行分解为显式路径参考、步调节奏模块和用于跟随者与环境自适应的残差模块，在新基准上取得了最高任务成功率，并无需微调即可迁移至未见过的真实环境。
summary_zh: 机器人领航需要在执行既定路线时持续适应指定的跟随者。现有的机器人领航系统通常通过显式状态、规划器或模块化接口来协调跟随者的理解与物理路线执行；而通过端到端轨迹预测直接学习这种耦合关系，则可能将路线执行与跟随者响应纠缠在一起。我们提出了LeadVLA，一种结构化的多模态策略，该策略将路线保留为显式的路径（Path）参考，同时学习用于路线推进的步调（Pace）以及用于局部跟随者与环境条件适应的残差（Residual）。为使该问题可训练且可度量，我们开发了LeadInfra，一个基于虚幻引擎的可配置闭环数据生成基础设施，并从中构建了约400万样本的训练语料库；同时构建了LeadBench，一个包含108个完全留出闭环测试场景的标准化基准。在LeadBench上，LeadVLA在所评估的机器人策略中取得了最高的任务成功率（39.6%），同时保持了较强的路线保真度和跟随者响应能力，并且无需真实世界策略微调即可迁移至未见过的真实环境。项目主页：https://louiszengCN.github.io/LeadVLA_PAGE/

title: Agent on Guard: Self-Improving Runtime Intervention for Robust Robotic Manipulation
summary: Robot foundation policies provide learned execution capabilities, while programming agents can reason about failures and construct recovery behaviors. Combining them effectively requires learning when intervention helps and when the policy can reliably resume. This challenge is inherently temporal: the physical world continues to evolve during reasoning, and a useful recovery may become infeasible before a decision takes effect. We introduce Agent on Guard (AoG), a hierarchical framework that improves collaboration between a frozen base policy and a programming agent through physical experience. An evolving outer planner allocates control as the physical state evolves, aligning decisions with the physical clock with attention to observation freshness, remaining recovery windows, and the time required for reasoning, recovery, and subsequent execution. Coupled inner loops jointly refine intervention timing, recovery skills, and handoff conditions. Rather than judging recovery by local correction alone, AoG uses downstream task progress, failure recurrence, final outcomes, and resource consumption to improve both recovery behaviors and scheduling. This turns temporary agent solutions into reusable collaboration capabilities that complement the frozen policy. On RoboDojo-Sim, AoG achieves a success rate of 50.57% and a task score of 57.26, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline by 11.22 percentage points and 10.68 points, respectively. It also reduces end-to-end episode latency by 80.4% and online token consumption by 85.1% relative to the GPT-6 Astra agent.
tldr: Agent on Guard (AoG) introduces a hierarchical framework that coordinates a frozen base policy and a programming agent for robotic manipulation, learning when to intervene via an evolving outer planner that times interventions according to physical state evolution, and refining recovery skills through coupled inner loops. AoG outperforms baselines on RoboDojo-Sim with higher success rate and lower latency.
tldr_zh: Agent on Guard（AoG）提出了一种分层框架，协调冻结的基础策略与编程代理，通过学习何时干预（根据物理状态演化进行干预时机调度）来增强机器人操作鲁棒性，并通过内循环优化恢复技能。在RoboDojo-Sim上，AoG的成功率和任务得分均优于基线，且显著降低了延迟和令牌消耗。
summary_zh: 机器人基础策略提供了学习到的执行能力，而编程智能体能够对失败进行推理并构建恢复行为。将二者有效结合，需要学习何时干预是有帮助的，以及何时基础策略能够可靠地恢复执行。这一挑战本质上具有时间性：在推理过程中，物理世界持续演化，一个有用的恢复方案可能在决策生效之前就已变得不可行。我们提出了Agent on Guard (AoG)，一种层次化框架，通过物理经验提升冻结基础策略与编程智能体之间的协作。一个不断演进的外层规划器根据物理状态的变化分配控制权，通过对观测新鲜度、剩余恢复窗口以及推理、恢复和后续执行所需时间的关注，将决策与物理时钟对齐。耦合的内层循环联合优化干预时机、恢复技能和交接条件。AoG不仅仅以局部修正来评判恢复效果，而是利用下游任务进展、故障复发情况、最终结果和资源消耗来同时改进恢复行为和调度策略。这将临时的智能体解决方案转化为可复用的协作能力，与冻结策略形成互补。在RoboDojo-Sim上，AoG实现了50.57%的成功率和57.26的任务得分，分别超过最强评估基线11.22个百分点和10.68分。此外，与GPT-6 Astra智能体相比，AoG将端到端回合延迟降低了80.4%，在线token消耗降低了85.1%。

title: MotionServe: Efficient Multi-Robot Serving by Exploiting Robot Execution Slack
summary: As robotic arms undertake diverse manipulation tasks, a deployment may need to serve many task-specific vision-language-action (VLA) policies concurrently. Dedicating a GPU to each robot is costly, motivating shared-GPU inference. Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) allows compatible policies to share a frozen backbone with lightweight policy-specific adapters, reducing model-weight memory and enabling cross-policy batching. However, robot inference must keep pace with physical execution. With action chunking, robots continue executing buffered actions while awaiting new predictions, and the remaining buffered time provides each robot's execution slack for serving its next request. Once this slack is exhausted, the robot stalls until new actions arrive, interrupting task progress. Observing earlier preserves more slack but can lead to disruptive replanning and lower task success, whereas delaying dispatch to form larger batches can improve GPU efficiency but consumes slack and risks stalls. To balance these competing demands, we present MotionServe, a shared-GPU serving system that coordinates robot observation timing with server-side batch formation. MotionExec selects observation triggers based on motion structure in predicted action chunks, allowing inference to overlap with remaining buffered execution. SlackBatch combines the resulting per-robot execution budgets with estimated outstanding GPU work to determine when to wait, which requests to batch, and when to dispatch them. We evaluate X-VLA on LIBERO and SimplerEnv's WidowX tasks and OpenVLA-OFT on LIBERO, with up to 96 simulated robots sharing one NVIDIA H200 GPU. At 96 robots, MotionServe reduces mean stall per episode by 43.4% and 32.6% and improves task success by 8.98 and 2.30 percentage points, respectively, over each model's lowest-stall baseline. Backbone sharing also reduces weight memory for 96 policies by 97.6% and 91.1%.
tldr: MotionServe is a shared-GPU serving system that coordinates robot observation timing with server-side batch formation to efficiently serve many concurrent VLA policies on a single GPU, reducing robot stalls and improving task success.
tldr_zh: MotionServe 是一个共享 GPU 服务系统，通过协调机器人观测时机与服务器端批处理形成，在单个 GPU 上高效服务多个并发 VLA 策略，减少机器人停顿并提高任务成功率。
summary_zh: 随着机械臂承担多样化的操作任务，一次部署可能需要同时服务于多个特定任务的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略。为每台机器人配备专属GPU成本高昂，因此共享GPU推理成为更具吸引力的方案。低秩适配（LoRA）允许兼容的策略共享一个冻结的骨干网络，并配备轻量级的策略专用适配器，从而减少模型权重内存占用，并支持跨策略批处理。然而，机器人推理必须与物理执行保持同步。在动作分块机制下，机器人会在等待新预测的同时继续执行缓冲动作，剩余缓冲时间即为每台机器人下一次请求提供的执行裕量。一旦该裕量耗尽，机器人将停滞直至新动作到达，从而中断任务进度。提前观测可保留更多裕量，但可能导致频繁的计划调整和较低的任务成功率；反之，延迟派发以形成更大批次可提升GPU效率，但会消耗裕量并带来停滞风险。为平衡这些相互冲突的需求，我们提出了MotionServe——一个共享GPU服务系统，用于协调机器人观测时机与服务器端批次形成。MotionExec根据预测动作块中的运动结构选择观测触发时机，使推理与剩余缓冲执行重叠进行。SlackBatch将由此产生的各机器人执行预算与预估的未完成GPU工作相结合，以确定等待时机、应批处理哪些请求以及何时派发。我们在LIBERO和SimplerEnv的WidowX任务上评估了X-VLA，并在LIBERO上评估了OpenVLA-OFT，模拟多达96台机器人共享一台NVIDIA H200 GPU。在96台机器人场景下，与各模型最低停滞基线相比，MotionServe将每回合平均停滞时间分别降低了43.4%和32.6%，任务成功率分别提升了8.98和2.30个百分点。骨干共享还使96个策略的权重内存分别减少了97.6%和91.1%。

title: PushMimic: Learning Adaptive Humanoid Box Pushing via Dynamic Motion Augmentation and Reference Distillation
summary: Humanoid box pushing is challenging when the physical properties of the task, such as the box mass and the ramp inclination, are unknown before the push begins. This paper presents PushMimic, a framework that learns adaptive humanoid box pushing from a single level-ground kinematic reference motion. The learned policy adapts its pushing posture to these properties without observing them. PushMimic augments the reference motion into a dynamically feasible motion dataset over these properties with sampling-based trajectory optimization, and distills the dataset into one motion tracking policy in one stage of training. Simulation results over box masses from 5 to 15 kg and ramp inclinations up to 15 degrees show that PushMimic raises the success rate from 57.8% to 88.8% compared with a baseline that tracks the original reference motion. It also reduces the cost of push of the arms by 22%. Hardware experiments on a Unitree G1 humanoid show that the policy adapts its torso pitch during continuous pushing on an inclined treadmill, with box masses up to 19 kg and ramp inclinations up to 12.6 degrees. PushMimic therefore needs only one reference motion, instead of one for every box mass and ramp inclination.
tldr: PushMimic learns adaptive humanoid box pushing from a single reference motion by augmenting it into a dynamically feasible dataset via sampling-based trajectory optimization and distilling it into one policy, improving success rate and reducing arm effort in both simulation and real robot experiments.
tldr_zh: PushMimic 通过采样轨迹优化将单一参考动作扩展为动态可行的数据集，并蒸馏为单一策略，使仿人机器人能够自适应不同重量和坡度的推箱任务，显著提高成功率并降低手臂成本。
summary_zh: 仿人推箱在任务物理属性（如箱子质量和坡道倾角）在推动开始前未知时具有挑战性。本文提出了PushMimic，一个从单一水平地面运动学参考动作学习自适应仿人推箱的框架。所学策略无需观测这些属性即可调整其推动姿态。PushMimic通过基于采样的轨迹优化，将参考动作扩展为涵盖这些属性的动态可行动作数据集，并在单阶段训练中将该数据集蒸馏为一个运动跟踪策略。仿真结果显示，在箱子质量5至15千克、坡道倾角最高15度的情况下，与跟踪原始参考动作的基线相比，PushMimic将成功率从57.8%提升至88.8%，同时将手臂推动成本降低了22%。在Unitree G1仿人机器人上的硬件实验表明，该策略能在倾斜跑步机上持续推动过程中调整躯干俯仰角，箱子质量最高达19千克，坡道倾角最高达12.6度。因此，PushMimic仅需一个参考动作，而非针对每种箱子质量和坡道倾角分别提供参考动作。

title: Spiking World-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
summary: World action models (WAMs) predict how the world responds to actions and offer a promising path toward general embodied intelligence, but they are large and run the network many times per plan, so they are hard to deploy on robots. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) compute with sparse binary spikes and use additions instead of multiplications, which saves power. However, existing WAMs use dense videos as the world state, so a spiking version would spend most of its computation on the background. We therefore introduce SpikingWAM, the first spiking WAM, which uses a sparse task skeleton as the world state. Inspired by biological motor control, which attends only to the key positions of a task, the Task Skeleton State (TSS) keeps the keypoints of the arm and the task objects, and a small spiking front end estimates the object keypoints from images. Body Frame Spike Coding (BFSC) and Grid Coincidence Attention (GCA) keep millimetre precision, and the Persistent Single Step Readout (PSR) runs the network once per plan. On the simulated benchmarks LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin 2.0, SpikingWAM achieves competitive success rates with far less energy than ANN methods and surpasses all compared methods on LIBERO-Plus. Real robot experiments further confirm its effectiveness. These results show that a task skeleton lets spiking networks implement WAMs at very low energy, offering a new solution for low power embodied intelligence. Project page: https://wxqnl.github.io/spikingwam/
tldr: SpikingWAM introduces the first spiking world-action model for robotic manipulation, using sparse task skeleton states and energy-efficient spiking neural networks to achieve competitive success rates and significantly lower energy consumption on simulation and real-robot benchmarks.
tldr_zh: SpikingWAM 提出了首个用于机器人操作的脉冲世界动作模型，利用稀疏任务骨架状态和脉冲神经网络，在仿真和真实机器人基准上实现了有竞争力的成功率并大幅降低能耗。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过预测世界对动作的响应，为通用具身智能提供了一条有前景的路径，但这类模型规模庞大，且每次规划需多次运行网络，因此难以部署于机器人上。脉冲神经网络（SNNs）以稀疏二值脉冲进行计算，用加法替代乘法，从而节省功耗。然而，现有WAMs以稠密视频作为世界状态，若采用脉冲版本，其大部分计算将耗费在背景处理上。为此，我们提出了SpikingWAM——首个脉冲WAM，它以稀疏任务骨架作为世界状态。受生物运动控制机制（仅关注任务关键位置）的启发，任务骨架状态（TSS）保留手臂及任务物体的关键点，并通过一个小型脉冲前端从图像中估计物体关键点。体帧脉冲编码（BFSC）与网格重合注意力（GCA）保证了毫米级精度，而持久单步读出（PSR）机制使每次规划仅需运行网络一次。在模拟基准LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus及RoboTwin 2.0上，SpikingWAM以远低于ANN方法的能耗取得了具有竞争力的成功率，并在LIBERO-Plus上超越了所有对比方法。真实机器人实验进一步验证了其有效性。上述结果表明，任务骨架使脉冲网络能够以极低能耗实现WAMs，为低功耗具身智能提供了一种新方案。项目页面：https://wxqnl.github.io/spikingwam/

title: FlexWAM: Learning Flexible Visual Routing for World Action Models
summary: Humans dynamically adjust their reliance on sensory modalities across manipulation stages. Although existing World Action Models (WAMs) fuse multi-camera observations, they struggle to adapt their reliance on individual views based on the current observations. This raises a central question: how can the action expert integrate complementary visual evidence while prioritizing the views most relevant to the current action? FlexWAM addresses this challenge through three modules. First, we alternate within-view and cross-view attention to capture view-specific dynamics and complementary cues. For action prediction, View-Routed Action Attention uses an observation-conditioned router to prioritize relevant views. To calibrate routing, we train a critic using counterfactual view credit, estimated from action loss sensitivity upon suppressing each view's contribution to action attention. We evaluate FlexWAM with two video backbones on five challenging real-world manipulation tasks across two robot platforms. The two variants improve mean task success by 16.4 and 23.0 percentage points over the strongest baseline. Project website: https://flexwam.github.io/.
tldr: FlexWAM introduces a view-routing mechanism for World Action Models that dynamically prioritizes relevant camera views through counterfactual credit assignment, improving multi-view robotic manipulation success on five real-world tasks across two platforms.
tldr_zh: FlexWAM 为世界动作模型引入视图路由机制，通过反事实信用分配动态优先相关相机视图，在两个平台五项真实操作任务中提升成功率。
summary_zh: 人类在操作的不同阶段会动态调整对不同感官模态的依赖。尽管现有的世界动作模型（WAMs）融合了多摄像头观测信息，但它们难以根据当前观测自适应地调整对各视角的依赖程度。这引出了一个核心问题：动作专家如何在优先关注与当前动作最相关的视角的同时，整合互补的视觉证据？FlexWAM通过三个模块解决了这一挑战。首先，我们交替进行视角内与跨视角注意力计算，以捕捉各视角特有的动态信息及互补线索。在动作预测方面，视角路由动作注意力采用基于观测条件的路由器来优先选择相关视角。为校准路由机制，我们训练了一个评论器，利用反事实视角贡献度——通过抑制各视角对动作注意力的贡献时所引起的动作损失敏感性来估计。我们在两个机器人平台的五项具有挑战性的真实世界操作任务上，使用两种视频骨干网络对FlexWAM进行了评估。两种变体在平均任务成功率上分别比最强基线提升了16.4和23.0个百分点。项目网站：https://flexwam.github.io/。

title: MOVER: Planning Beyond Motion
summary: Residual world models forecast a driving scene through its temporal change, so feature components that stay constant over time vanish from the residual pathway. We ask whether evidence with weak temporal change, such as a waiting pedestrian or a stopped vehicle, can be used more effectively for planning, and introduce MOVER, a complementary event-routing mechanism. A training-time teacher measures how each spatially grounded event query responds when a past frame is removed from shared history and contrasts that sensitivity with the event's pooled temporal residual, prioritizing events that depend on history but receive weak residual evidence. A student predicts the resulting priorities from unperturbed history, so the teacher adds no inference cost. Under fixed total routing mass, one distribution scales a low-rank future bird's-eye-view update and biases trajectory-conditioned event reading. On nuScenes, MOVER reduces ResWorld's UniAD-style average L2 from 0.65 to 0.55 m and its collision rate from 0.23% to 0.12% without direct planner ego status (0.50 m and 0.09% with it), adding 4.1 ms per frame. Matched controls show that the complementary teacher outperforms either signal alone and that the allocation acts mainly during training. Adapted to BridgeDrive-LEAD, MOVER reaches a 96.52 +/- 0.65 driving score over three seeds on the 220-route Bench2Drive closed-loop benchmark, exceeding matched controls in each paired seed by a margin within seed variation.
tldr: MOVER introduces a complementary event-routing mechanism that improves residual world models for autonomous driving planning by prioritizing events with weak temporal change, reducing errors and collision rates on nuScenes and improving closed-loop driving scores on Bench2Drive.
tldr_zh: MOVER提出了一种互补事件路由机制，通过优先处理时间变化较弱的驾驶事件，改进残差世界模型的规划性能，在nuScenes上降低误差和碰撞率，并在Bench2Drive闭环基准上提升驾驶分数。
summary_zh: 残差世界模型通过时间变化来预测驾驶场景，因此随时间保持恒定的特征组件会从残差路径中消失。我们探讨了时间变化较弱的证据（例如等待中的行人或停驻的车辆）能否更有效地用于规划，并提出了MOVER——一种互补事件路由机制。在训练阶段，教师模型衡量每个空间锚定事件查询在从共享历史中移除过去帧时的响应变化，并将该敏感性与事件的汇集时间残差进行对比，从而优先处理依赖历史但残差证据较弱的事件。学生模型从未受扰动的历史中预测由此产生的优先级，因此教师模型不增加推理成本。在固定总路由质量下，一个分布对低秩未来鸟瞰图更新进行缩放，并影响轨迹条件化事件读取。在nuScenes数据集上，MOVER将ResWorld的UniAD风格平均L2误差从0.65米降至0.55米，碰撞率从0.23%降至0.12%（结合直接规划器自车状态时为0.50米和0.09%），每帧仅增加4.1毫秒计算时间。配对对照实验表明，互补教师模型优于任一单独信号，且该分配主要在训练阶段发挥作用。当适配至BridgeDrive-LEAD后，MOVER在220条路线的Bench2Drive闭环基准测试中，基于三个随机种子达到96.52±0.65的驾驶评分，在每个配对种子中均以种子内变异范围内的优势超过匹配对照组。

title: MoMa-NMP: Scene-Scale Neural Motion Planning for Mobile Manipulators
summary: Mobile manipulators operating in homes and other complex environments must coordinate their base and arm over long horizons, navigating around obstacles, through narrow passages, and between constrained workspaces. Neural motion planners can provide fast closed-loop planning from partial observations, but scaling them to room-sized environments is difficult because generating high-quality training trajectories is itself a challenging motion-planning problem. To address this, we introduce MoMa-DemoSmith, a demonstration-generation pipeline that separates the problem into global path discovery for large complex scenes and local motion refinement for collision avoidance. This key separation enables the generation of millions of challenging whole-body trajectories across our procedurally generated scenes. We train MoMa-NMP on these demonstrations through behavior cloning (BC) followed by privileged on-policy distillation, achieving 87.0% success on our simulation benchmark and 77.5% across 80 trials in unseen real-world scenes. See video results at https://adamhkan.com/moma-nmp/.
tldr: MoMa-NMP introduces a demonstration-generation pipeline that separates global path discovery from local motion refinement to create millions of whole-body trajectories, then trains a neural motion planner via behavior cloning and privileged on-policy distillation for mobile manipulators, achieving high success in simulation and real-world scenes.
tldr_zh: MoMa-NMP 提出了一种将全局路径发现与局部运动细化分离的演示生成流程，生成数百万个全身轨迹，并通过行为克隆和特权在线蒸馏训练移动操作器的神经运动规划器，在仿真和真实场景中均取得高成功率。
summary_zh: 在家庭及其他复杂环境中运行的移动操作机器人，必须长期协调其基座与机械臂，在躲避障碍物、穿越狭窄通道以及在受限工作空间之间导航。神经运动规划器能够根据部分观测提供快速的闭环规划，但将其扩展到房间大小的环境中较为困难，因为生成高质量的训练轨迹本身就是一个具有挑战性的运动规划问题。为解决这一问题，我们引入了MoMa-DemoSmith，一种演示生成流水线，它将问题分解为大型复杂场景下的全局路径发现和用于避碰的局部运动细化。这种关键分离使得我们能够在程序化生成的场景中生成数百万个具有挑战性的全身轨迹。我们通过行为克隆（BC）及随后的特权在策略蒸馏，在生成的这些演示上训练了MoMa-NMP，在我们的仿真基准测试中达到了87.0%的成功率，并在未见过的真实世界场景的80次试验中达到了77.5%的成功率。视频结果见 https://adamhkan.com/moma-nmp/。

title: UnderGrasp: Envelopment-Oriented Grasp Refinement for an Underactuated Gripper
summary: Underactuated grippers can form enveloping grasps through passive compliance, while the terminal pose and single width predicted by generic grasp generators do not fully capture the approach-closure process. Conventional collision filtering also struggles to distinguish harmful interference from acceptable contact. We present UnderGrasp, a post-hoc grasp refinement and evaluation framework for an underactuated gripper that reuses grasp candidates and quality priors from a frozen generator. The model jointly encodes the target, local environment, support surface, and approach-path geometry to propose diverse combinations of insertion depth, pre-grasp width, and target closing width for each candidate. These actions are ranked by combining separately predicted envelopment and interaction quality with upstream priors, balancing grasp feasibility, envelopment, and scene disturbance rather than rejecting all environmental contact. The back end is trained solely on configuration and interaction labels generated by gripper-specific simulations, without real-robot grasp labels. Real-robot experiments with an underactuated gripper show that UnderGrasp improves the overall success rate (SR) and the envelopment rate (ER) among successful grasps from 0.55/0.12 to 0.82/0.55 with AnyGrasp, and from 0.42/0.08 to 0.65/0.36 with GraspNet. In contrast, increasing the fixed insertion depth to 40 mm improves ER to 0.35 but reduces SR to 0.52, supporting the value of adaptive refinement. For trials involving target or environmental contact during approach, the conditional success rates increase from 0.36 to 0.89 and from 0.25 to 0.86, respectively, demonstrating more reliable execution under contact. Project page: https://dishenliu2004-hub.github.io/undergrasp-site/
tldr: UnderGrasp is a post-hoc grasp refinement and evaluation framework for underactuated grippers that adaptively proposes insertion depth and closing widths, and ranks candidates by predicted envelopment and interaction quality, improving real-robot grasp success and envelopment rates versus generic grasp generators.
tldr_zh: UnderGrasp 是一个针对欠驱动抓手的后置抓取优化与评估框架，自适应提出插入深度和闭合宽度，并根据预测的包络和交互质量对候选排序，在真实机器人上提升了抓取成功率和包络率。
summary_zh: 欠驱动抓取器能够通过被动顺应性形成包覆抓取，而通用抓取生成器预测的末端位姿和单一宽度并未完全捕捉接近-闭合过程。传统的碰撞过滤也难以区分有害干涉与可接受的接触。我们提出了UnderGrasp，一个针对欠驱动抓取器的后置抓取优化与评估框架，该框架复用冻结生成器中的抓取候选和质量先验。该模型联合编码目标物体、局部环境、支撑表面以及接近路径几何结构，为每个候选生成插入深度、预抓取宽度和目标闭合宽度的多样化组合。这些动作通过将分别预测的包覆质量和交互质量与上游先验相结合进行排序，在抓取可行性、包覆程度和场景扰动之间取得平衡，而非拒绝所有环境接触。后端仅在由特定抓取器仿真生成的配置和交互标签上训练，无需真实机器人抓取标签。使用欠驱动抓取器的真实机器人实验表明，UnderGrasp将总体成功率（SR）和成功抓取中的包覆率（ER）从AnyGrasp的0.55/0.12提升至0.82/0.55，从GraspNet的0.42/0.08提升至0.65/0.36。相比之下，将固定插入深度增加至40 mm可将ER提升至0.35，但SR降至0.52，这验证了自适应优化的价值。对于接近过程中涉及目标或环境接触的试验，条件成功率分别从0.36提升至0.89、从0.25提升至0.86，表明在接触条件下的执行更加可靠。项目页面：https://dishenliu2004-hub.github.io/undergrasp-site/

title: Motion Mamba 2.0: Autoregressive Diffusion Mamba for Long-Horizon Humanoid Control
summary: Long-horizon, real-time controllable motion generation is essential for interactive animation and humanoid robotics, where an agent must respond to changing instructions and spatial goals while moving. Existing autoregressive diffusion methods generate motion incrementally, but bounded attention caches limit access to distant history, while repeated denoising introduces substantial inference overhead. We present Motion Mamba 2.0, a Mamba-based root-body diffusion architecture that integrates local attention, resumable recurrent states, and persistent content memory (PCM) for long-horizon controllable motion generation. PCM transforms compressed motion history from Mamba recurrent states, together with state changes and text-conditioned features, into dynamically updated content slots accessible to local attention. To enable efficient inference, we further develop an execution scheme tailored to this architecture, combining CUDA Graph replay, fused kernels, and execution-flow simplification while preserving the canonical history update. Evaluations on retargeted HiPHI demonstrate accurate terminal control over rollouts of up to 39.52 s, while short-horizon comparisons on BONES Seed and retargeted HumanML3D show that the model also retains strong spatial control and text-motion matching. On an RTX 4090, the optimized execution reduces median complete-window latency from 1685.35 to 276.14 ms, achieving a median paired speedup of 6.138$\times$ while preserving identical outputs and committed states in the tested rollouts. Moreover, we conduct extensive real-world evaluation on the Unitree G1, demonstrating sequential text-guided action composition, expressive motion, and interactive locomotion through keyboard and mouse control.
tldr: This paper introduces Motion Mamba 2.0, a Mamba-based diffusion architecture with persistent content memory and optimized inference for long-horizon, text-conditioned humanoid control, validated on both simulation and real-world Unitree G1 robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Motion Mamba 2.0，一种基于Mamba的扩散架构，具有持久内容记忆和优化推理，用于长时程、文本条件的人形控制，并在仿真和真实宇树G1机器人上验证。
summary_zh: 长视野、实时可控的运动生成对于交互式动画和人形机器人至关重要，在此类应用中，智能体必须在移动过程中响应不断变化的指令和空间目标。现有的自回归扩散方法能够增量生成运动，但有界注意力缓存限制了对远距离历史的访问，而重复去噪则带来了大量推理开销。我们提出Motion Mamba 2.0，一种基于Mamba的根节点-身体扩散架构，集成了局部注意力、可恢复的循环状态和持久内容记忆（PCM），用于长视野可控运动生成。PCM将Mamba循环状态中的压缩运动历史、状态变化以及文本条件特征转换为动态更新的内容槽，供局部注意力访问。为实现高效推理，我们进一步开发了一种针对该架构定制的执行方案，结合CUDA Graph重放、融合内核和执行流简化，同时保留规范的历史更新。在重定向后的HiPHI上的评估表明，该方法在长达39.52秒的推演中实现了精确的终端控制，而在BONES Seed和重定向后的HumanML3D上的短视野比较显示，该模型还保持了强大的空间控制和文本-运动匹配能力。在RTX 4090上，优化后的执行将中位完整窗口延迟从1685.35毫秒降至276.14毫秒，实现了6.138倍的中位配对加速，同时在测试推演中保持完全相同的输出和已提交状态。此外，我们在Unitree G1上进行了广泛的真实世界评估，展示了通过键盘和鼠标控制实现的顺序文本引导动作组合、表现力丰富的运动以及交互式移动。

title: ProMix: Efficient Data Mixture Optimization for Robotic Imitation via Proxy-Reference DRO
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel in open-world manipulation, yet their performance often saturates when training data are naively pooled across heterogeneous robots, tasks, and environments. Distributionally robust data mixture optimization, exemplified by Re-Mix, can recover much of this performance, but its weight search requires training full-scale policies twice on the entire corpus, placing it out of reach for most laboratories. We present ProMix, a compute-efficient instantiation of the proxy-reference DRO recipe for robotic imitation learning: a 15M-parameter proxy learns per-domain sampling weights by minimizing worst-case excess loss against a frozen reference model, and the learned weights transfer, without re-tuning, to VLA backbones up to 7B parameters. We further provide, to our knowledge, the first controlled analysis of the reference model's role in robotic DRO, showing that removing it induces over-pessimism toward noisy, low-quality domains (-3.8% average and -14.3% worst-domain success rate), and that entropy regularization is needed to prevent weight collapse. Evaluated on 9500 real-world episodes from the Open-X Embodiment dataset, ProMix improves the average success rate over uniform mixing from 68.4% to 76.2%, matching Re-Mix within evaluation noise while reducing mixture-optimization cost to a backbone-independent 11 GPU-hours - versus 16 GPU-hours at the 50M comparison scale and 192 GPU-hours at 7B for full-scale searches - with a +17.1% absolute gain on the worst-case domain.
tldr: ProMix introduces a compute-efficient proxy-reference DRO method for optimizing data mixtures in robotic imitation learning, using a small proxy model to learn domain sampling weights that transfer to large VLA models, achieving Re-Mix-level performance at a fraction of the cost.
tldr_zh: ProMix提出了一种计算高效的代理参考分布鲁棒优化方法，用于机器人模仿学习中的数据混合优化，通过小型代理模型学习领域采样权重并迁移至大型VLA模型，以极低的计算成本达到与Re-Mix相当的性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在开放世界操控任务中表现出色，然而，当训练数据被简单混合自异构机器人、任务和环境时，其性能往往趋于饱和。以Re-Mix为代表的分布鲁棒数据混合优化方法能够显著恢复部分性能损失，但其权重搜索需要对整个语料库进行两轮全规模策略训练，这使得大多数实验室难以负担。我们提出ProMix，一种面向机器人模仿学习的代理-参考分布鲁棒优化（DRO）框架的高效计算实现：一个1500万参数的代理模型通过最小化相对于冻结参考模型的最坏情况超额损失来学习各领域采样权重，且学习到的权重无需重新调整即可迁移至参数规模高达70亿的VLA骨干网络。此外，我们首次对参考模型在机器人DRO中的作用进行了受控分析，结果表明，移除参考模型会导致对噪声大、质量低的领域产生过度悲观估计（平均成功率下降3.8%，最差领域下降14.3%），且需要熵正则化以防止权重崩塌。在来自Open-X Embodiment数据集的9500条真实世界轨迹上进行的评估显示，ProMix将平均成功率从均匀混合的68.4%提升至76.2%，在评估噪声范围内与Re-Mix持平，同时将混合优化成本降低至与骨干网络无关的11 GPU小时——相比之下，在5000万参数比较尺度上全规模搜索需16 GPU小时，在70亿参数尺度上需192 GPU小时——并且在最差领域上实现了+17.1%的绝对提升。

title: Arcadian: Open-Source Humanoid Ecosystem for Accessible and Customizable Research and Education
summary: Reproducing and modifying a meter-scale humanoid remains challenging for research and teaching groups with limited fabrication resources and engineering support. This paper presents Arcadian, an open-source humanoid ecosystem that offers accessible and customizable humanoid hardware and software with community support. Arcadian aims to strike a balance among cost-effectiveness, structural durability, and full customizability, lowering the barrier to entry for research and education. Specifically, this meter-scale humanoid adopts metal-embedded 3D printing to achieve a high strength-to-cost ratio, eliminating the need for computer numerical control (CNC) machining while retaining design flexibility. Extensive simulation and hardware tests validate the design: a reinforcement-learning (RL) locomotion policy trained in simulation transfers to the hardware, and a virtual reality (VR) teleoperation interface drives both arms for simple manipulation tasks. The robot is around one meter tall and costs approximately $6,800 to build. All computer-aided design (CAD) models, the bill of materials, assembly documentation, and training and deployment code are publicly released, distributed through Tnkr.ai and MakerWorld and supported by a Discord server and a project forum through which community feedback informs design updates. The ecosystem resources are available at https://anonymous-humanoid.gitbook.io/docs.
tldr: This paper presents Arcadian, an open-source, meter-scale humanoid robot ecosystem with metal-embedded 3D printing for cost-effective and customizable hardware, validated by RL locomotion and VR teleoperation, targeting accessible research and education.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Arcadian，一个开源、米级人形机器人生态系统，采用金属嵌入3D打印实现高性价比和可定制硬件，并通过RL运动与VR遥操作验证，旨在降低研究与教育门槛。
summary_zh: 再现和改造米级人形机器人，对于制造资源与工程支持有限的研究和教学团队而言，仍是一大挑战。本文介绍了Arcadian，一个开源人形机器人生态系统，提供可获取且可定制的人形机器人硬件与软件，并配有社区支持。Arcadian旨在实现成本效益、结构耐用性和全面可定制性之间的平衡，降低研究和教育领域的入门门槛。具体而言，这款米级人形机器人采用金属嵌入式3D打印技术，实现了高强度与成本比的优化，无需计算机数控（CNC）加工，同时保留了设计灵活性。大量仿真与硬件测试验证了该设计：在仿真中训练的强化学习（RL）运动策略可成功迁移至硬件，虚拟现实（VR）遥操作界面可驱动双臂完成简单操作任务。该机器人身高约一米，制造成本约为6,800美元。所有计算机辅助设计（CAD）模型、物料清单、装配文档以及训练和部署代码均已公开，通过Tnkr.ai和MakerWorld平台分发，并配有Discord服务器和项目论坛，社区反馈可指导设计更新。生态系统资源可在https://anonymous-humanoid.gitbook.io/docs获取。

title: Dynamics Forcing: Mitigating Error Accumulation in Causal Video World Models
summary: Causal video world models generate block by block from their own previous outputs. Small errors in early blocks are fed back as history and grow until the scene and the robot fall apart. Teacher forcing trains on clean ground-truth history, so the model never sees the history it will actually condition on, and it also finds a shortcut: copying the previous frame instead of predicting how the scene changes. We present Dynamics Forcing, a training scheme that keeps real video as the only supervision and reshapes how history is presented. History is perturbed in three ways: random noising, self-resampling by the model itself, and joint denoising, in which the most recent blocks are still partly noisy when the next block is predicted. On top of this we move history guidance and first-frame anchor guidance from inference into training, so that the model is pushed to use its history and its reference frame rather than ignore them. Dynamics Forcing needs no teacher model, no distillation, and no additional model at inference. Applied to a 5B video model with LoRA on 77 hours of manipulation video on a single GPU, it better matches unseen real continuations and reduces error accumulation.
tldr: This paper proposes Dynamics Forcing, a training scheme for causal video world models that perturbs history via random noising, self-resampling, and joint denoising, and incorporates history and first-frame guidance into training. Applied to a 5B video model on manipulation videos, it reduces error accumulation and better matches real continuations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出动力学强迫（Dynamics Forcing），一种针对因果视频世界模型的训练方案，通过随机噪声、自身重采样和联合去噪来扰动历史，并在训练中加入历史引导和首帧锚定引导。应用于操作视频的5B模型，减少了误差累积并更接近真实连续结果。
summary_zh: 因果视频世界模型会从自身之前的输出出发，逐块生成内容。早期块中的微小误差会作为历史信息被反馈回来，并不断累积，直到场景和机器人崩溃。教师强迫（Teacher Forcing）在干净的、基于真实值的历史数据上进行训练，因此模型从未见过它实际将依赖的历史信息，并且还会找到一条捷径：复制前一帧而不是预测场景的变化。我们提出了动态强迫（Dynamics Forcing）训练方案，该方案保持真实视频作为唯一的监督信号，并重新调整了历史信息的呈现方式。历史信息通过三种方式被扰动：随机加噪、模型自身的自我重采样，以及联合去噪——在预测下一块时，最近的块仍部分带有噪声。在此基础上，我们将历史引导和首帧锚定引导从推理阶段移至训练阶段，从而促使模型利用其历史信息和参考帧，而不是忽略它们。动态强迫（Dynamics Forcing）不需要教师模型，不需要蒸馏，推理时也无需额外模型。我们将该方法应用于一个50亿参数的视频模型，使用LoRA在单块GPU上对77小时的操作视频进行训练，实验结果表明，该方法能更好地匹配未见过的真实后续帧，并减少误差累积。

title: Generating Safety-Critical Driving Scenarios from Role-Typed Signal Temporal Logic Specifications Drafted by Large Language Models
summary: Safety-critical scenarios are rare in recorded driving and must be generated to test and train motion planners of automated vehicles. In guided diffusion models, each scenario type needs its own weighted objective, separate from the validity check. Optimized together with the attacker, the vehicle under test can cancel the attack or draw it toward itself. We state each scenario as a signal temporal logic specification with clauses typed by role. Every clause names the agent it may change and the agents it may read, and the vehicle under test reads the attacker only from the attack onset. A large language model drafts the specification from a description, and a type checker accepts it. A compiler derives the optimization: it edits a diffusion model's samples by the smallest change that satisfies the specification, each clause moves only its owner, the attacker is solved against the unreacted vehicle under test before its response, and the monitor of the same specification decides acceptance. On nuScenes and CommonRoad, judged independently of the specification, one parameter set produced valid scenarios at a rate 0.14 above a weighted objective tuned per scenario type, and descriptions yielded at least one valid scenario for 11 of the 16 pre-crash types expressible in the public data. Learned planners fail more often on the generated scenarios than on their seeds. Fine-tuning on them lowers a planner's failure rate on critical scenarios, and the time headway one clause of the label requires, not the generator, sets the size of the gain.
tldr: This paper presents a method to generate safety-critical driving scenarios by using large language models to draft role-typed signal temporal logic specifications, which are then compiled into guided diffusion sample edits for adversarial testing of motion planners.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用大型语言模型起草角色类型信号时序逻辑规范，并编译为引导扩散样本编辑以生成安全关键驾驶场景的方法，用于对抗性测试运动规划器。
summary_zh: 安全关键场景在实际记录的驾驶数据中极为罕见，因此必须生成此类场景，以测试和训练自动驾驶汽车的运动规划器。在引导扩散模型中，每种场景类型都需要其各自的加权目标，并与有效性检查相互独立。当攻击者与受测车辆被联合优化时，受测车辆可能抵消攻击，亦可能将攻击引向自身。我们将每个场景表述为一种信号时序逻辑规范，其中子句按角色类型化。每个子句指明其可修改的主体以及其可读取的主体，且受测车辆仅从攻击开始时刻起读取攻击者的信息。大型语言模型根据描述草拟规范，并由类型检查器予以接受。编译器推导出优化过程：它通过满足规范的最小改动来编辑扩散模型的样本，每个子句仅移动其所属主体，攻击者在受测车辆未作出反应之前即被求解，而同一规范的监控器决定是否接受生成结果。在nuScenes和CommonRoad数据集上，独立于规范进行评判时，一组参数生成的有效场景比例比针对每种场景类型单独调优的加权目标高出0.14；在公共数据可表达的16种预碰撞类型中，描述方法为其中11种生成了至少一个有效场景。学习型规划器在生成的场景上的失败率高于其在种子场景上的失败率。基于这些场景进行微调可降低规划器在关键场景中的失败率，而收益的大小由标签中某一子句所需的时间车头时距决定，而非生成器本身。

title: CarlHOI: Counterfactual Predictive Imagination for Generalizable Multi-Humanoid Object Interaction under Constrained Environments
summary: Recent advances in physics-based humanoid control enable teams of varying sizes to coordinate their movements and cooperatively transport shared objects. However, adapting learned cooperative behaviors to unseen environmental constraints remains challenging, particularly when obstacles require coordinated detours and changes in team configuration. We propose CarlHOI, a counterfactual predictive imagination framework built upon a counterfactual-anchored relational latent world model (CarlWM) for human-object interaction (HOI), enabling multi-humanoid teams to adapt to unseen environmental constraints without retraining their underlying cooperative control policies. CarlHOI explicitly represents the shared object, individual humanoids, and environmental obstacles as interacting entities. Trained offline using counterfactual simulator rollouts, the model imagines alternative collective futures under different shared waypoint commands, predicting how the coupled humanoid team and object would respond. By evaluating these imagined outcomes through predicted progress, failure, and contact risks, and long-horizon value estimates, CarlHOI selects adaptive guidance commands while preserving the pretrained cooperative controller. We introduce a benchmark comprising three challenging obstacle-constrained transport tasks to evaluate adaptation and generalization. Despite being trained exclusively with four humanoids, our model generalizes without retraining to teams of two to ten humanoids, unseen obstacle geometries and placements, unseen objects, and novel combinations of environmental constraints. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved cooperative transport success over evaluated baselines across diverse configurations. Results highlight the potential of counterfactual predictive imagination to extend pretrained multi-humanoid cooperative skills beyond their original training conditions.
tldr: CarlHOI introduces a counterfactual predictive imagination framework with a latent world model, enabling multi-humanoid teams to cooperatively transport shared objects under unseen environmental constraints without retraining their pretrained cooperative policies. The model generalizes to varying team sizes, obstacle configurations, and object types.
tldr_zh: CarlHOI提出了一个基于反事实预测想象和潜在世界模型的框架，使多个人形机器人团队能够在未见过的环境约束下协作搬运共享物体，而无需重新训练其预训练协作策略。该模型可泛化到不同团队规模、障碍物配置和物体类型。
summary_zh: 近期在基于物理的人形机器人控制领域取得的进展，使得不同规模的人形机器人团队能够协调其运动并合作搬运共享物体。然而，将学到的协作行为适应于未见过的环境约束仍然具有挑战性，特别是当障碍物要求协调绕行和改变团队配置时。我们提出了CarlHOI，一种基于反事实锚定关系潜在世界模型（CarlWM）的反事实预测想象框架，用于人-物交互（HOI），使多人形机器人团队能够在无需重新训练其底层协作控制策略的情况下适应未见过的环境约束。CarlHOI将共享物体、个体人形机器人和环境障碍物显式表示为相互交互的实体。通过使用反事实模拟器轨迹进行离线训练，该模型在不同共享路径点命令下想象替代性的集体未来，预测耦合的人形机器人团队及物体将如何响应。通过预测的进展、失败和接触风险以及长时程价值估计来评估这些想象结果，CarlHOI在保持预训练协作控制器的同时选择自适应引导命令。我们引入了一个包含三个具有挑战性的障碍约束搬运任务的基准测试，以评估适应性和泛化能力。尽管仅使用四个人形机器人进行训练，我们的模型无需重新训练即可泛化到两到十个人形机器人的团队、未见过的障碍物几何形状和位置、未见过的物体以及环境约束的新颖组合。大量实验表明，在不同配置下，相较于评估的基线方法，协作搬运成功率有所提高。结果凸显了反事实预测想象在将预训练的多人形机器人协作技能扩展到其原始训练条件之外方面的潜力。

title: SparQ4D: Learning to Act through Sparse 4D Queries
summary: Successful manipulation requires a policy to understand where things are and how they will move, yet action demonstrations leave this spatiotemporal structure implicit. While explicit 4D supervision has proven effective, reducing the cost of dense 4D prediction remains challenging. This paper introduces SparQ4D, a lightweight yet expressive decoder that efficiently injects holistic 4D scene understanding into policies and improves success rates. At its core is a query-based decoder attached to a pretrained policy, which casts many spatialtemporal tasks into one unified interface (e.g. depth, 2D/3D point motion, multi-view correspondence, and hand-eye relations). This design enables efficient training and inference without sacrificing expressivity: the policy learns rich 4D structure from a small number of sampled queries during training, while the decoder can be removed at inference with zero additional overhead. Across multiple backbones, simulated environments, and real-world settings, SparQ4D achieves state-of-the-art manipulation performance, outperforming competing methods while training up to $5\times$ faster. Probing analyses further reveal that this 4D structure is recoverable from the policy.
tldr: SparQ4D introduces a lightweight query-based decoder that injects sparse 4D scene understanding (depth, motion, correspondence) into pretrained robot policies, improving manipulation success rates with faster training and zero inference overhead.
tldr_zh: SparQ4D 提出一种轻量级基于查询的解码器，将稀疏4D场景理解（深度、运动、对应关系）注入预训练机器人策略，提升操作成功率并实现更快训练和零推理开销。
summary_zh: 成功的操控需要一个策略来理解物体的位置及其运动方式，然而动作演示并未明确呈现这种时空结构。尽管显式的4D监督已被证明有效，但降低密集4D预测的成本仍具挑战性。本文提出SparQ4D，一种轻量且富有表现力的解码器，能够高效地将整体4D场景理解注入策略中，并提升任务成功率。其核心是一个基于查询的解码器，附加在预训练策略之上，将多种时空任务统一到同一接口中（例如深度、2D/3D点运动、多视图对应关系以及手眼关系）。该设计在不牺牲表现力的前提下实现了高效的训练与推理：策略在训练期间从少量采样的查询中学习丰富的4D结构，而解码器在推理时可完全移除，不增加任何额外开销。在多种骨干网络、模拟环境及真实世界场景中，SparQ4D均取得了最先进的操控性能，在超越竞争方法的同时，训练速度提升高达5倍。进一步的分析实验表明，这种4D结构可从策略中恢复。

title: Grounded in Contact: Reducing Floating and Interpenetration Artifacts with Multimodal Skill-Effect Models
summary: Learning to predict the effects of contact-rich manipulation skills requires models that represent distinct outcome modes rather than a single expected result. Even for basic skills such as pushing, picking, and placing, small variations in contact conditions or object geometry can produce qualitatively different object motions under nearly identical states and actions. Deterministic and Gaussian models tend to average over these alternatives or represent them as a single broad distribution, obscuring distinct modes such as sliding, toppling, and rotating. We study probabilistic skill-effect models that learn multimodal distributions over object pose changes given partial point clouds and actions. We instantiate this abstraction with three representative model classes: mixture density networks, state tokenization, and flow matching, each paired with latent dynamics for next-step prediction. Across diverse objects and skills, explicitly multimodal models predict which outcome occurs more accurately than deterministic and Gaussian baselines. In planning, flow matching significantly improves task success over the deterministic baseline on every skill and achieves the highest success on every multi-step sequence. On a real robot, probabilistic models succeed at pick about twice as often as the deterministic baseline, providing evidence that probabilistic skill effects offer a practical abstraction for reasoning and planning under uncertainty.
tldr: This paper introduces probabilistic skill-effect models for contact-rich manipulation that learn multimodal distributions over object pose changes, and demonstrates that explicitly multimodal models (especially flow matching) outperform deterministic and Gaussian baselines in planning and real-robot pick tasks, reducing floating and interpenetration artifacts.
tldr_zh: 本文提出用于接触丰富操作的概率技能效应模型，学习物体位姿变化的多模态分布，并证明显式多模态模型（尤其是流匹配）在规划和真实机器人拾取任务中优于确定性和高斯基线，减少了浮动和穿透伪影。
summary_zh: 学习预测接触丰富的操作技能的效果，需要能够表征不同结果模式而非单一预期结果的模型。即便是推、抓取和放置这类基础技能，接触条件或物体几何形状的微小变化，也可能在几乎相同的状态和动作下，导致物体运动产生质的差异。确定性模型和高斯模型往往会对这些可能性进行平均处理，或将其表示为单一的宽泛分布，从而掩盖了滑动、倾倒和旋转等不同的模式。我们研究了概率技能效果模型，该模型能够在给定部分点云和动作的情况下，学习物体位姿变化的多模态分布。我们通过三种具有代表性的模型类别来实现这一抽象：混合密度网络、状态标记化和流匹配，每一种都结合了潜在动力学进行下一步预测。在多样化的物体和技能上，显式的多模态模型在预测实际发生的结果方面比确定性和高斯基线模型更为准确。在规划方面，流匹配在每项技能上的任务成功率均显著优于确定性基线，并且在每一个多步骤序列上都取得了最高的成功率。在真实机器人上，概率模型在抓取任务中的成功率约为确定性基线的两倍，这为概率技能效果在不确定性条件下进行推理和规划提供了实用抽象的有力证据。

title: Boltz-Flow: Generating High-Quality Robot Action from Boltzmann Machine
summary: Flow-matching policies integrate a velocity field from a fixed, observation-independent Gaussian source. However, since the source is unimodal and identical across all tasks, the limited representational capacity of Gaussian distributions constrains how far a policy can scale with growing task diversity. Moreover, the source factorizes over time steps and control dimensions, discarding the coordination that manipulation requires. We introduce Boltz-Flow, which replaces Gaussian initialization with a more powerful, observation- and instruction-conditioned Boltzmann source while leaving the base VLA unchanged. Boltz-Flow parameterizes this source with a conditional Boltzmann machine that assigns an energy value to each binary source state. A listwise objective, supervised entirely by offline demonstrations, aligns this energy with the quality of actions produced after frozen flow integration. At inference, the energy defines an Ising instance whose solution is decoded into continuous noise before a single standard integration. We use a physical coherent Ising machine during training. Experiments show that Boltz-Flow improves $π_{0.5}$ across three benchmarks, outperforming the compared strong policy baselines and competing noise optimization methods on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 and ranking second only to LEAP on LIBERO-Plus. Additional experiments show gains under noise-adapted fine-tuning, with action-to-action warm starts, and on the SmolVLA backbone.
tldr: Boltz-Flow replaces the Gaussian noise source in flow-matching VLA policies with a conditional Boltzmann machine that is trained to sample task-specific, high-quality action-initializing noise, improving manipulation performance across benchmarks.
tldr_zh: Boltz-Flow用条件玻尔兹曼机替代流匹配VLA策略中的高斯噪声源，通过训练使其采样任务相关的高质量动作初始化噪声，在多个操纵基准上提升性能。
summary_zh: 流匹配策略从一个固定的、与观测无关的高斯源整合速度场。然而，由于该源是单峰的且在所有任务间相同，高斯分布的有限表示能力限制了策略随任务多样性增长而扩展的程度。此外，该源在时间步和控制维度上因子化，丢弃了操作所需的协调性。我们提出了Boltz-Flow，用更强大的、以观测和指令为条件的玻尔兹曼源替代高斯初始化，同时保持基础VLA不变。Boltz-Flow使用条件玻尔兹曼机对该源进行参数化，为每个二值源状态分配一个能量值。一个完全由离线示范监督的列表级目标，将该能量与冻结流整合后生成的动作质量对齐。在推理时，该能量定义了一个Ising实例，其解在单次标准整合前被解码为连续噪声。我们在训练期间使用物理相干Ising机。实验表明，Boltz-Flow在三个基准上提升了$π_{0.5}$，在LIBERO和RoboTwin 2.0上优于所比较的强策略基线和竞争性噪声优化方法，在LIBERO-Plus上仅次于LEAP排名第二。额外实验显示，在噪声自适应微调、动作到动作的热启动以及SmolVLA骨干上的增益。

title: ActField: Learning Action Effects as Continuous-Time Latent Dynamics
summary: Learning how actions change visual states is essential for prediction and decision-making in embodied tasks. Existing action-conditioned JEPA world models typically predict future representations at discrete observation intervals, leaving the temporal evolution of action effects implicit. We introduce ActField, a continuous-time JEPA world model that explicitly models latent state evolution through an action-conditioned vector field integrated over physical time. ActField separates action-independent evolution from action-induced changes, with the latter modulated by the latent context. A reference-conditioned representation and multi-step dynamics loss further support accurate long-horizon prediction.
