summary_zh:
基于Mooring将标定流程分解为建模、测量、辨识与补偿四个阶段的理论框架，本文探讨了分析式运动学模型转换算法在标定框架中的作用及其提升标定性能的潜力。研究选取四种具有代表性和广泛引用的运动学模型：Denavit-Hartenberg (DH)、Hayati (HAY)、Complete and Parametrically Continuous (CPC) 以及 Product of Exponentials (POE)。对现有转换关系的系统分析表明，尽管这些模型之间的大多数转换已在文献中建立，但POE与HAY之间以及CPC与HAY之间的直接分析式转换仍然缺失。转而依赖现有的POE-DH和DH-HAY转换的序贯组合则会引入若干局限性。为弥补这一空白，本文基于李群理论构建了POE-HAY与HAY-CPC模型之间的构造性分析转换方法，并通过一系列引理和命题予以正式论证。

利用RRRP型SCARA机器人和RRHHHH型Puma 560机械臂对所提算法进行了验证。将直接POE-HAY转换与序贯POE-DH-HAY方法及HAY-CPC方法从多个相关准则维度进行比较，结果表明所提方案具有显著优势。最后，在ABB IRB 1600机械臂上开展了开环运动学标定实验，采用API Radian EMSD3激光跟踪仪进行测量，验证了完整分析式转换框架的实际应用价值。实验结果表明，合理的模型选择结合完整的分析式转换方案可直接提升标定精度。

title: Can Multimodal Fusion MakeSense for Embodied Vision in Degraded Sensing?
summary: Embodied vision systems rely on complementary sensors to perceive and act as conditions change. Even models that accept arbitrary sensor subsets can exhibit negative fusion: adding a sensor increases prediction error. We propose MakeSense, a multimodal fusion framework that preserves sensor-specific evidence in private streams and combines information through shared bottleneck tokens. Training pairs full and subset views of the same degraded observations, penalizing higher error with more sensors. Where geometry permits, the distance readout uses range measurements alone, while the rest of the prediction draws on all available inputs. Paired tests across five datasets reveal helpful and harmful sensor additions. MakeSense reduces negative fusion on MM-Fi. With lightweight adapters and per-dataset training, the same design improves UAV localization on MMAUD, cooperative 3D detection on V2X-Real, few-shot pose transfer to RELI11D, and command prediction on Humanoid-Everyday, where a world model trained on the frozen core's outputs forecasts future fused states more accurately than a linear baseline at longer tested horizons. MakeSense supports embodied sensing across human activity, aerial systems, robotics, and autonomous driving.
tldr: MakeSense is a multimodal fusion framework that preserves sensor-specific evidence and penalizes negative fusion, improving embodied perception and command prediction across diverse tasks including UAV localization, cooperative 3D detection, and humanoid control.
tldr_zh: MakeSense提出了一种多模态融合框架，通过保留传感器特定证据并惩罚负融合，提升了无人机定位、协同3D检测和人形机器人控制等多种具身感知任务的性能。
summary_zh: 具身视觉系统依赖互补传感器，在条件变化时进行感知与行动。即使能够接受任意传感器子集的模型，也可能出现负融合现象：增加传感器反而导致预测误差上升。我们提出MakeSense，一种多模态融合框架，在私有流中保留传感器特定证据，并通过共享瓶颈令牌整合信息。训练过程中，将完整视图与子集视图配对，输入相同的退化观测数据，对传感器更多但误差更大的情况施加惩罚。在几何条件允许时，距离读数仅依赖测距传感器，其余预测则利用所有可用输入。在五个数据集上的配对测试揭示了有益与有害的传感器新增情况。MakeSense在MM-Fi数据集上减少了负融合现象。借助轻量级适配器和逐数据集训练，同一设计在MMAUD上提升了无人机定位性能，在V2X-Real上改善了协同三维检测，在RELI11D上实现了少样本姿态迁移，并在Humanoid-Everyday上提升了指令预测能力。在Humanoid-Everyday中，基于冻结核心输出训练的世界模型，在较长的测试时域上对未来融合状态的预测比线性基线更为准确。MakeSense支持跨人类活动、空中系统、机器人和自动驾驶领域的具身感知应用。

title: EgoDepth-Bench: Benchmarking Metric Depth for Egocentric Manipulation
summary: We introduce EgoDepth-Bench, comprising 941,233 synchronized samples collected across 37 distinct physical environments. Each sample combines six calibrated RGB views with metric depth in the native fisheye view, reconstructed from five active-infrared stereo modules. A calibrated ball-bar confirms millimeter-level geometric accuracy, with a median error of 1.27 mm on a known sphere spacing. Environment-held-out splits enable evaluation of generalization to unseen environments. Across monocular, stereo, and multi-view models, the benchmark measures both depth accuracy and prediction coverage, including on hands and objects. Fine-tuning MapAnything on EgoDepth-Bench reduces metric AbsRel from 0.708 to 0.091 and scale-aligned AbsRel from 0.327 to 0.072 on unseen environments. These results demonstrate that EgoDepth-Bench provides effective supervision and enables rigorous evaluation of metric and relative depth estimation in egocentric manipulation. The project page provides the evaluation code and interactive RGB-depth sequences.
tldr: Introduces a large-scale egocentric manipulation dataset with multi-view RGB and metric depth, and benchmarks depth estimation models, showing significant improvement after fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 提出了一个大规模第一人称操作数据集，包含多视角RGB和度量深度，并基准测试了深度估计模型，微调后性能显著提升。
summary_zh: 我们提出了EgoDepth-Bench，该基准数据集包含在37个不同物理环境中收集的941,233个同步样本。每个样本将六个经过标定的RGB视图与原生鱼眼视图中的度量深度相结合，这些深度数据由五个主动红外立体模块重建而来。经标定的球杆仪验证，其几何精度达到毫米级，在已知球体间距上的中值误差为1.27毫米。通过环境留出划分，该基准能够评估模型对未见环境的泛化能力。在单目、立体及多视图模型上，该基准同时衡量深度精度和预测覆盖率，包括对手部和物体的预测。在EgoDepth-Bench上对MapAnything进行微调后，其在未见环境中的度量绝对相对误差（AbsRel）从0.708降至0.091，尺度对齐的绝对相对误差从0.327降至0.072。这些结果表明，EgoDepth-Bench能够提供有效的监督信号，并支持对自我中心操作中度量深度和相对深度估计进行严格评估。项目页面提供了评估代码及交互式RGB-深度序列。

title: Autonomous UAV Navigation in an Unknown Environment via Multi-Trajectory Model Predictive Control
summary: A novel model predictive control (MPC) formulation, named multi-trajectory MPC (mt-MPC), is presented and applied to the problem of autonomous navigation of an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) in an unknown environment. The UAV is equipped with a LiDAR sensor, providing only a partial description of the surroundings and resulting in time-varying constraints as the vehicle navigates among the obstacles. The control system layout is hierarchical: the low-level loops stabilize the vehicle's trajectories and track the set-points commanded by the high-level, mt-MPC controller. The latter is required to plan the UAV trajectory trading off safety, i.e. to avoid collisions with the uncertain obstacles, and exploitation, i.e. to reach an assigned target location. To achieve this goal, mt-MPC considers different future state trajectories in the same Finite Horizon Optimal Control Problem (FHOCP), enabling a partial decoupling between constraint satisfaction (safety) and cost function minimization (exploitation). Recursive feasibility and, consequently, persistent obstacle avoidance guarantees are derived under the assumption of a time invariant environment. The performance of the approach is studied in simulation and compared with that of a standard MPC, showing good improvement.
tldr: This paper presents a multi-trajectory model predictive control (mt-MPC) formulation for autonomous UAV navigation in unknown environments with LiDAR-based obstacle avoidance, demonstrating improved performance over standard MPC in simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种多轨迹模型预测控制（mt-MPC）方法，用于无人机在未知环境中基于LiDAR的自主导航与避障，仿真结果表明其性能优于标准MPC。
summary_zh: 提出了一种新颖的模型预测控制（MPC）方案，命名为多轨迹模型预测控制（mt-MPC），并将其应用于无人机（UAV）在未知环境中的自主导航问题。该无人机配备有激光雷达传感器，仅能提供周围环境的部分描述，导致无人机在障碍物间导航时面临时变约束。控制系统布局为分层结构：底层回路负责稳定飞行轨迹，并跟踪由高层mt-MPC控制器下达的设定点。高层控制器需权衡安全性与探索性来规划无人机轨迹，即既要避免与不确定障碍物碰撞（安全性），又要到达指定目标位置（探索性）。为实现该目标，mt-MPC在同一有限时域最优控制问题（FHOCP）中考虑多条未来状态轨迹，从而在约束满足（安全性）与成本函数最小化（探索性）之间实现部分解耦。在时不变环境假设下，推导了递归可行性和持续性避碰保证。该方法的性能通过仿真研究，并与标准MPC进行了对比，结果显示其具有明显改进。

title: GeLiFiSH: Recursive LiDAR Keypoint Estimation with Ground and Moving Object Segmentation
summary: LiDAR registration and loop closure often rely on sparse keypoints, which must remain repeatable across sessions, viewpoints, and sensors. To handle differing scan patterns, detectors typically operate on accumulated submaps, which introduces latency and processes each submap independently, so repeated observations are never fused. Height-based detectors also reference structure to an estimated ground, so its inconsistency across sessions propagates into the keypoints. Moreover, dynamic objects leave ghost trails that can be mistaken for static structure. We present GeLiFiSH (Geometric LiDAR Filtering with Sequential Hypothesis testing), a learning-free filter that recursively estimates persistent keypoints at scan rate. A height-structure detector runs on a rolling voxel map, and detections initialize tracks with a position, covariance, and existence probability, accepted or rejected by a sequential probability ratio test. Ground segmentation provides a sensor-agnostic height reference, and moving object segmentation removes dynamic points before map insertion. On SemanticKITTI, HeLiMOS, and HeLiPR, spanning five LiDARs and multiple sessions, GeLiFiSH attains the highest average keypoint repeatability among the compared detectors and the second-highest cross-session registration recall from keypoints alone, behind ISS which extracts four times as many keypoints. With one parameter set and no sensor-height prior, both ground and moving object segmentation modules outperform their baselines on average.
tldr: GeLiFiSH is a learning-free, recursive LiDAR keypoint detector that fuses repeated observations via a sequential hypothesis test on a rolling voxel map, using ground and moving-object segmentation to improve repeatability and registration recall across sensors and sessions.
tldr_zh: GeLiFiSH 是一种无学习的递归 LiDAR 关键点检测器，通过在滚动体素地图上使用序贯假设检验融合重复观测，并利用地面与动态物体分割提升跨传感器和跨会话的可重复性与配准召回率。
summary_zh: 激光雷达配准与回环检测通常依赖于稀疏关键点，而这些关键点必须在不同采集时段、视角及传感器之间保持可重复性。为应对不同的扫描模式，检测器通常基于累积子图进行操作，这种做法会引入延迟，并对每个子图独立处理，导致重复观测信息始终未被融合。此外，基于高度的方法通常将结构参考至估计的地平面，而地平面在不同采集时段间的不一致性会进一步传递至关键点中。同时，动态物体会留下鬼影轨迹，可能被误认为静态结构。我们提出GeLiFiSH（基于序贯假设检验的几何激光雷达滤波方法），这是一种免学习的滤波器，能够以扫描频率递推估计持久关键点。高度结构检测器在滚动体素地图上运行，检测结果初始化带有位置、协方差和存在概率的轨迹，并通过序贯概率比检验予以接受或拒绝。地面分割提供了与传感器无关的高度参考，移动物体分割则在建图插入之前移除动态点。在覆盖五种激光雷达和多个采集时段的SemanticKITTI、HeLiMOS和HeLiPR数据集上，GeLiFiSH在比较的检测器中取得了最高的平均关键点可重复性，并且仅凭关键点便取得了第二高的跨时段配准召回率，仅次于提取关键点数量为前者四倍的ISS方法。在仅使用一组参数且不依赖传感器高度先验的情况下，地面分割与移动物体分割模块的平均性能均优于其基线方法。

title: Trustworthy agentic lunar robotics: safety-constrained contingent planning with a foundation-model planner
summary: Sustained lunar-base operations require robots that restore equipment and deliver cargo under conditions unforeseen before deployment. Flown space autonomy executes pre-validated procedures and enters a safe hold outside their scope, whereas foundation models synthesize plans on site that cannot be verified before execution. We formulate these operations as safety-constrained contingent planning with irreversible actions, erroneous records, three-valued physical evidence, and costly, deadline-constrained sensing. We propose asymmetric knowledge-level replanning (AKR), which treats the planner as an untrusted black box: reversible actions run on the planner's assumptions, and irreversible actions run only after a minimum-cost sensing cover verifies every precondition. Under sound measurements, no irreversible action executes on a false precondition for any planner or record, the sensing cost before an irreversible action is bounded below for every sound knowledge-based policy, and execution with a complete planner ends in a verified goal or a certified hold. AKR executed no hazardous action in 21,000 Monte Carlo trials with sound observations or in 58 full-stack runs; the FF-Replan acting rule executed one in 7% of those trials. The median AKR run took 1.10 times the fastest run on the same mission, against 1.50 under the K-replanner acting rule. AKR completed 20 of 21 contingency and sequential-fault runs with an unchanged task model; the original PLEXIL and EUROPA$\rightarrow$PLEXIL procedures completed none.
tldr: This paper introduces asymmetric knowledge-level replanning (AKR), a safety-constrained contingent planning framework that uses a foundation-model planner as an untrusted black box for lunar robotics, verifying preconditions before irreversible actions. It demonstrates high safety and reliability in Monte Carlo trials and full-stack runs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了非对称知识级重规划（AKR），一种安全约束的应急规划框架，将基础模型规划器视为不可信黑箱，用于月球机器人，在执行不可逆动作前验证前提条件。在蒙特卡洛试验和全栈运行中证明了高安全性和可靠性。
summary_zh: 摘要：持续的月球基地运行需要机器人在部署前未曾预见的条件下恢复设备并运送货物。已上天的空间自主系统会执行经过预先验证的程序，并在超出其范围时进入安全保持状态，而基础模型则能在现场合成计划，但这些计划无法在执行前得到验证。我们将这些运行任务形式化为带有不可逆动作、错误记录、三值物理证据以及成本高昂且受截止时间约束的感知的安全约束偶发规划问题。我们提出了非对称知识层面重规划（AKR）方法，该方法将规划器视为不可信的黑盒：可逆动作基于规划器的假设执行，而不可逆动作仅在最小成本感知覆盖验证了所有前置条件之后才执行。在测量结果正确的条件下，任何不可逆动作都不会基于错误前置条件执行，无论采用何种规划器或记录；对于任何基于知识的可靠策略，在执行不可逆动作前的感知成本都有下界；使用完整规划器执行时，整个过程会以验证目标或认证保持状态结束。AKR在21,000次蒙特卡洛试验（观测数据正确）和58次全栈运行中均未执行任何危险动作；而FF-Replan动作规则在7%的试验中执行了危险动作。AKR的中位运行时间为同一任务最快运行时间的1.10倍，而K-重规划器动作规则为1.50倍。AKR在任务模型不变的情况下完成了21次偶发与连续故障运行中的20次；而原有的PLEXIL和EUROPA$\rightarrow$PLEXIL流程则未能完成任何一次。

title: Confidently Lost: Silent Failure and Edge Deployment of Dense Visual SLAM under Photon Starvation
summary: Dense visual SLAM built on learned two-view geometry is evaluated in good light; in low light it fails silently. Two frames of 9-level quantized noise, no scene at all, give MASt3R-SLAM's network a cross-view geometric self-consistency of 0.936; a real dark frame pair gives 0.935. Starved of structure, the network invents the same geometry for both views and the system trusts the agreement: on a dark sequence it consumes 1,605 frames, emits 7 keyframes, rejects no factor-graph edges and reports full frame rate, while over 95% of the correspondences it accepts violate the ground-truth epipolar geometry. One inflated statistic is read by two subsystems against thresholds in opposite directions, so keyframing starves while relocalization accepts almost every candidate. The same statistic, read at keyframe-pair baselines, separates the confident collapse from working runs on the ETH3D dark sequences without ground truth or extra computation (in-sample). Low-light-adapted weights take tracked trajectories from 1/6 to 5/6, as does retuning two thresholds; neither yields accurate ones, because the adaptation withdraws confidence from wrong geometry rather than finding right geometry. Replayed on a Jetson AGX Orin carried by a legged robot, the mechanism's signature reproduces on the two darkest of four routes, and which of its faces appears varies with route geometry and sensor encoding. The network does not lose confidence in the dark; it manufactures it.
tldr: This paper studies silent failure of dense visual SLAM under low-light conditions, showing that learned geometry networks manufacture false confidence in photon-starved scenes and proposing a metric to detect this failure without ground truth.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了密集视觉SLAM在弱光条件下的静默失败，揭示了学习几何网络在光子匮乏场景中会产生虚假信心，并提出了一种无需真值即可检测该失败的指标。
summary_zh: 基于学习到的双视角几何构建的稠密视觉SLAM在光照良好时表现可靠，但在低光环境下会无声失效。两帧经过9级量化的噪声图——完全不含任何场景内容——便能让MASt3R-SLAM的网络产生0.936的跨视角几何自一致性；真实暗光帧对则给出0.935。当缺乏结构信息时，网络会为两个视角虚构出相同的几何结构，而系统误信了这种一致性：在一个暗光序列中，系统消耗了1,605帧，生成7个关键帧，未拒绝任何因子图边，并报告了满帧率，但其接受的相关点对中，超过95%违反了真实极线几何约束。这一被放大的统计量被两个子系统读取，并分别用于方向相反的阈值判定，导致关键帧选取被抑制，而重定位却几乎接受每一个候选帧。同样的统计量在关键帧对的基线上读取时，无需真值或额外计算，即可在ETH3D暗光序列中将“自信崩溃”与正常运行区分开来（样本内）。低光自适应权重将跟踪轨迹从1/6提升至5/6，调节两个阈值也能达到同样效果；但两者都无法产生精确轨迹，因为这种自适应是从错误的几何中收回置信度，而非寻找正确的几何。在搭载于足式机器人的Jetson AGX Orin上重放时，该机制的标志性特征在四条路线中最暗的两条上复现，其表现面随路线几何和传感器编码方式的不同而变化。网络在黑暗中并未失去置信度，而是主动制造了置信度。

title: How Should a Home Robot Update Its Memories When Human Routines Change?
summary: A home robot that helps with chores needs to know where objects are, but people move objects according to routines that change and later change back. The robot's memory must adapt to the new routine without erasing experience that may become useful again. One approach is to have a language model maintain written summaries of the home from the robot's own observations, but existing evaluations of such memories use static worlds. We explore simulated households where a resident gets sick, recovers, and later gets sick again. We compare a rule that keeps every room an object has been seen in, language-model memories that store only written summaries, and language-model memories that can also read the raw history of sightings. The rule outperforms every summary-only memory, and giving language models the sighting history closes the gap. Surprisingly, writing summaries on top of the history adds nothing we can measure. When the illness returns, methods that keep the history search better than they did the first time, while summary-only methods show no consistent improvement. Deleting the first illness from memory removes all of the rule's gain and part of theirs. The summaries recorded where objects went during the illness but rarely distinguished sick-day patterns from normal routines. Our findings suggest that common approaches to summarizing robot memories struggle to remember facts about a routine that might return, highlighting the need for future benchmarks to evaluate this aspect of long-term robot deployment.
tldr: This paper investigates how home robots should update their memory of object locations when human routines change, comparing rule-based, summary-based, and raw-history language model approaches in simulated households, finding that preserving raw sighting history is crucial for adapting to recurring routines.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了当人类日常习惯改变时，家用机器人应如何更新物体位置的记忆，在模拟家庭中比较了基于规则、基于摘要和基于原始历史记录的语言模型方法，发现保留原始观察历史对于适应反复出现的习惯至关重要。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
协助家务的家用机器人需要知道物体的位置，但人们会根据不断变化、随后又恢复原状的日常习惯移动物体。机器人的记忆必须适应新的习惯，同时又不抹除未来可能再次有用的经验。一种方法是由语言模型根据机器人自身的观察，维护关于家庭环境的书面摘要，但现有的此类记忆评估均基于静态世界。我们探索了模拟家庭场景，其中一位居民生病、康复，随后再次生病。我们比较了三种方法：规则方法（保留每个物体出现过的所有房间）、只存储书面摘要的语言模型记忆，以及既能存储书面摘要又能读取原始目击历史的语言模型记忆。结果显示，规则方法优于所有仅使用摘要的记忆方法，而让语言模型获得目击历史后，其表现与规则方法相当。令人意外的是，在历史记录之上再撰写摘要并未带来任何可测量的额外收益。当疾病再次发生时，保留历史记录的方法在搜索上的表现优于首次患病时，而仅使用摘要的方法则没有表现出一致的改进。从记忆中删除第一次患病经历后，规则方法的全部优势消失，而其他方法的优势也部分丧失。摘要记录了患病期间物体的去向，但很少将病日模式与正常日常习惯区分开来。我们的研究结果表明，常见的机器人记忆摘要方法难以记住可能再次出现的习惯相关事实，这凸显了未来基准测试需要评估长期机器人部署中这一方面的必要性。

title: Superellipse Function: A Powerful Geometric Tool for the Design and Deformation Modeling of Tendon-Driven Continuum Manipulators With Flexural Patterns Experiencing Tension Loss
summary: In this article, we feature the Superellipse function as a geometric and versatile tool for effective design and modeling of flexural patterns (FPs) in tendon-driven continuum manipulators (TD-CMs) with discontinuous cross section geometries. We also propose a unique complementary mathematical framework and solution algorithm for modeling the effects of distributed and concentrated friction forces- caused by partially-constrained tendons- on tension loss and deformation behavior of a TD-CM designed using a Superellipse function. Particularly, by employing this geometric function, we establish four intuitive functional mappings relating the manipulator's geometric parameters, kinematics, and deformation behavior. Thanks to the features of these intuitive mappings and Superellipse function, we then introduce the concepts of design space and design curve to facilitate intuitive design of a TD-CM with a generic FP geometry experiencing tendon tension loss. To thoroughly evaluate the performance of this novel framework and its aforementioned features, we performed various simulation and experimental studies on TD-CMs designed and fabricated based on a Superellipse function. Results were then analyzed and compared using different error metrics.
tldr: The paper introduces a Superellipse-function-based geometric framework for designing and modeling tendon-driven continuum manipulators with flexural patterns, addressing tension loss from friction via simulations and experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于超椭圆函数的几何框架，用于设计和建模具有屈曲模式的腱驱动连续机械臂，并通过仿真和实验解决了摩擦导致的张力损失问题。
summary_zh: 本文重点介绍了超椭圆函数作为一种几何多功能工具，用于具有不连续截面几何形状的腱驱动连续型机械臂中弯曲模式的有效设计与建模。我们还提出了一种独特的互补数学框架和求解算法，用于建模由部分约束腱产生的分布和集中摩擦力对采用超椭圆函数设计的腱驱动连续型机械臂的张力损失和变形行为的影响。特别是，通过利用该几何函数，我们建立了四个直观的功能映射，将机械臂的几何参数、运动学和变形行为联系起来。借助这些直观映射和超椭圆函数的特性，我们进一步引入了设计空间和设计曲线的概念，以便于对具有通用弯曲模式几何形状并经历腱张力损失的腱驱动连续型机械臂进行直观设计。为全面评估该新型框架及其上述特性的性能，我们针对基于超椭圆函数设计和制造的腱驱动连续型机械臂进行了多项仿真和实验研究。随后，使用不同的误差指标对结果进行了分析和比较。

title: SWAM: State-aware World Action Model for Multi-Agent 3D Environments
summary: Interactive world models generate virtual environments autoregressively from player actions and visual history. However, visual history alone cannot reliably capture the evolving states of independently acting non-player characters (NPCs) in real games, particularly when they are outside the camera view. Recent multi-agent world models address this challenge through joint multi-view generation or persistent shared state, but often rely on external observations, like maps or scene geometry, or predefined state transitions. We present SWAM, a State-aware World Action Model that separates agent-state evolution from autoregressive visual generation in interactive 3D environments. A lightweight state model propagates character dynamics from actions without consuming generated frames, combining motion priors with learned scene-dependent corrections. The predicted states then guide an autoregressive diffusion transformer alongside visual history through a novel conditioning scheme. Rather than requiring an explicit scene geometry map or visibility tests, the conditioning indicates where characters may appear, allowing the diffusion model to learn their appearance and occlusion. This design enables NPCs to evolve independently of visual generation while maintaining consistent observations across visibility changes, interactions, and respawns. Evaluations in a custom Godot-based first-person shooter game demonstrate improvements in visual fidelity, NPC consistency, and long-horizon stability over existing approaches.
tldr: SWAM proposes a state-aware world action model that separates NPC state evolution from autoregressive visual generation in interactive 3D environments, enabling consistent long-horizon generation without explicit scene geometry.
tldr_zh: SWAM提出了一种状态感知的世界动作模型，将NPC状态演化与自回归视觉生成分离，在交互式3D环境中实现无需显式场景几何的长期一致生成。
summary_zh: 交互式世界模型根据玩家动作和视觉历史自回归地生成虚拟环境。然而，仅依靠视觉历史无法可靠地捕捉真实游戏中独立行动的非玩家角色（NPC）的演化状态，尤其是在这些角色位于相机视野之外时。近年来，多智能体世界模型通过联合多视角生成或持久化共享状态来应对这一挑战，但往往依赖外部观测（如地图或场景几何信息）或预定义的状态转移规则。我们提出了SWAM，一种状态感知的世界动作模型（State-aware World Action Model），它将智能体状态的演化与交互式3D环境中的自回归视觉生成相分离。一个轻量级状态模型仅根据动作传播角色动态，无需消耗生成的帧，将运动先验与学习到的场景相关修正相结合。预测得到的状态随后通过新颖的条件注入机制，与视觉历史一起引导自回归扩散Transformer。该机制无需显式的场景几何地图或可见性测试，而是指示角色可能出现的位置，使扩散模型能够自行学习其外观和遮挡关系。这一设计使得NPC能够在独立于视觉生成的同时演化，并在可见性变化、交互和重生过程中保持观测一致性。在基于Godot引擎定制的第一人称射击游戏中的评估表明，与现有方法相比，该方法在视觉保真度、NPC一致性和长时程稳定性方面均有显著提升。

title: LiveAudio: From Bidirectional to Autoregressive Diffusion for Real-Time Streaming Video-to-Audio Generation
summary: Video-to-audio generation synthesizes sound that matches a video in content and timing, with applications ranging from film post-production to live streaming, games and interactive world models. Interactive applications receive video continuously and need the sound to follow it in real time, yet most existing video-to-audio models are bidirectional and must observe an entire clip before producing any sound. We propose LiveAudio, a streaming video-to-audio framework that generates high-quality and synchronized audio in real time while the video is playing. In contrast to prior streaming models trained from scratch, LiveAudio converts a bidirectional model into a streaming generator so as to build on its audio quality and synchronization. LiveAudio generates audio block by block, and each block depends only on the video that has already been played. The streaming generator is obtained from the bidirectional model through progressive causal fine-tuning and distillation, so that each block needs only a few sampling steps. Experiments on VGGSound show that LiveAudio outperforms existing streaming models in audio quality and synchronization, and surpasses the bidirectional model it starts from in synchronization. On a single A100 GPU, it runs in real time with a real-time factor of 0.79 and a time to first frame of 143 ms. Audio samples are available at https://streamaudio.github.io.
tldr: LiveAudio converts a bidirectional video-to-audio diffusion model into a streaming autoregressive generator via progressive causal fine-tuning and distillation, enabling real-time, synchronized audio generation for live video streams and interactive world models.
tldr_zh: LiveAudio通过渐进式因果微调和蒸馏，将双向视频到音频扩散模型转换为流式自回归生成器，实现实时同步的音频生成，适用于直播和交互式世界模型。
summary_zh: 视频到音频生成技术能够合成与视频在内容和时间上匹配的声音，其应用范围涵盖电影后期制作、直播、游戏及交互式世界模型等。交互式应用需持续接收视频，并要求声音能够实时同步跟随，然而现有的大多数视频到音频模型均为双向模型，必须观察完整个片段才能产生任何声音。为此，我们提出LiveAudio，一种流式视频到音频框架，能够在视频播放过程中实时生成高质量且同步的音频。与以往从头训练的流式模型不同，LiveAudio将双向模型转换为流式生成器，从而继承其音频质量和同步性能。LiveAudio逐块生成音频，每个音频块仅依赖于已播放的视频内容。该流式生成器通过渐进式因果微调和蒸馏技术从双向模型中获得，使得每个音频块只需少量采样步骤即可完成。在VGGSound上的实验表明，LiveAudio在音频质量和同步性方面均优于现有流式模型，并且在同步性上超越了其源双向模型。在单块A100 GPU上，它能够实时运行，实时因子达0.79，首帧延迟为143毫秒。音频样本可在https://streamaudio.github.io获取。

title: AxE: Benchmarking Agent-Environment Generalization of Video World Models via Grounded Events
summary: Edge cases are not the long tail; they are the norm. An embodied system deployed across changing environments, bodies, objects, and tasks will routinely encounter combinations that were absent from its training data. General-purpose physical intelligence therefore requires world models that reuse prior knowledge, predict consequences, and adapt with little or no additional training. Yet current evaluations of conditional video generation emphasize visual quality, prompt alignment, or isolated physical plausibility, leaving systematic generalization difficult to measure. We introduce AxE Bench, a benchmark that organizes condition changes along eight factors of the acting agent and of its environment, and pairs every original condition with controlled variants that change one side or both. WBench-plus applies the same structure to an existing multi-turn benchmark, pairing each WBench scenario with variants on the environment side, through its world setting or camera behavior, or on the agent side, through its interaction instructions. Additionally, to score generated futures, we develop an evaluation harness that combines vision-language reasoning with targeted computer-vision evidence, converting each video into temporally localized events and comparing generated events with reference events in both time and semantics. We summarize each model with the AxE Score, event Fidelity weighted by its Stability across original-variant pairs. Across twenty models, generated events match reference events far more often in timing than in content: no model exceeds a Fidelity of 13.01, the highest Stability is 0.55, and the highest AxE Score is 7.10. Together, these components turn world-model generalization from an informal aspiration into a falsifiable evaluation program for real and simulated interactions. Our project website can be found at: AxEBench.github.io
tldr: AxE Bench is a benchmark for evaluating the generalization of video world models across agent and environment changes, using grounded events and a vision-language evaluation harness to measure temporal and semantic fidelity.
tldr_zh: AxE Bench 是一个基准测试，用于评估视频世界模型在智能体和环境变化下的泛化能力，通过基于视频的事件和视觉语言评估来度量时间与语义保真度。
summary_zh: 边缘情况并非长尾分布，而是常态。一个在变化的环境、身体、物体和任务中部署的具身系统，将频繁遭遇其训练数据中未曾出现的组合。因此，通用物理智能需要能够复用先验知识、预测后果，并在极少或无需额外训练的情况下进行适应的世界模型。然而，当前对条件视频生成的评估侧重于视觉质量、提示对齐或孤立的物理合理性，导致系统化泛化难以度量。我们引入了AxE Bench基准，该基准沿着行为主体及其环境的八个因素组织条件变化，并将每个原始条件与改变单侧或双侧的受控变体配对。WBench-plus将相同的结构应用于现有的多轮基准，将每个WBench场景与环境侧的变体（通过其世界设置或相机行为）或主体侧的变体（通过其交互指令）配对。此外，为对生成的未来进行评分，我们开发了一套评估工具，将视觉语言推理与针对性的计算机视觉证据相结合，将每个视频转换为时间定位事件，并在时间和语义上将生成事件与参考事件进行比较。我们通过AxE Score（事件保真度乘以其在原始-变体对上的稳定性加权）来总结每个模型。在二十个模型中，生成事件与参考事件在时间上的匹配频率远高于内容上的匹配频率：没有模型的保真度超过13.01，最高稳定性为0.55，最高AxE Score为7.10。综合来看，这些组件将世界模型的泛化从一种非正式愿景转变为对真实和模拟交互的可证伪评估程序。我们的项目网站位于：AxEBench.github.io

title: Place-Revisit Consistency Evaluation of Reference Poses
summary: Reference trajectories are widely used to evaluate odometry and simultaneous localization and mapping systems. However, local inconsistencies in benchmark reference poses can bias such evaluations. This paper presents a place-revisit consistency evaluation method for reference poses in mobile sensing datasets. When a platform revisits a previously observed place after a sufficient temporal gap, the relative pose implied by the reference trajectory should agree with relative poses estimated directly from onboard sensors. We instantiate this idea with lidar scan registration and stereo-image pose estimation, and apply it to the KITTI Odometry and SNAIL Radar. The KITTI analysis identifies several revisit regions where the public reference poses disagree with sensor-derived relative poses, with median translation discrepancies up to 6.60 m. Representative point-cloud overlays further localize these discrepancies and support the use of place revisits as a benchmark-validation tool.
tldr: This paper proposes a place-revisit consistency method to validate reference poses in odometry/SLAM benchmarks, using lidar/stereo pose estimation to detect local inconsistencies in trajectories. Applied to KITTI Odometry and SNAIL Radar, it identifies significant reference pose errors at revisit regions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于重访一致性的方法，用于验证里程计/SLAM基准中的参考位姿，通过激光雷达/立体视觉位姿估计检测轨迹中的局部不一致。在KITTI Odometry和SNAIL Radar上发现了显著的参考位姿误差。

title: OmniSLAM: Evidence-Authorized Revision of Persistent Object Maps
summary: A new surface observation can extend an object map while contradicting an earlier object assignment. Treating both updates as a single merge can join unrelated objects; keeping all earlier assignments leaves fragmented objects unresolved. We present a revision module that makes these decisions separately. Historical merges require shared-mask evidence to outweigh separate-object explanations across views, including after removal of any one observation. New measured points are assigned through local competition among object seeds supported by image masks. On two preselected KITTI-360 windows, the method improves mean building/car instance AP50:90 from 17.259 to 18.762. On four further spatial holdouts, AP rises from 20.263 to 23.171, although unconditional revision reaches 23.251. Controlled comparisons attribute the gains to protecting existing identities, consolidating selected fragments, and assigning new points locally. The results also show where conservative merge decisions suppress useful updates. A garage recording demonstrates the same revision module on LiDAR--inertial--visual mapping outputs.
tldr: This paper introduces a revision module for persistent object maps that distinguishes between extending and correcting object assignments, using shared-mask evidence and local competition to improve object instance AP50:90 on KITTI-360 and garage recordings.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于持久对象地图的修订模块，通过共享掩码证据和局部竞争来区分扩展与纠正对象分配，在KITTI-360和车库记录上提升了对象实例AP50:90。

title: RadarOSV: Unified 3D Scene and Motion Perception from mmWave Radars
summary: Millimeter-wave radar offers weather-resilient sensing for 3D occupancy prediction. Existing radar occupancy methods mainly model geometry, with limited joint modeling of semantics and motion. Cascaded imaging radar provides fine spatial detail but has a limited unambiguous velocity range, whereas single-chip radar offers a wider range but coarser spatial resolution. We propose RadarOSV, to our knowledge the first radar-only framework that jointly predicts occupancy, dynamic object semantics, and ground-relative velocity from raw radar data in unified voxels, by exploiting complementary measurements from both radars. Its Polar-to-Cartesian Geometry (PCG) backbone maps polar imaging-radar features into Cartesian voxels through fixed and deformable sampling, guiding cross-radar fusion for geometry and attribute prediction. Single-chip detection outputs provide class evidence, while raw Doppler spectra supply motion features and radial-velocity candidates. The velocity readout selects from these candidates using fused features to resolve aliasing, then combines the selected radial estimate with learned motion. Ego-motion compensation uses radar-estimated velocity, so inference requires no external odometry or other sensors. On K-Radar, single-frame PCG achieves 40.7% mIoU within 12.8 m, compared with RadarOcc's reported 34.3%. On the BRIDGE-Liv dataset, compared with a cascaded-radar baseline predicting the same outputs with external ego velocity, RadarOSV improves macro-averaged accuracy across four dynamic object classes within annotated object regions from 63.1% to 75.5% and reduces object radial-velocity MAE against manual Doppler annotations from 1.03 to 0.51 m/s, while maintaining geometric occupancy mIoU.
tldr: RadarOSV is the first radar-only framework to jointly predict 3D occupancy, dynamic object semantics, and ground-relative velocity from raw millimeter-wave radar data by fusing cascaded imaging and single-chip radars, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy without external sensors.
tldr_zh: RadarOSV是首个仅依靠雷达、不借助外部传感器，通过融合级联成像雷达和单芯片雷达原始数据，统一预测3D占据、动态物体语义和地面相对速度的框架，精度达到SOTA。

title: Particle Belief Representations for Reinforcement Learning under Partial Observability
summary: Particle filters flexibly represent complex, multimodal beliefs but expose them as weighted, unordered sets incompatible with conventional fixed-dimensional policies. We study particle-belief encodings as inputs to reinforcement-learning policies while holding belief estimation and policy optimization fixed. We compare statistical summaries, cumulant-generating-function (CGF) features, and permutation-invariant set encoders. Trainable encoders are learned end-to-end or pretrained through belief reconstruction or task-specific prediction. Across eight tasks, pooling-based set encoders and gradient CGF features are reliable end-to-end, while the Set Transformer achieves the highest performance with appropriate pretraining. Task-specific pretraining helps when its target captures decision-relevant belief structure, whereas reconstruction pretraining and latent alignment provide more selective benefits. For selecting and training particle-belief encoders in partially observable Markov decision processes, our results show that an encoding that reconstructs the belief well is not necessarily a good input for control.
tldr: This paper investigates how to encode particle filter beliefs as inputs to reinforcement learning policies under partial observability, comparing statistical summaries, CGF features, and permutation-invariant set encoders across eight tasks, and finding that belief reconstruction quality does not guarantee good control performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了在部分可观测条件下，如何将粒子滤波信念编码为强化学习策略的输入，比较了统计摘要、CGF特征和置换不变集合编码器在八项任务中的表现，并发现信念重建质量并不保证良好的控制性能。

title: CARE-3D: Reinforcement Learning for Evidence Grounded Agentic Reasoning in Situated 3D Scenes
summary: Situated 3D reasoning requires embodied agents to interpret objects, scene geometry, and viewpoint dependent spatial relations. Existing methods learn grounded interactions from supervised traces, but largely imitate prescribed evidence acquisition patterns rather than optimizing the support that the returned evidence provides for the correct answer. Moreover, outcome rewards provide limited credit for intermediate tool choices and may leave infrequent tools underexplored. An effective agent should instead adaptively decide what to ground, which tool to invoke, and how to assess the utility of returned evidence. To this end, this paper presents CARE-3D, a reinforcement post-training framework for adaptive grounded reasoning. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on grounding instructions first establishes valid interactions, after which Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) optimizes the agent while keeping the 3D grounding module frozen. CARE-3D combines Counterfactual Attribution of Returned Evidence for evidence sensitive credit assignment, and Group Coverage Sampling to preserve tool coverage. Experiments on MSQA and Beacon3D show consistent gains over SFT and GRPO using only answer and format rewards, especially in spatial reasoning and grounding answer coherence. Our code is available at \href{https://github.com/xiaoqian-UQ/CARE-3D}{CARE-3D}.
tldr: CARE-3D introduces a reinforcement learning post-training framework for situated 3D reasoning, using counterfactual attribution and coverage sampling to improve evidence grounding and spatial reasoning over SFT and GRPO baselines.
tldr_zh: CARE-3D提出了一种用于情境3D推理的强化学习后训练框架，通过反事实归因和覆盖采样来改进证据基础与空间推理，在SFT和GRPO基础上取得一致提升。

title: Part-wise Certified State Estimation of Articulated Objects from Passive Stereo
summary: Robots in manufacturing often handle thin, hinged objects known from CAD models that change shape during the task, like folding cartons. Monitoring such tasks requires estimating the object's articulation state, its pose and the shape of any semi-deformable part. Learning-based estimators generalise across objects but lose precision while handling thin parts. Model-based fitting is precise but often needs accurate depth, a close initial estimate and a clean object mask. We present part-wise certification of an articulated object's state, estimated from passive stereo. Our estimator rivals the precision of the best model-based fitting method without using depth, a close initial estimate or a mask. We detect the corners that the CAD model defines in both stereo images and fit the articulated model to them. Geometric certificates, which we extend from rigid to articulated objects, then tell whether to trust each part, because the fit returns a state even for hidden parts. Certified estimates on unlabelled video become labels that improve sim-to-real transfer. On five of seven simulated objects, we locate the parts we certify three to five times more precisely than the strongest learned baseline on the same readings, given depth and true masks. On a real folding carton, our median corner error on the end panels is 2.1% of the carton's size, at least 40% lower than every learned baseline and also lower than a depth-based fit initialised near the true state.
tldr: This paper presents a model-based method for certified state estimation of articulated objects (e.g., folding cartons) from passive stereo images, detecting CAD-defined corners without depth or masks. It extends geometric certification to articulated objects, enabling trustworthy labels that improve sim-to-real transfer and outperforming learned baselines in precision on simulated and real objects.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于模型的认证方法，用于从被动立体图像估计铰接物体（如折叠纸盒）的状态，无需深度或掩码即可检测CAD定义的角点。将几何认证扩展到铰接物体，提供可信标签以改善仿真到现实的迁移，在模拟和真实物体上均优于学习基线。

title: Assembly-JEPA: Using World Models for Fine-Grained Industrial Image Verification
summary: Automated verification of industrial assembly processes remains a challenging problem due to substantial visual variability, limited availability of labeled defect data, and the fine-grained nature of many assembly errors. Existing approaches often rely on object detection, CAD models, or supervised classification pipelines, which can struggle to generalize across changing products and assembly configurations. In this work, we propose a novel self-supervised assembly verification framework based on Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs). Starting from the JEPA-based world model LeWorldModel, we investigate how the architecture must be adapted to verify the correctness of fine-grained assembly operations. To this end, we formulate assembly verification as a predictive world modeling task operating on before-and-after observations of assembly processes. Experimental results on industrial assembly tasks demonstrate that the proposed approach reliably detects both fine-grained incorrect assembly states and action-state mismatches, achieving an AUROC of 86.9% on a newly introduced assembly verification dataset. These results indicate that JEPA-based predictive representations constitute a promising foundation for robust and data-efficient industrial assembly verification.
tldr: This paper introduces Assembly-JEPA, a self-supervised framework based on Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures that verifies industrial assembly correctness by predicting future states from before-and-after observations, achieving high AUROC on a new dataset.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Assembly-JEPA，一种基于联合嵌入预测架构的自监督框架，通过预测装配前后的状态来验证工业装配正确性，在新数据集上取得了高AUROC。

title: Toward Open Room-Scale Scanning with Consumer LiDAR via Depth-Inertial Odometry
summary: Room scanning with consumer LiDAR today depends on ARKit, whose tracking and map update are a black box: an application receives depth and poses but cannot inspect how they were produced, so an error in a scan cannot be traced to its cause. This paper examines whether an open alternative, one whose every stage can be inspected, is feasible on the device. Mobile-LIO is a depth-inertial odometry pipeline that uses the phone's depth and inertial data and no ARKit poses. On seven ScanNet++ iPhone recordings it completed every scene with 0.2-2.0 m deviation from the ARKit-derived reference, where six open-source LiDAR-inertial estimators run as configured for dedicated scanners had at least 4.46 m in 41 of 42 runs (two of the six also failed a noise-free adapter check, and Mobile-LIO has a speed cap they lack; the comparison is not controlled and does not rone 15 Pro Max, a buildwith corrected phone code kept up with the sensor in 14 of 15 replay runs of three 7-13 s recordings; e estimator before thosecorrections. Laser-scanned meshes give the accuracy. Within 3 m, recorded depth differed from the m on three held-out scenes,maps fused with ARKit poses that the dataset scales and aligns to the mesh la a median 1.8-2.3 cm from 17 cm. Because thepipeline is open, the gap could be examined: in the scene with the largest error, noise-free renderefrom 1.97 m to 0.04 m, sorecorded depth, whose error reached 20-54 cm at 5-7 m, contributed alongside the estimator. An open de tracked on phone depth and kept up with the sensor in short phone replays, but it is not yet as accurate as ARKit-pose maps, whicheach only the coarsestUSIBD accuracy level (LOA10); its accuracy on the device was not measured.
tldr: This paper presents Mobile-LIO, an open-source depth-inertial odometry pipeline for consumer LiDAR phones, enabling inspectable room-scale scanning without ARKit, and evaluates its accuracy against ARKit-derived maps.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Mobile-LIO，一种用于消费级LiDAR手机的开源深度-惯性里程计流水线，无需ARKit即可实现可检查的房间级扫描，并评估了其相对于ARKit衍生地图的精度。

title: World Models and the Law
summary: Current AI may have a model of how we use human language, but this does not translate into a reliable representation of physical reality. World models promise to fill this gap by learning how an environment changes over time and predicting the consequences of an action, and they are already used to steer robots and generate explorable worlds. This article asks how AI regulation in three major legal contexts, the European Union, California, and China, copes with the distinctive challenges they raise. I propose a definition and a taxonomy of world models based on who or what acts on their predictions, and identify the risks of misplaced reliance on them. I argue that existing rules tend to cover world models but leave three questions open, i.e., action provenance, trajectory validity, and the weight of simulated evidence, and recommend ways to fill these gaps.
tldr: This paper analyzes how AI regulation in the EU, California, and China addresses the challenges of world models, proposing a definition, taxonomy, and identifying regulatory gaps such as action provenance, trajectory validity, and simulated evidence.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了欧盟、加利福尼亚和中国的人工智能法规如何应对世界模型的挑战，提出了定义、分类法，并指出了行动溯源、轨迹有效性和模拟证据权重等方面的监管空白。

title: OmniV-Bench: Can MLLMs Comprehend Immersive Spatio-temporal Scenes?
summary: Omnidirectional videos (ODVs) capture dynamic environments with a full $360^\circ$ field of view, providing rich spatial context and temporal dynamics for applications such as virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), and embodied intelligence. Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made great progress in spatial and temporal understanding, yet their ability to comprehend the immersive 360 spatio-temporal information conveyed by ODVs remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we first introduce OmniV-Bench, a Benchmark designed to comprehensively evaluate the capabilities of MLLMs on spatio-temporal Omnidirectional Video understanding. OmniV-Bench contains 4,123 high-quality ODVs collected from diverse scenes, along with 8,923 human-annotated question-answer pairs spanning 11 fine-grained tasks across three categories, i.e., general, spatial, and spatio-temporal understanding. Extensive benchmark experiments reveal that the spatio-temporal complexity of ODVs poses significant challenges for current MLLMs. To address these limitations, we further propose OmniV-Harness, an agentic harness that enhances ODV understanding through viewpoint-guided evidence initialization and task-relevant evidence acquisition with adaptive tool use. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that OmniV-Harness consistently improves immersive spatio-temporal reasoning ability of MLLMs. Both OmniV-Bench and OmniV-Harness will be released upon publication.
tldr: This paper introduces OmniV-Bench, a benchmark of 4,123 omnidirectional videos with 8,923 QA pairs across 11 tasks to evaluate MLLMs' spatio-temporal video understanding, and OmniV-Harness, an agentic tool-use framework that improves MLLM reasoning on ODVs. The work is motivated by applications in VR/AR and embodied intelligence, but the evaluation is purely on video understanding without any robotic or driving system integration.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了OmniV-Bench基准，包含4,123个全景视频和8,923个问答对，涵盖11个细粒度任务，用于评估多模态大模型对沉浸式时空视频的理解能力；同时提出了OmniV-Harness代理框架，通过工具使用增强模型推理。该研究虽声称面向具身智能，但评估仅涉及视觉理解，未与机器人或驾驶系统结合。

title: World Models Are the Right Foundation for Simulating Mars Terraforming
summary: Terraforming Mars is a long-horizon, action-conditioned control problem that requires predicting atmospheric responses to interventions over centuries to identify effective policies. This position paper argues that physics-regularized recurrent state-space world models are the most promising foundation for this setting. Data-driven climate emulators lack action-conditioning, and physics-based general circulation models (GCMs) are too expensive for policy search. Among learned world models, recurrent state-space architectures with physics constraints are better suited than transformer-based alternatives: they provide native uncertainty quantification through their stochastic-deterministic decomposition, remain stable under sparse non-terrestrial training data, and enforce physical consistency at each rollout step. To make this position concrete, we describe a potential architecture combining JEPA-inspired latent encoding, universal differential equation constraints, and a Dreamer-lineage planning head. We also introduce MarsWorld, an open benchmark proposal for intervention-conditioned planetary world models, and discuss broader implications and objections.
tldr: This position paper argues that physics-regularized recurrent state-space world models are the most promising foundation for simulating Mars terraforming, and proposes a benchmark for intervention-conditioned planetary world models.
tldr_zh: 本文主张物理正则化的循环状态空间世界模型是模拟火星地球化的最有前景的基础，并提出了一个干预条件行星世界模型的基准。

title: STAR: Structure-Aware Temporal Action Recovery for Point Supervised Temporal Action Localization
summary: Point supervised temporal action localization is becoming the need of time in this era of ever growing and non-stop video data. Existing method mainly rely on snippet level action response to generate pseudo labels. However, these labels often suffer from boundary ambiguity, over extended proposals, and weak temporal structure. To address these issues, we propose STAR, a structure-aware Temporal Action Recovery framework for point supervised temporal action localization. STAR works by enhancing the base S model with temporal difference interaction with attention module to capture forward and backward snippet changes, and introduces the learning of start, core, and end roles to model the internal temporal structure of actions. In addition, STAR further improves the pseudo label generation through All point proposal ranking and Rolebank based structural re-ranking, which suppress neighbor crossing and structurally inconsistent proposals. Finally, temporal action detector to STAR feedback supervision transfers high quality detector prediction back to the STAR model through soft start, core, end, action, and background targets. This helps to further refine the pseudo labels. Extensive experiments on four standard benchmarks shows the effectiveness of STAR. By using I3D features, STAR achieves 67.2% at AVG@0.1:0.7 on THUMOS'14, 58.1% on GTEA, 74.6% on BEOID, and 31.7% at AVG@0.5:0.95 on ActivityNet-1.3, outperforming previous point supervised methods across multiple benchmarks.
tldr: STAR is a structure-aware temporal action recovery framework for point-supervised temporal action localization, which enhances pseudo-label generation by modeling start, core, and end roles of actions and refining via structural ranking and feedback supervision, achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks.
tldr_zh: STAR是一个用于点监督时间动作定位的结构感知时间动作恢复框架，通过建模动作的开始、核心和结束角色并利用结构重排序和反馈监督来改进伪标签生成，在多个基准上取得了最先进的结果。

title: Robust Lateral String Stability and Error Attenuation for Heterogeneous Vehicle Platoons
summary: Keeping an entire vehicle platoon close to its planned path is essential for navigating road boundaries and obstacles safely. Followers may rely on predecessor information for lateral guidance, which couples their lateral dynamics and allows errors to propagate downstream. This paper develops a robust lateral string stability framework to study this propagation and achieve downstream error attenuation in heterogeneous platoons under varying longitudinal motion and local perturbations. Arc-length-based feedback linearization gives each vehicle the same nominal lateral error dynamics, with parameter uncertainty and external disturbances represented as local perturbations. We define robust $\mathcal L_2$ lateral string stability in terms of platoon-length-uniform error bounds and derive a sufficient condition for achieving it. Furthermore, we show that the same condition guarantees platoon-length-uniform $\mathcal L_\infty$ error bounds. For the considered control formulations, predecessor tracking (PT) can accumulate lateral errors, whereas desired-path tracking (DT) prevents this accumulation. We propose a learn-from-predecessor (LFP) strategy with explicit gains for downstream error attenuation and characterize how intervehicle perturbation differences limit this attenuation. Simulations validate the theoretical findings under vehicle heterogeneity, varying longitudinal motion, and local perturbations.
tldr: This paper develops a robust lateral string stability framework for heterogeneous vehicle platoons, propose a learn-from-predecessor control strategy, and proves sufficient conditions for downstream error attenuation under local perturbations.
tldr_zh: 本文针对异构车辆队列建立了鲁棒横向弦稳定性框架，提出了一种向前驱学习的控制策略，并证明了在下游扰动下实现误差衰减的充分条件。

title: SGPC: Safety-Guiding Policy Constraint for Stable Off-Policy Safe Reinforcement Learning
summary: Off-policy safe reinforcement learning (RL) faces a challenging trade-off between task optimality and constraint feasibility. In primal-dual methods, the coupled optimization of cumulative reward and constraint penalties through adaptive Lagrange multipliers may induce oscillatory policy updates near the safety boundary and amplify the effect of unreliable reward estimates outside the safe set. To address these issues, we formulate a new constrained optimization problem (COP) for safe RL by introducing a Safety-Guiding Policy (SGP) and a corresponding Safety-Guiding Policy Constraint (SGPC). The proposed COP augments the standard COP in safe RL with a conditional safety-guidance constraint. During actor updates, the current actor is evaluated using the learned cost critic. If it is predicted to be outside the safe set, SGP provides a nearby lower-cost training reference, and SGPC guides actor optimization toward this reference. Once the policy enters the safe set, the added constraint becomes inactive, and the formulation reduces to the original COP. This formulation leads to a plug-in actor-training constraint that can be integrated into off-policy safe RL algorithms. By applying primal-dual optimization to the auxiliary COP, we finally derive an SGPC-based off-policy safe RL algorithm and implement it in two representative off-policy algorithms, yielding SAC-SGPC and TD3-SGPC. Experiments on multiple Safety-Gymnasium benchmarks demonstrate that SGPC achieves a better optimality-safety trade-off by substantially reducing constraint violations and cost oscillations while maintaining competitive or better task returns.
tldr: This paper introduces a Safety-Guiding Policy Constraint (SGPC) for off-policy safe RL, which adds a conditional constraint to guide the actor toward a safer reference policy when predicted to be unsafe, reducing constraint violations while maintaining task returns in Safety-Gymnasium benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于离策略安全强化学习的安全引导策略约束（SGPC），通过条件约束在当前策略预测不安全时向更安全的参考策略引导，从而在保持任务回报的同时减少约束违反。

title: TidyFlow: Geometry-Aware Tabletop Arrangement Generation with Human-Aligned Tidiness Evaluation
summary: Generating tidy tabletop arrangements that align with human organizational preferences requires considering both functional relationships among objects and geometric constraints within limited tabletop space. We present TidyFlow, a tabletop arrangement generation framework that integrates conditional Flow Matching with topology-aware geometric refinement. We construct two tabletop arrangement datasets based on functional grouping and geometric constraints, namely General Tabletop Layouts (GTL) and Workstation Tabletop Layouts (WTL), and introduce a six-dimensional tidiness scoring function. Conditional Flow Matching is employed to learn a multimodal distribution of target arrangements conditioned on object attributes and tabletop geometry. To address geometric errors in generated layouts, we construct topology-aware refinement data based on collision and boundary-violation patterns, and employ a pair-aware attention network to iteratively refine object poses. Experiments demonstrate that, after three refinement iterations, TidyFlow improves geometric validity from 23.21% to 88.91% on GTL and from 10.58% to 57.91% on WTL. Furthermore, a human preference study demonstrates a positive correlation between the proposed tidiness scores and human rankings, achieving a Spearman correlation coefficient of 0.5543.
tldr: TidyFlow generates tidy tabletop arrangements by combining conditional Flow Matching with topology-aware geometric refinement, introducing two datasets and a six-dimensional tidiness scoring function validated by human preference.
tldr_zh: TidyFlow 结合条件流匹配与拓扑感知几何细化来生成整洁桌面布局，并引入两个数据集和六维整洁度评分函数，通过人类偏好研究验证。

title: Active sensing as control over sensory acquisition
summary: The term "active sensing" is used across neuroscience and engineering to describe a wide range of sensing behaviors, but there is no consensus on what makes sensing "active." We propose that the behaviors grouped under this label are better understood as forms of control over sensory acquisition and develop a framework that distinguishes three interacting forms of control. Mechanistic control physically structures sensory input, strategic control modulates sensing in closed loop through adaptive and attentional processes, and agentic control concerns the sensing policies available to an agent and its authority to choose among them. These forms of control can occur separately or in combination, and have distinct consequences for sensory input, perception, behavior, and performance. The framework clarifies active-passive comparisons and provides a common basis for analyzing biological, engineered, and hybrid sensing systems by asking what is controlled, how, and by whom.
tldr: This paper proposes a conceptual framework for active sensing, defining it as control over sensory acquisition with three interacting forms: mechanistic, strategic, and agentic control, to unify biological and engineered sensing systems.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了主动感知的概念框架，将其定义为对感觉获取的控制，区分了机械性、战略性和主体性三种交互控制形式，以统一生物和工程感知系统。

title: From States to Dynamics: Detecting Rule Violations in OthelloGPT
summary: Sequence models trained on game moves have been shown to encode world models, with structured linear probes revealing the underlying game states. World models, however, are inherently dynamic: in deterministic board games, a set of rules constrain how states evolve over time. We therefore ask if and how OthelloGPT, a transformer trained only on Othello move sequences, manifests the rules of the game in its activation space. We divide the rules of Othello, and symmetrically their violations, into three classes: placing a disc on an empty square (R1), flanking an opponent's disc (R2), and moving in turn (R3). We find that linear probes accurately separate legal from illegal moves, and also distinguish between the three kinds of rule violations. We introduce an unsupervised rule-violation detector based on the step length of activations between consecutive moves, which identifies illegal moves above chance. We further improve our detection metric by computing step length in the latent space of select sparse autoencoders. Together, we find that OthelloGPT follows game rules of Othello to a large extent, and that we can detect rule violations using structured detectors on model activations.
tldr: This paper investigates whether OthelloGPT, a transformer trained only on game move sequences, encodes the rules of Othello in its activation space. It finds that linear probes can accurately separate legal from illegal moves and distinguish between three types of rule violations, and introduces an unsupervised rule-violation detector based on activation step length, improved with sparse autoencoders.
tldr_zh: 本文研究仅训练于游戏走子序列的 OthelloGPT 是否在其激活空间中编码了奥赛罗的规则。研究发现线性探针能准确区分合法与非法的走子，并能区分三类规则违反，还提出了一种基于激活步长的无监督规则违反检测器，并通过稀疏自编码器加以改进。

title: 3AGameFactory-Motion: Agentic Rigging and Reliable Complex Motion Generation for Diverse 3D Assets
summary: Animating arbitrary 3D assets from instructions requires both structural inference and motion control, yet existing motion benchmarks mostly cover conventional human or animal skeletons with simple instructions. We introduce DivDynBench, which evaluates rigging and motion generation across six morphology categories, with instructions requiring multi-phase part coordination and explicit timing, angle, repetition, and trajectory constraints. With large language models, we systematically compare three common paradigms: specialized motion generation, video generation followed by motion recovery, and direct agent-driven generation. We analyze their control capabilities, cross-morphology adaptability, and generation costs. Guided by this comparison, we propose an Agentic Motion Framework in which an agent writes compact parametric skeleton and motion programs, and a deterministic executor performs rigging, kinematic solving, and geometric correction. Compact parameter control reduces generation overhead and improves rigging reliability and motion-control accuracy, providing practical guidance for deploying complex 3D motion generation.

title: A CPU-Only Framework for Mining Collectively-Behaving Bots in MMORPGs
summary: MMORPGs continually face automated programs (bots) that disrupt gameplay balance and in-game economies. An unsupervised Transformer framework can mine collectively behaving bot groups, but its multi-GPU training is costly in live operations. We show that such GPU-trained sequence models are not strictly necessary for this task. Our CPU pipeline pairs zone embeddings learned from movement context, which place teleport-linked zones close together, with a training-free coordinate kernel, and then applies density clustering. It trains 3-5$\times$ faster than the GPU-based Transformer (56-86$\times$ on the same CPU) while matching its mining quality on two commercial MMORPGs, and has been deployed since late 2024. We also share deployment lessons on how to set the clustering threshold and when to retrain.

title: A Cascaded Framework with a Cross-Attention-Guided Mamba-CNN Model for Pre- and Post-Treatment Glioma Segmentation
summary: Accurate glioma segmentation is vital for diagnosis and follow-up, but manual segmentation is time-consuming, subjective, and variable across interpreters. Gliomas are heterogeneous in size, shape, and location. Deep learning has therefore emerged as a potential solution. CNNs excel at local features but may struggle with long-range dependencies, whereas Vision Transformers capture global context efficiently but incur higher computational complexity. Most previous studies focused on pre-treatment gliomas; post-treatment cases with resection cavities (RCs) remain less explored. This study proposes a Cross-Attention-Guided Mamba-CNN (CMC-Seg) model within a cascaded framework for pre- and post-treatment diffuse glioma segmentation, aiming to balance accuracy and computational cost. Experiments used BraTS 2025 mpMRI of diffuse glioma patients. After preprocessing, a coarse segmentation model extracted tumor-centered patches, which were fed to CMC-Seg for fine-grained segmentation. CMC-Seg was compared with 3D U-Net, SegResNet, SwinUNETR, UNETR, nnFormer, and SegMamba. On the test set, CMC-Seg achieved the highest mean Dice (81.20%) and non-enhancing tumor core (NETC) Dice (77.09%). It also achieved an RC Dice of 78.63% and the lowest 95% Hausdorff distance (HD95; 4.39 mm). Results were comparable to CNN and Mamba baselines and significantly better than Transformer-based baselines (P < 0.05). CMC-Seg required the fewest inference GFLOPs (381.49). Ablation experiments indicated that multi-direction scanning and cross-attention improved performance, particularly for RC (P < 0.05). Grad-CAM explainability experiments showed that CMC-Seg focuses on diagnostically relevant tumor regions.

title: A Comparison of Uncertainty in AI and Dynamical Climate Ensembles
summary: Climate model ensembles and their uncertainty estimates are essential for evaluating risk and designing climate policy. Yet, in the assessment of newly developed AI climate models, evaluating uncertainty is often secondary to diagnosing mean-state climate biases and trends. In this work, we conduct the first systematic comparison of uncertainty representation in ensembles of state-of-the-art AI and dynamical atmospheric climate models. Examining 2-meter temperature, 500 hPa geopotential height, and precipitable water, we find that the AI ensemble exhibits reduced internal variability and model uncertainty across variables relative to the dynamical ensemble. We show that this dampened variability causes the AI ensemble to produce more limited climate extremes and yields underdispersion relative to ERA5. Under a uniform warming scenario, the AI ensemble shows increased model uncertainty. Dynamical models grapple with their own challenges, exhibiting stronger miscalibration (overdispersion) relative to ERA5 and larger climate biases than the AI models. As AI and dynamical climate models are mutually integrated into operational climate prediction, careful consideration of their differences in uncertainty representations is crucial for grounded assessment of climate risk.

title: A High-Resolution UAV Benchmark Dataset and Baseline Evaluation for Teak Crown Segmentation in Western Ghats Tropical Forests
summary: Accurate teak-tree segmentation from high-resolution drone imagery is critical for sustainable plantation management, yet lacks dedicated benchmarks. We introduce TeakTreeNet, a comprehensive dataset and evaluation protocol for binary teak-tree segmentation at native 2cm resolution. Four state-of-the-art architectures: U-Net, PSPNet, DeepLabV3, and SegFormer were rigorously benchmarked across scratch and ImageNet-pretrained settings with three-seed reproducibility. SegFormer establishes new SOTA performance with F1 0.938 +/- 0.002 (Teak), IoU 0.968 +/- 0.001 (Teak), and Accuracy 0.986 +/- 0.001, outperforming all pretrained CNNs. Domain-adaptive training suffices, as the scratch SegFormer outperforms ImageNet pretrained baselines, avoiding large-scale pretraining overhead. Comprehensive analysis reveals Transformer's superior boundary delineation for dense plantation scenarios. TeakTreeNet provides researchers with 6391 expertly annotated drone patches (224x224) and establishes reproducible evaluation protocols, enabling direct comparison of future methods. Our benchmark demonstrates SegFormer's optimal balance of accuracy, efficiency, and deployability for operational forestry monitoring of teak plantations for India's western tropical forests.

title: A New Perspective on ANN-to-SNN Conversion: Hardware-Aligned Multi-Threshold Neuron Dynamics for Neuromorphic Inference
summary: By accumulating spikes over multiple timesteps, rate coding approximates the real-valued activations of an ANN, a principle that underpins numerous ANN-to-SNN conversion methods. However, the converted SNNs typically incur loss in accuracy compared to the original ANN. Existing methods either increase a number of timesteps or introduce more complex neuronal dynamics to reduce this accuracy gap. Yet, both approaches ultimately lead to the same outcome: redundancy either in information or in computation, thereby suffering from efficiency degradation. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{PRIME} (\underline{P}otential-\underline{R}esidual \underline{I}ntegration for \underline{M}ulti-threshold \underline{E}ncoding), a multi-threshold concurrent spiking neuron framework redesigned from a hardware data representation perspective:a) We introduce the Residual Membrane Potential Amplification (RMPA) mechanism, which replaces rate coding with Integration Coding by actively amplifying the residual membrane potential. RMPA enables the binary representation of spikes to carry substantially more information, achieving near-lossless conversion with as few as two timesteps.b) Complementarily, we implement concurrent spike firing in multi-threshold neurons, where spikes are decoded directly from the binary representation of floating-point data, eliminating membrane potential--threshold comparisons and replacing multiplications with lightweight bit-shift and accumulation operations that align with hardware computation primitives. At $T=2$ and $D=3$, we achieve competitive performance across both vision and language benchmarks with only 40.6\% of the FP32 bit-transmission cost and 13.4\% of the FP32 multiplication energy consumption. The PRIME framework establishes a new design principle for efficient ANN-to-SNN conversion, bridging the gap between algorithmic efficiency and hardware constraints.

title: A Polynomial-Time Best-of-Both-Worlds Algorithm for Matroid Semi-Bandit Problems
summary: Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader (FTPL) offers a computationally attractive framework for online learning, with recent advances establishing Best-of-Both-Worlds (BOBW) guarantees for various bandit settings. For matroid semi-bandits, existing methods offering such guarantees primarily rely on Follow-the-Regularized-Leader (FTRL), which requires solving an optimization problem at each round. We establish BOBW guarantees for FTPL with Fréchet and Pareto distributions with a certain parameter with geometric resampling in the matroid semi-bandit problem, showing that FTPL can simultaneously achieve the minimax-optimal $O(\sqrt{mdT})$ regret in adversarial setting and a logarithmic regret in stochastic setting. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first polynomial-time algorithm for matroid semi-bandits that achieves BOBW guarantees.

title: A Search Worth a Billion Pixels: Explaining Gigapixel Classifiers
summary: Perturbation-based attribution methods explain model predictions without accessing their internal representations, but scaling them to high-resolution images requires balancing perturbation granularity and computational cost. Fine-grained perturbations require many model evaluations, whereas coarse masks may overlook small but relevant evidence. We introduce Wavelet Find-and-Refine (WaFR), a model-agnostic attribution method combining adaptive hierarchical search with sparse multiscale regression. By selectively refining regions that influence the prediction, WaFR maintains fine-grained localisation with a computational cost that depends on the spatial distribution of the evidence. As image resolution increases to 8,192 pixels per side, WaFR maintains a Pointing Game score of at least .995 in controlled localisation experiments, including at matched forward-pass budgets. On gigapixel whole-slide images, it requires a median of 176 forward passes and achieves the highest mean patch-level AUROC among the evaluated perturbation-based methods (.949).

title: A statistical measure of trust in generative AI
summary: Trustworthiness is a crucial issue for generative AI, as modern models can produce convincing and confident responses even when their outputs are incomplete, unsupported, or wrong. The frequent absence of ground-truth knowledge or labels complicates verification of generative AI outputs. To address this issue, we propose a trustworthiness framework grounded in model-internal confidence calibrated against an external expert reference. We estimate per-token trustworthiness of a student generative model as the statistical typicality of each generated token relative to an expert model's distribution, where the expert is used as a distributional reference rather than as a source of factual verification labels. To this end, we introduce an AI ontology calibrator that leverages the student model's internal latent features and token-level output statistics to compute expert-reference acceptance scores. Combined with traditional token-level confidence, entropy, and perplexity statistics, calibrator scores yield a compact set of $15$ response-level indicators for correctness classification. Evaluated across BF program generation, mathematical problem solving, and medical question answering, combined calibrator and traditional indicators provide complementary reliability signal which could be used to build detectors of untrustworthy outputs and hallucinations. Remarkably, our experiments show that these detectors are transferable across domains, although transferability is not always symmetric.

title: A theory of inductive node-level generalization from a single large graph
summary:
In Graph Machine Learning (GML), the notion of generalization fundamentally varies depending on the task level and the properties of the dataset. For instance, graph-level tasks fit into the traditional ML framework of i.i.d. samples, with relatively small graphs. On the contrary, node-level tasks involve dependent nodes, often in a few large graphs. Existing studies often consider the transductive settings, where training and test data co-exist in the same graph, or, for inductive learning, try to recover some kind of probabilistic ``independence'', e.g. by still assuming a large number of independent graphs or subgraphs.
  In this work, we develop a novel framework to express the generalization capabilities of Graph ML algorithms for inductive node-level tasks when learning from a single large graph, taking inspiration from the literature on GNN transferability. In particular, we emphasize the similarities with classical ML by revisiting the excess risk decomposition with a new notion of ``transferable'' risk on large graphs. We apply this framework to Latent Position random graphs: we uncover new insights on the hardness of GML compared to traditional ML, and derive novel notions of concentration. Finally, we apply this framework to several models of GNNs, unifying several existing results on GNNs transferability and universality.

title: AI-Assisted Auto-formalization for Trustworthy Scientific Computing: Case Studies and Lessons Learned
summary: Agentic AI tools have recently had success in mathematical reasoning. Both general purpose coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex, and specialized mathematics agents such as Aristotle, have been used for formalizing mathematical problems such as Fermat's last theorem, Erdős problems and several IMO level math problems. However, much of these efforts are concentrated in the pure mathematics domain, which benefits from relatively self-contained theorem statements, fixed mathematical representation and extensive support in existing formal libraries. Applied mathematics, on the other hand, presents additional challenges because the source may describe a computational procedure or modeling transformation rather than a declarative theorem. In this work, we present a systematic study of AI-assisted auto-formalization for scientific computing (SC), a domain in applied mathematics central to U.S. Department of Energy applications. Through case studies spanning hierarchical abstraction layers in SC software stack, we evaluate not only whether AI agents can complete numerical proofs, but also where and why they fail across the stack. Our primary contribution is a cross-layer taxonomy of failure modes and an analysis of the form of expert feedback required at each layer to recover mathematical soundness. From these observations, we derive a workflow for recurring proof patterns and practical guidance for using AI agents while preserving mathematical soundness. Our results characterize both the practical value and the current limitations of AI-assisted formalization for trustworthy scientific computing.

title: AI-Assisted Programming and Labor Demand
summary: Generative AI has demonstrated human-level performance on technical work tasks, yet evidence on how these task-level capabilities are changing labor demand remains scarce. We study the firm-level adoption of GitHub Copilot, an AI coding assistant, across 5,414 multinational firms accounting for 38% of the U.S. programming workforce. To identify causal effects, we exploit a natural experiment generated by firms' predetermined software procurement cycles. Early AI-adopting firms hired more workers before the launch of GitHub Copilot and had larger, more technical, and older workforces. After one year, GitHub Copilot adoption reduces quarterly technical hiring by 29% among review-induced adopters, with no effect on separations, overall technical headcount, or vacancy duration. The hiring slowdown is concentrated in the subset of junior technical roles that involve the highest share of coding work. Overall, AI coding assistance causes firms to shift demand towards more experienced workers and roles that pair some coding with broader design responsibilities.

title: AIGI-26: A Benchmark for AI-Generated Image Detection Across Diverse Modern Generators
summary: Existing AI-generated image (AIGI) detection benchmarks predominantly rely on earlier synthesis systems with limited content diversity and conspicuous artifacts, failing to fully reflect the detection challenges posed by high-fidelity images from contemporary models. We introduce AIGI-26, a benchmark of 253,200 images covering 26 recent open- and closed-source generators. Its novel, diverse, and heterogeneous sources provide a basis for systematically evaluating detection methods on modern generated imagery. Additionally, to capture subtle statistical discrepancies across complementary forensic views, we propose the multi-aspect forensic detection network (MAFDNet). Its fixed forensic operators expose complementary texture, local prediction, resampling, and chromatic responses, summarized by a hierarchical encoder using multiscale means and standard deviations. In parallel, a spectral branch captures Fourier log-magnitude and neighboring-frequency phase variation across radial bands and directional axes. Fusing these descriptors combines local inconsistencies with global spectral organization for authenticity detection. Trained on 12,660 AIGI-26 images, MAFDNet achieves 88.5% accuracy and 94.9% average precision on the 240,540-image test set, with only 1.04M parameters and 1.39 GFLOPs per $256\times256$ input. MAFDNet also demonstrates effective cross-dataset generalization on DailyBench and Treasure-37.

title: Accuracy Is Not Evidence: Measuring and Training Evidence Dependence in Video Temporal Grounding
summary: In video temporal grounding, a correct interval can come from finding the event, answering blind or fitting one annotation style, and Recall at IoU scores them alike. We measure evidence dependence, how much the answer rests on the event's frames. Our fixed-answer audit edits either the frames inside the annotated interval or, as a placebo, as many frames elsewhere in the same video, and compares the two drops in the annotated answer's likelihood. Supervised fine-tuning and three public checkpoints trained with IoU-reward reinforcement learning raise the accuracy of Qwen2.5-VL-7B by 9 to 20 points, partly by answering blind and by fitting one annotation. Yet their answers rest on the event no more than the base model's, and the same holds for IoU-reward training on our data at the audit's frame rate. This comparison is a difference of the model's own likelihoods, so we can train on it. A placebo contrast and a bound on the placebo drop rule out learning to react to any edit. With them, evidence dependence rises in all five base models we train, and the weight on clean supervision controls how much. Added to IoU-reward training, the objective raises evidence dependence while keeping the accuracy gain. Masking the event's frames makes the trained models decline or miss the event more often than their base; masking as many other frames does not. The dependence moves to another event when the query names it, and holds on a second dataset and under patch scrambling, an edit never used in training.

title: AdaptRouter: Adaptive Routing across Evolving Tasks and Models
summary: Model routing assigns each query to a suitable foundation model, but tasks and available models keep changing, and existing routers are either untrained for the pool at hand or fit once and forget earlier tasks when updated. We present AdaptRouter, an adaptive router trained by policy learning: a compact multimodal decision model reads each question with cards describing the current experts and learns from native task feedback, without routing labels, to select one frozen expert. Open-weight and API experts share the router, its inputs, and the quality-cost trade-off but use different losses: cheap open-weight experts are explored with RL, whereas paid API experts are queried once and their cached feedback is reused as soft labels. New tasks are learned without replay, new experts enter as cards, and an open-weight quality-first advantage provably keeps cost from overriding quality. Across four task stages, AdaptRouter loses at most 0.4 points on earlier tasks, whereas feedback-trained routers lose up to 7.0, and as its pool grows from three to ten experts, its accuracy rises from 67.2% to 72.1%. On five API models, it exceeds GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Astra (low) by over 22 points at under a third of their cost.

title: Admitted Is Not Effective: Lessons from a Notary-Gated Retrospective Loop in an Agentic Pipeline
summary:
Agentic software development pipelines with frozen prompts can repeat the same mistakes across pull requests (PRs), yet ungoverned additions to instruction files grow without bound and do not generally improve task success. We present a retrospective loop for a four-stage large language model (LLM) pipeline in which a Retrospective agent proposes edits to learned rules every ten PRs and a Notary admits, merges, or rejects them while recording each decision in a provenance ledger. In a pre-registered study of 880 PRs on two Python repositories, the loop ran end to end and the Notary admitted 55 of 89 proposals, rejecting 8 that cited nonexistent evidence.
  However, held-out review comments and hidden-test resolution did not improve after ten retrospectives. Tracing each step of the loop, we found that sparse review signal (0.45 comments/PR) left little to learn from and that rules admitted on their stated evidence did not show measurable held-out effects.
